Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The lever one arm shoulder press is a machine-based exercise targeting the deltoid muscles of the shoulder. It is performed one arm at a time, allowing for focused muscle engagement and unilateral strength development. The exercise also involves the triceps and upper back as secondary muscles.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com as costas contra o apoio.
Segure o lever manopla com uma mão e posição o cotovelo na 90-degree ângulo.
Empurre o lever para cima até o braço está totalmente estendidos acima da cabeça.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o lever de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e passe para o outro braço.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento para Ombros Unilateral na Máquina Articulada

name: lever overhand triceps dip
instructions: Adjust the machine to the appropriate height and secure your body in position.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your body so that your arms are fully extended.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms close to your sides.
Continue lowering until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever overhand triceps dip is a machine-based exercise targeting the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It involves lowering and raising the body using a leverage machine, which provides stability and controlled resistance.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho para o appropriate altura e trave o corpo em posição.
Segure as manoplas com pegada pronada e posição o corpo de modo que seus braços estão totalmente estendidos.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo seu upper braços próximo a seu lados.
Continue descendo até os braços estejam paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os cotovelos.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Mergulho nas Paralelas na Máquina Articulada

name: lever preacher curl
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.
Place your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles with an underhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your elbows positioned on the pad.
Exhale and curl your forearms towards your upper arms, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever preacher curl is a strength training exercise performed on a leverage machine, primarily targeting the biceps with secondary activation of the forearms. It involves curling the handles upward while keeping the upper arms supported on a pad, which isolates the biceps and minimizes cheating.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no leverage aparelho.
Posicione os braços no apoio e pegada as manoplas com pegada supinada.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e os cotovelos positioned no apoio.
Expire e flexione os antebraços em direção aos braços, contraindo os bíceps.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, contraindo os bíceps.
Inspire e lentamente desça as manoplas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever reverse hyperextension
instructions: Adjust the leverage machine to fit your body and secure your feet in the foot pads.
Lie face down on the machine with your upper body hanging off the edge and your hips resting on the pad.
Cross your arms over your chest or place them behind your head.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your legs upward until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever reverse hyperextension is a machine-based exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It involves lying face down on a leverage machine and lifting the legs upward using the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o leverage aparelho para fit o corpo e trave os pés no pé apoios.
Deite-se de bruços no aparelho com o tronco livres para fora da borda e o quadril apoiando no apoio.
Cruze os braços sobre o peitoral ou posicione os pesos atrás da cabeça.
Contraia os glúteos e hamstrings para levante as pernas para cima até they estejam paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente as pernas à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever seated calf raise
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated calf raise is a machine-based exercise that targets the calf muscles, particularly the gastrocnemius and soleus. It is performed while seated, using a leverage machine to provide resistance as you raise and lower your heels.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco de modo que seus joelhos estão levemente flexionados e os pés estão apoiado no footplate.
Posicione as pontas dos pés no footplate com os calcanhares livres para fora da borda.
Segure as manoplas ou o lados do seat por stability.
Empurre através do balls dos pés para eleve os calcanhares as alto as possible.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever seated crunch (chest pad)
instructions: Adjust the seat height and chest pad position according to your comfort.
Sit on the machine with your back against the chest pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles or side bars for stability.
Engage your abs and slowly lean back, allowing the chest pad to move with you.
Pause for a moment at the maximum contraction, feeling the tension in your abs.
Slowly return to the starting position by contracting your abs and pulling yourself back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated crunch (chest pad) is an abdominal exercise performed on a leverage machine. It primarily targets the abs and also engages the obliques. The movement involves controlled flexion and extension of the torso against resistance, making it suitable for building core strength.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e peitoral apoio posição according para seu comfort.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o peitoral apoio e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas ou lado bars por stability.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente incline de volta, allowing o peitoral apoio para move com você.
Faça uma breve pausa no maximum contração, feeling o tension no abdômen.
Retorne lentamente à posição inicial por contraindo o abdômen e puxando yourself de volta para cima.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Abdominal Supra Sentado na Máquina Articulada

name: lever seated fly
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with a pronated grip and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Exhale and push the handles forward, bringing them together in front of your chest.
Pause for a moment, squeezing your chest muscles.
Inhale and slowly return to the starting position, allowing your chest muscles to stretch.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated fly is a machine-based exercise targeting the pectoral muscles, performed by bringing the handles together in front of the chest while seated.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com as costas contra o apoio.
Segure as manoplas com a pronated pegada e mantenha seus cotovelos levemente flexionados.
Expire e empurre as manoplas para a frente, aproximando os pesos juntos em frente ao peitoral.
Faça uma breve pausa, contraindo o peitoral muscles.
Inspire e retorne lentamente à posição inicial, allowing o peitoral muscles para alongamento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever seated hip abduction
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Place your hands on the side handles for stability.
Engage your abductors and slowly push your legs apart, away from the midline of your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your legs back together to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated hip abduction is a machine-based exercise that targets the hip abductor muscles. It is performed while seated, pushing the legs apart against resistance provided by the machine.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco de modo que seus joelhos estão na 90-degree ângulo.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o backrest e os pés no footrests.
Posicione as mãos no lado manoplas por stability.
Contraia seu abductors e lentamente empurre as pernas afastados, longe do midline do corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa no end do movimento, em seguida lentamente aproxime as pernas de volta juntos à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever seated hip adduction
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Place your feet on the footrests and grasp the handles for stability.
Engage your adductor muscles and slowly bring your legs together, squeezing your inner thighs.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated hip adduction is a machine-based exercise targeting the adductor muscles of the inner thighs. It is performed by bringing the legs together against resistance while seated.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com as costas contra o backrest.
Posicione os pés no footrests e segure as manoplas por stability.
Contraia seu adductor muscles e lentamente aproxime as pernas juntos, contraindo seu inner coxas.
Faça uma breve pausa no pico contração, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever seated leg curl
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your lower legs under the padded lever, just above your ankles.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper legs stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated leg curl is a machine-based exercise that targets the hamstrings. It involves curling your lower legs against resistance while seated, isolating the hamstrings and minimizing involvement from other muscle groups.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho para fit o corpo e sente-se no peso com as costas contra o backrest.
Posicione seu desça pernas sob o padded lever, just acima seu tornozelos.
Segure as manoplas no lados do aparelho por support.
Mantendo seu upper pernas stationary, expire e flexione as pernas para cima as far as possible.
Sustente a posição contraída pela breve faça uma pausa ao contraia os posteriores de coxa.
Inspire e lentamente desça o lever de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever seated leg raise crunch
instructions: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Grasp the handles or sidebars for stability.
Engage your abs and slowly raise your legs up towards your chest, curling your torso forward at the same time.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated leg raise crunch is an abdominal exercise performed on a leverage machine. It targets the abs and also works the hip flexors. The movement involves raising the legs and curling the torso forward simultaneously, providing a challenging core workout.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no leverage aparelho com as costas contra o backrest e os pés no footrests.
Segure as manoplas ou sidebars por stability.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente eleve as pernas para cima em direção ao peitoral, flexionando o tronco para a frente no same time.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente as pernas e tronco de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Abdominal Supra Sentado na Máquina Articulada

name: lever seated reverse fly (parallel grip)
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with a parallel grip, palms facing each other, and keep your arms slightly bent.
Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated reverse fly (parallel grip) is a machine-based exercise targeting the rear deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the trapezius and rhomboids. It involves pulling the handles back and outward while seated, focusing on squeezing the shoulder blades together.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com o peitoral contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas com a paralelo pegada, palmas voltadas uma para a outra, e mantenha seus braços levemente flexionados.
Expire e aproxime bem as escápulas ao puxe as manoplas de volta e para fora, longe do corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa no pico contração, em seguida inspire e retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Crucifixo Inverso Sentado na Máquina Articulada

name: lever seated reverse fly
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms slightly bent.
Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated reverse fly is a machine-based exercise targeting the rear deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the trapezius and rhomboids. It is performed seated, using a leverage machine, which provides stability and helps isolate the target muscles.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com o peitoral contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas com pegada pronada e mantenha seus braços levemente flexionados.
Expire e aproxime bem as escápulas ao puxe as manoplas de volta e para fora, longe do corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa no pico contração, em seguida inspire e retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Crucifixo Inverso Sentado na Máquina Articulada

name: lever shoulder press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at shoulder level.
Push the handles upward until your arms are fully extended, but do not lock your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever shoulder press is a machine-based exercise targeting the deltoid muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and chest. It is performed using a leverage machine, providing guided movement for safety and stability.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com as costas contra o backrest.
Segure as manoplas com pegada pronada e posição as mãos na altura dos ombros.
Empurre as manoplas para cima até a extensão completa dos braços, sem travar os cotovelos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente as manoplas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento para Ombros na Máquina Articulada

name: lever shrug
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight.
Keeping your back straight, lift your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever shrug is a machine-based exercise targeting the trapezius muscles. It involves elevating the shoulders while keeping the arms straight, using a leverage machine for resistance.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no leverage aparelho com as costas contra o apoio.
Segure as manoplas com pegada pronada e mantenha os braços estendidos.
Mantendo a coluna ereta, levante os ombros para cima em direção a seu ears as alto as possible.
Segure o contração pela instante, em seguida desça lentamente os ombros de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Encolhimento de Ombros na Máquina Articulada

name: lever standing calf raise
instructions: Adjust the machine to your height and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your shoulders under the pads and hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever standing calf raise is a strength exercise performed on a leverage machine, targeting the calves. It involves raising and lowering the heels while standing, using resistance provided by the machine.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho para seu altura e Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Posicione os ombros sob o apoios e segure-se nas manoplas por stability.
Eleve os calcanhares as alto as possible por estendendo seu tornozelos.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Panturrilha em Pé na Máquina Articulada

name: lever t bar row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate position to ensure proper alignment.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever T bar row is a machine-based exercise targeting the upper back, with secondary emphasis on the biceps and forearms. It is performed seated with the chest supported, reducing lower back strain and allowing for focused engagement of the upper back muscles.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e footplate posição para ensure proper alignment.
Sente-se no aparelho com o peitoral contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no footplate.
Segure as manoplas com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e contraia o abdômen.
Puxe as manoplas em direção ao tronco, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no pico contração, em seguida solte lentamente as manoplas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever triceps extension
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and fully extend your arms in front of you.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the handles towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the handles back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever triceps extension is an isolation exercise performed on a leverage machine to target the triceps. It involves extending the arms against resistance, focusing on triceps activation while minimizing shoulder involvement.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com as costas contra o apoio.
Segure as manoplas com pegada pronada e totalmente estenda os braços à sua frente.
Mantendo os braços firmes e imóveis, lentamente desça as manoplas em direção a seu forehead flexionando os cotovelos.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre as manoplas de volta para cima à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Extensão de Tríceps na Máquina Articulada

name: london bridge
instructions: Attach the rope to a high anchor point.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Lean forward slightly, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Pull the rope towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The London Bridge exercise targets the upper back using a rope attached to a high anchor point. It involves pulling the rope towards the body while squeezing the shoulder blades together, engaging the upper back, shoulders, biceps, and forearms.
instructions_pt: Prenda a corda em um ponto de fixação alto.
Fique de costas para o ponto de fixação com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure a corda com pegada pronada, palmas voltadas para baixo.
Incline para a frente levemente, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Puxe a corda em direção ao corpo, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no pico do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente o tension e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Puxada London Bridge com Corda (Costas Superior)

name: lying (side) quads stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight.
Bend your top leg and grab your ankle or foot with your hand.
Gently pull your ankle or foot towards your glutes until you feel a stretch in your quads.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat on the other side.
description: A static stretch performed lying on your side to target the quadriceps, often used to improve flexibility and reduce muscle tightness.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de lado com as pernas reto.
Flexione seu topo perna e grab seu tornozelo ou pé com a mão.
Gently puxe seu tornozelo ou pé em direção aos glúteos até você sentir um alongamento em seu quads.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds.
Solte o alongamento e Repita do outro lado.
name_pt: Alongamento de Quadríceps Deitado de Lado

name: lying leg raise flat bench
instructions: Lie flat on a flat bench with your back pressed against it.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Keep your legs straight and together, and lift them up towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lying leg raise flat bench is an abdominal exercise performed on a flat bench using only body weight. It primarily targets the abs and also engages the hip flexors. The movement involves lifting straight legs up towards the ceiling while lying flat, then lowering them back down under control.
instructions_pt: Deite-se apoiado na apoiado banco com as costas pressed contra o peso.
Posicione as mãos sob os glúteos por support.
Mantenha seu pernas reto e juntos, e levante os pesos para cima em direção ao ceiling.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente as pernas à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: march sit (wall)
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet hip-width apart.
Slowly slide your back down the wall until your knees are bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lift your right foot off the ground and bring your knee towards your chest.
Lower your right foot back down and lift your left foot off the ground, bringing your knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating between lifting your right and left foot for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The march sit (wall) is a lower body exercise performed with body weight, targeting the glutes and also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves holding a wall sit position while alternately lifting each knee towards the chest, mimicking a marching motion.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com as costas contra a wall e os pés na largura do quadril.
Lentamente slide as costas para baixo o wall até os joelhos estão flexionado a 90 graus.
Levante seu pé direito do chão e aproxime o joelho em direção ao peitoral.
Desça seu pé direito de volta para baixo e levante seu pé esquerdo do chão, aproximando o joelho em direção ao peitoral.
Continue alternando a elevação do pé direito e esquerdo pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Marcha Estacionária na Parede (Wall Sit March)

name: mixed grip chin-up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an underhand grip (palms facing towards you) and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your feet off the ground.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The mixed grip chin-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lats, with secondary emphasis on the biceps and forearms. It involves pulling your body up to a bar using a mixed grip, which challenges grip strength and upper body pulling power.
instructions_pt: Grab o puxe-para cima bar com pegada supinada (palmas voltadas para você) e suas mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso na barra com os braços totalmente estendidos e os pés do chão.
Contraia as costas muscles e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, leading com o peitoral.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o corpo de volta à posição inicial com control.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: monster walk
instructions: Place a resistance band around your ankles.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Take a step to the side with your right foot, maintaining tension on the resistance band.
Follow with your left foot, stepping to the side to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The monster walk is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes and also works the hamstrings and quadriceps. It is typically performed with a resistance band around the ankles to increase intensity. The movement involves stepping side-to-side while maintaining tension in the band and a slight knee bend.
instructions_pt: Posicione a elástico de resistência around seu tornozelos.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e levemente flexione os joelhos.
Take a dê um passo para o lado com seu pé direito, mantendo tension no elástico de resistência.
Follow com seu pé esquerdo, stepping para o lado para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de lado.

name: mountain climber
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and bring your right knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring your left knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, keeping your hips low and your core engaged.
Maintain a steady pace and breathe evenly throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Mountain climbers are a dynamic bodyweight exercise that targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the core, shoulders, and triceps. The movement mimics a running motion in a plank position, making it effective for both cardio and muscular endurance.
instructions_pt: Inicie na alto posição de prancha com as mãos directly sob os ombros e o corpo na linha reta.
Contraia o abdômen e aproxime seu joelho direito em direção ao peitoral, em seguida quickly troque e aproxime seu joelho esquerdo em direção ao peitoral.
Continue alternando pernas na running movimento, mantendo seus quadris baixo e o core engaged.
Mantenha a steady pace e breathe evenly throughout o exercise.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: muscle up
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you reach the top of the movement, transition your grip so that your palms are facing towards you.
Continue pulling yourself up until your chest is above the bar and your arms are fully flexed.
Reverse the movement by slowly lowering yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The muscle up is a challenging bodyweight exercise that combines a pull-up with a dip, requiring significant upper body strength, coordination, and explosive power. It targets the lats primarily, with secondary engagement of the biceps, triceps, shoulders, and chest.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging da puxe-para cima bar com suas palmas voltadas para a frente e os braços totalmente estendidos.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, leading com o peitoral.
Ao alcance o topo do movimento, transition seu pegada de modo que seu palms estão virado para em direção a você.
Continue puxando yourself para cima até o peitoral está acima a barra e os braços estão totalmente flexed.
Inverta o movimento por lentamente descendo yourself de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: neck bridge prone
instructions: Place a thick pad on the floor; kneel with toes tucked, hands under shoulders, and forehead on the pad.
Gently tuck the chin to create a long neck and brace your abs.
Press into your forehead and toes to lift the knees slightly, raising the hips into a pike.
With hands lightly assisting, slowly shift your body forward to load the forehead without collapsing the neck.
Pause briefly, then shift back to reduce load while maintaining alignment and steady breathing.
Perform small, pain-free rocks for reps, keeping movements slow and controlled.
Lower the knees back to the floor to exit the position.
description: Kneel on a padded surface and place your forehead on the mat with hands for support, hips high. Shift your weight between forehead and toes in small, controlled rocks to strengthen the neck while keeping a tucked-chin position.
instructions_pt: Posicione a thick apoio no chão; kneel com pontas dos pés tucked, mãos sob ombros, e forehead no apoio.
Gently tuck o chin para create a long pescoço e brace o abdômen.
Empurre into seu forehead e pontas dos pés para levante o joelhos levemente, elevando o quadril em um pike.
Com mãos lightly assisting, lentamente shift o corpo para a frente para load o forehead sem collapsing o pescoço.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida shift de volta para reduce load enquanto mantendo alignment e steady breathing.
Perform small, pain-free rocks por reps, mantendo movements slow e controlled.
Desça o joelhos de volta para o chão para exit o posição.
name_pt: Ponte Cervical em Decúbito Ventral (Neck Bridge)

name: negative crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The negative crunch is an abdominal exercise focusing on the eccentric (lowering) phase of the crunch to increase core strength and control.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraindo o abdômen, lentamente levante o tronco do chão, flexionando para a frente até o tronco formar um ângulo de 45 graus.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: oblique crunches floor
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, rotating your torso to one side.
Pause for a moment, then lower your shoulder blades back down to the floor.
Repeat on the other side, alternating sides with each repetition.
description: Oblique crunches on the floor target the abdominal muscles, especially the obliques, by incorporating a twisting motion as you crunch up. This exercise is performed lying on your back, using only body weight, and is suitable for most fitness levels.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas com os joelhos flexionado e pés apoiado no chão.
Posicione as mãos atrás da cabeça ou cruze os pesos sobre o peitoral.
Contraia o abdômen e levante o ombro blades do chão, girando o tronco para um lado.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida desça o ombro blades de volta para baixo para o chão.
Repita do outro lado, alternando lados com cada repetition.

name: olympic barbell hammer curl
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold an Olympic barbell with an overhand grip.
Let the barbell hang at arm's length in front of your thighs, with your palms facing your body.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The olympic barbell hammer curl is a strength exercise targeting the biceps and forearms. It involves curling an Olympic barbell with a neutral grip, emphasizing both the biceps and brachialis muscles.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure an Olympic barra com pegada pronada.
Mantenha a barra suspensa à frente em comprimento dos braços em frente a suas coxas, com suas palmas voltadas para o corpo.
Mantendo os braços firmes e imóveis, expire e flexione os antebraços contraindo os bíceps.
Continue para eleve a barra até os bíceps estão totalmente contraído e a barra está na altura dos ombros.
Sustente a posição contraída por um instante, contraindo ao máximo os bíceps.
Inspire e lentamente begin para desça a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: olympic barbell triceps extension
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding the barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the barbell above your head, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The olympic barbell triceps extension is a strength exercise targeting the triceps, performed by raising an Olympic barbell overhead and lowering it behind the head before extending the arms back up.
instructions_pt: Comece em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e segurando a barra com uma pegada pronada.
Eleve a barra acima da cabeça, totalmente estendendo os braços.
Mantendo seu upper braços próximo à cabeça, lentamente desça a barra atrás da cabeça flexionando os cotovelos.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida estenda os braços de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Extensão de Tríceps com Barra Olímpica

name: one arm chin-up
instructions: Stand facing a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach up and grab the bar with an underhand grip, with one hand gripping the bar and the other hand holding your wrist for support.
Hang from the bar with your arm fully extended, keeping your body straight and your core engaged.
Pull yourself up towards the bar by bending your elbow and squeezing your back muscles.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms and repeat.
description: The one arm chin-up is a highly advanced bodyweight exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi (lats) and requires significant strength, coordination, and grip power. It is performed by pulling your body up to a bar using only one arm, with the other hand optionally supporting the wrist.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a puxe-para cima bar com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Alcance para cima e grab a barra com pegada supinada, com uma mão gripping a barra e o outro mão segurando o punho por support.
Fique suspenso na barra com o braço totalmente estendidos, mantendo seu corpo reto e o core engaged.
Puxe yourself para cima em direção à barra por flexionando o cotovelo e contraindo as costas muscles.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra, em seguida desça lentamente yourself de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições, em seguida troque braços e repita.

name: one arm dip
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench or chair, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one hand on the bench or chair behind you, fingers pointing towards your body.
Extend your legs out in front of you, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench or chair.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat with the other arm.
description: The one arm dip is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It requires significant upper body strength, balance, and coordination, as you support your body weight with one arm while performing the dip motion.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para longe de um banco ou chair, com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Posicione uma mão no banco ou chair atrás você, fingers pointing em direção ao corpo.
Estenda as pernas para fora à sua frente, mantendo seus calcanhares no chão.
Flexione os cotovelos e desça o corpo em direção ao chão, mantendo seu de volta próximo ao banco ou chair.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre através de seu palms para straighten os braços e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições, em seguida troque lados e Repita com o outro braço.

name: one arm slam (with medicine ball)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the medicine ball with one hand in front of your waist.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Raise the medicine ball above your head, fully extending your arm.
Forcefully slam the medicine ball down to the ground, using your core and shoulders to generate power.
Catch the medicine ball on the bounce and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The one arm slam with a medicine ball is a dynamic exercise targeting the abs, shoulders, and back. It involves forcefully slamming a medicine ball to the ground with one arm, requiring core strength, power, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando o medicine bola com uma mão em frente a seu waist.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e contraia o abdômen.
Eleve o medicine bola acima da cabeça, totalmente estendendo o braço.
Forcefully slam o medicine bola para baixo para o chão, using o core e ombros para generate power.
Catch o medicine bola no bounce e Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições.

name: otis up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The Otis Up is a weighted abdominal exercise that targets the abs, with secondary emphasis on the hip flexors and lower back. It involves curling the torso up from a lying position, requiring core strength and stability.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraindo o abdômen, lentamente levante o tronco do chão, flexionando para a frente até o tronco formar um ângulo de 45 graus.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: outside leg kick push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
As you push back up, kick one leg out to the side, extending it fully and engaging your glutes.
Return your leg to the starting position and repeat the push-up, alternating legs with each repetition.
Continue alternating leg kicks and push-ups for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The outside leg kick push-up is a dynamic bodyweight exercise that combines a traditional push-up with a lateral leg kick, targeting the glutes and engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. This movement challenges upper body strength, core stability, coordination, and lower body mobility.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros e os pés juntos.
Desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Ao empurre de volta para cima, kick uma perna para fora para o lado, estendendo o peso totalmente e contraindo os glúteos.
Retorne a perna à posição inicial e repita o empurre-para cima, alternando pernas com cada repetition.
Continue alternando perna kicks e empurre-ups pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: overhead triceps stretch
instructions: Stand or sit upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm overhead, bending at the elbow so that your hand reaches towards the opposite shoulder blade.
With your other hand, gently pull the elbow of the extended arm towards the opposite side of your head, feeling a stretch in your triceps.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other side.
description: The overhead triceps stretch is a static stretching exercise that targets the triceps and also stretches the shoulders. It is performed by extending one arm overhead, bending at the elbow, and using the opposite hand to gently pull the elbow for a deeper stretch.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ou Sente-se ereto com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Estenda um braço acima da cabeça, flexionando no cotovelo de modo que seu mão reaches em direção ao oposto ombro blade.
Com seu outro mão, gently puxe o cotovelo do estendido braço em direção ao lado oposto da cabeça, feeling a alongamento em seu triceps.
Segure o alongamento por 15-30 seconds, em seguida solte.
Repita do outro lado.

name: power clean
instructions: Start with the barbell on the ground in front of you, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and chest up as you lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.
As the barbell reaches your mid-thigh, explosively pull it upwards, shrugging your shoulders and pulling your elbows high and to the sides.
As the barbell reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath it, rotating your elbows around and catching the barbell on your shoulders in a front squat position.
Stand up with the barbell, fully extending your hips and knees.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position, keeping control of the weight throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The power clean is a compound Olympic weightlifting movement that involves lifting a barbell from the floor to the shoulders in one explosive motion. It targets the hamstrings, glutes, quadriceps, and calves, and requires significant strength, coordination, and technique.
instructions_pt: Comece com a barra no chão à sua frente, com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Flexione para baixo e pegada a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e peito estufado ao levante a barra do chão, estendendo o quadril e joelhos.
As a barra reaches seu mid-coxa, explosively puxe o peso upwards, shrugging os ombros e puxando os cotovelos alto e para o lados.
As a barra reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath o peso, girando os cotovelos around e catching a barra nos ombros na frente squat posição.
Fique em pé para cima com a barra, totalmente estendendo o quadril e joelhos.
Desça a barra de volta à posição inicial, mantendo o controle da carga throughout o movimento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: pull-in (on stability ball)
instructions: Start by sitting on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands on the sides of the stability ball for support.
Engage your abs and slowly roll your hips forward, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The pull-in on a stability ball is an abdominal exercise that also engages the hip flexors. It requires balance and core strength as you bring your knees toward your chest while stabilizing your body on the ball.
instructions_pt: Comece sitting no bola suíça com os pés apoiado no chão e os joelhos flexionado a 90 graus.
Posicione as mãos no lados do bola suíça por support.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente roll o quadril para a frente, aproximando os joelhos em direção ao peitoral.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida lentamente estenda as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Encolhimento de Joelhos na Bola Suíça (Jackknife)

name: pull up (neutral grip)
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The neutral grip pull-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) and also engaging the biceps and forearms. It is performed by hanging from a pull-up bar with palms facing each other, pulling the chin above the bar, and lowering back down with control.
instructions_pt: Fique suspenso na barra fixa com pegada neutra (palmas voltadas uma para a outra) e os braços totalmente estendidos.
Contraia o abdômen e aproxime bem as escápulas.
Puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra flexionando os cotovelos e driving os cotovelos para baixo em direção ao quadril.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o corpo de volta à posição inicial com control.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: pull-up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and bringing your chest towards the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The pull-up is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the latissimus dorsi muscles of the back. It also engages the biceps and forearms as secondary muscles. The movement requires significant upper body strength, coordination, and control, making it a challenging exercise for many individuals.
instructions_pt: Fique suspenso na barra fixa com suas palmas voltadas para a frente e os braços totalmente estendidos.
Contraia o abdômen e aproxime bem as escápulas.
Puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra flexionando os cotovelos e aproximando o peitoral em direção à barra.
Faça uma pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente o corpo de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: push-up (bosu ball)
instructions: Place the bosu ball on the ground with the flat side facing up.
Position yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the outer edges of the bosu ball.
Engage your core and lower your body down towards the bosu ball by bending your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The push-up (bosu ball) is a variation of the traditional push-up performed with hands on a BOSU ball, increasing instability and engaging more core and stabilizer muscles.
instructions_pt: Posicione o bosu bola no chão com o apoiado lado virado para para cima.
Posição yourself na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos no outer edges do bosu bola.
Contraia o abdômen e desça o corpo para baixo em direção ao bosu bola flexionando os cotovelos.
Empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: push-up (on stability ball)
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and position yourself facing down with your hands on the ball, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, balancing on your toes.
Engage your core and lower your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The push-up on a stability ball is a challenging variation of the traditional push-up that requires additional balance and core engagement. By placing your hands on a stability ball, you increase the instability of the movement, forcing your chest, triceps, shoulders, and core to work harder to maintain proper form.
instructions_pt: Posicione o bola suíça no chão e posição yourself virado para para baixo com as mãos no bola, na largura dos ombros.
Estenda as pernas estendidos atrás você, balancing nas pontas dos pés.
Contraia o abdômen e desça o peitoral em direção ao bola flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo seu corpo na linha reta.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Flexão de Braço na Bola Suíça

name: push-up (on stability ball)
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and position yourself facing down with your hands on the ball, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, balancing on your toes.
Engage your core and lower your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The push-up on a stability ball is a challenging variation of the traditional push-up that increases instability, requiring greater core engagement and balance. It primarily targets the pectorals, with significant involvement from the triceps, shoulders, and core.
instructions_pt: Posicione o bola suíça no chão e posição yourself virado para para baixo com as mãos no bola, na largura dos ombros.
Estenda as pernas estendidos atrás você, balancing nas pontas dos pés.
Contraia o abdômen e desça o peitoral em direção ao bola flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo seu corpo na linha reta.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Flexão de Braço na Bola Suíça

name: push-up (wall) v. 2
instructions: Stand facing a wall, about arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back with your feet, keeping them hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the wall, keeping your body straight.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The wall push-up is a beginner-friendly variation of the traditional push-up, performed standing and pressing against a wall. It primarily targets the pectorals, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. This exercise is ideal for those new to strength training or individuals seeking a low-impact alternative to floor push-ups.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a wall, about comprimento dos braços longe.
Posicione as mãos no wall na altura dos ombros, levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Dê um passo de volta com os pés, mantendo os pesos na largura do quadril.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu corpo na linha reta de cabeça para calcanhares.
Flexione os cotovelos e desça o peitoral em direção ao wall, mantendo seu corpo reto.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre o corpo de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: push-up (wall)
instructions: Stand facing a wall, about arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back a few feet, keeping your body straight and your feet hip-width apart.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the wall, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the starting position, straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The wall push-up is a beginner-friendly variation of the traditional push-up, performed standing and pressing against a wall. It primarily targets the pectorals, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and deltoids. This exercise is ideal for those new to strength training or individuals needing a low-impact alternative.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a wall, about comprimento dos braços longe.
Posicione as mãos no wall na altura dos ombros, levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Dê um passo de volta a few pés, mantendo seu corpo reto e os pés na largura do quadril.
Flexione os cotovelos e desça o peitoral em direção ao wall, mantendo seu corpo na linha reta.
Empurre de volta para cima à posição inicial, estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: push-up close-grip off dumbbell
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed close together, directly under your shoulders.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, resting them on the ground.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The push-up close-grip off dumbbell is a variation of the push-up that targets the triceps, with additional emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It is performed by gripping dumbbells placed on the ground, which increases the range of motion and challenges stability.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos placed fechado juntos, directly sob os ombros.
Segure um halter em cada mão, apoiando os pesos no chão.
Desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo os pesos próximo a seu lados.
Empurre através de seu palms para estenda os braços e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: push-up inside leg kick
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
As you push back up, lift one leg off the ground and kick it out to the side, keeping it straight.
Lower your leg back down and repeat the push-up, then switch to the other leg.
Continue alternating leg kicks with each push-up repetition.
description: The push-up inside leg kick is a dynamic bodyweight exercise that combines a standard push-up with a lateral leg kick, targeting the glutes and engaging the core, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It requires coordination, balance, and strength.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros e os pés juntos.
Desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Ao empurre de volta para cima, levante uma perna do chão e kick o peso para fora para o lado, mantendo-o reto.
Desça a perna de volta para baixo e repita o empurre-para cima, em seguida troque para o outro perna.
Continue alternando perna kicks com cada empurre-para cima repetition.

name: push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The push-up is a classic bodyweight exercise that targets the pectoral muscles, triceps, deltoids, and core. It is performed by lowering and raising the body using the arms while maintaining a straight line from head to heels.
instructions_pt: Inicie na alto posição de prancha com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros e os pés juntos.
Contraia o abdômen e desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo seu corpo na linha reta.
Faça uma breve pausa when o peitoral está just acima o chão, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: push-up medicine ball
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands on the medicine ball, shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The push-up medicine ball is a challenging variation of the traditional push-up that requires you to place both hands on a medicine ball. This increases the demand on your chest, triceps, shoulders, and core, while also challenging your balance and stability.
instructions_pt: Inicie na alto posição de prancha com as mãos no medicine bola, na largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Empurre através de seu palms para estenda os braços e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Flexão com Apoio na Medicine Ball

name: push-up to side plank
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Shift your weight onto your left hand and rotate your body to the right, lifting your right arm towards the ceiling.
Hold the side plank position for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the push-up and side plank on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The push-up to side plank is a compound bodyweight exercise that combines a traditional push-up with a rotational movement into a side plank. This exercise targets the abs while also engaging the shoulders, chest, and triceps, and challenges core stability and balance.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos na largura dos ombros e o corpo na linha reta.
Desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo o abdômen contraído.
Empurre de volta para cima à posição inicial.
transfira o peso do corpo onto seu mão esquerda e gire o corpo para a direita, levantando seu braço direito em direção ao ceiling.
Segure o lado posição de prancha pela few seconds, em seguida retorne à posição inicial.
Repita o empurre-para cima e lado plank no lado oposto.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Flexão com Transição para Prancha Lateral

name: raise single arm push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position, using your chest muscles to lift your body.
Repeat with the other arm extended.
description: The raise single arm push-up is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the pectorals while also engaging the triceps, shoulders, and core. It requires significant strength, balance, and coordination as one arm is extended out to the side while performing a push-up.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros e os pés juntos.
Estenda um braço estendidos para o lado, paralelos ao chão.
Desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Empurre de volta para cima à posição inicial, using o peitoral muscles para levante o corpo.
Repita com o outro braço estendido.

name: rear decline bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The rear decline bridge is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It involves lifting the hips off the ground while lying on your back, engaging the posterior chain.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas com os pés apoiado no chão e os joelhos flexionado.
Posicione os braços por seu lados com suas palmas voltadas para baixo.
Contraia os glúteos e hamstrings, e levante o quadril do chão até o corpo forms a linha reta dos joelhos para os ombros.
Sustente essa posição pela few seconds, em seguida desça lentamente o quadril de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: rear deltoid stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your right arm across your chest, placing your left hand on your right elbow.
Gently pull your right arm towards your left shoulder, feeling a stretch in your right shoulder.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other side.
description: The rear deltoid stretch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the deltoid muscles, particularly the rear (posterior) delts. It also stretches the trapezius and rhomboids. This movement is commonly used to improve shoulder flexibility and relieve tension.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Estenda seu braço direito através do peitoral, placing seu mão esquerda em seu cotovelo direito.
Gently puxe seu braço direito em direção a seu ombro esquerdo, feeling a alongamento em seu ombro direito.
Segure o alongamento por 15-30 seconds, em seguida solte.
Repita do outro lado.

name: rear pull-up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The rear pull-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) and also engaging the biceps and forearms. It involves pulling your body up to a bar with an overhand grip, focusing on back strength and control.
instructions_pt: Grab o puxe-para cima bar com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso na barra com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo reto.
Contraia as costas muscles e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, mantendo os cotovelos junto ao corpo.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra.
Faça uma pausa no topo e retorne o corpo controladamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: reverse dip
instructions: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The reverse dip is a bodyweight exercise targeting the triceps, performed between two parallel bars. It also engages the chest and shoulders as secondary muscles.
instructions_pt: Posição yourself entre dois barras paralelas com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo reto.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos até os braços estejam paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: reverse grip machine lat pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your chest out and shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the handles down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The reverse grip machine lat pulldown targets the latissimus dorsi using a leverage machine and an underhand grip, also engaging the biceps and forearms. It is performed seated with controlled movement, focusing on pulling the handles down to the chest and squeezing the shoulder blades together.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com os joelhos sob o apoios e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas com pegada supinada, levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Sente-se ereto com o peitoral para fora e ombros de volta, mantendo a slight arch em seu desça de volta.
Puxe as manoplas para baixo em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente as manoplas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: reverse grip pull-up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The reverse grip pull-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lats, performed by pulling the body up to a bar with an underhand grip. It also engages the biceps and forearms.
instructions_pt: Grab o puxe-para cima bar com pegada supinada, mãos na largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso na barra com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo reto.
Contraia as costas muscles e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, leading com o peitoral.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra.
Faça uma pausa no topo e retorne o corpo controladamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: reverse hyper extension (on stability ball)
instructions: Lie face down on a stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your legs extended straight behind you.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for stability.
Engaging your glutes and hamstrings, lift your legs up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The reverse hyper extension on a stability ball targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It requires balance and core stability due to the use of the stability ball, making it more challenging than a floor-based version.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de bruços na bola suíça com o quadril apoiando no bola e as pernas estendido em linha reta atrás você.
Posicione as mãos no chão à sua frente por stability.
Contraindo os glúteos e hamstrings, levante as pernas para cima em direção ao ceiling as alto ao can.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente as pernas à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: ring dips
instructions: Start by hanging from the rings with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Ring dips are a challenging bodyweight exercise performed on gymnastic rings, primarily targeting the triceps, with significant engagement of the chest and shoulders. The instability of the rings requires considerable strength, balance, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging do rings com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo reto.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos até os ombros estão abaixo os cotovelos.
Empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: rocky pull-up pulldown
instructions: Stand in front of a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach up and grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The rocky pull-up pulldown is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lats, with secondary emphasis on the biceps and forearms. It involves pulling the body up to a bar and lowering it under control, requiring significant upper body strength and coordination.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé em frente à puxe-para cima bar com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Alcance para cima e grab a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso na barra com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo reto.
Contraia as costas muscles e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, leading com o peitoral.
Faça uma pausa no topo e retorne o corpo controladamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: rope climb
instructions: Stand facing the rope with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grab the rope with both hands, palms facing towards you.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Begin pulling yourself up the rope by alternating hand-over-hand movements.
Use your legs to assist in the upward movement.
Continue climbing until you reach the desired height or the top of the rope.
To descend, reverse the hand-over-hand movement while controlling your descent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The rope climb is a challenging upper body exercise that targets the upper back, forearms, biceps, and shoulders. It requires significant grip strength, coordination, and core stability, as well as the ability to use both the upper and lower body to ascend and descend a rope safely.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a corda com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Grab a corda com ambas as mãos, palmas voltadas para você.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e contraia o abdômen.
Begin puxando yourself para cima a corda por alternando mão-sobre-mão movements.
Use as pernas para assist no para cima movimento.
Continue climbing até você alcance o altura desejada ou o topo da corda.
Para descend, inverta o mão-sobre-mão movimento enquanto controlling seu descent.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: run (equipment)
instructions: Start by standing upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your upper body relaxed.
Begin jogging in place, lifting your knees up towards your chest and landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Maintain a steady pace and continue jogging for the desired duration or distance.
Remember to breathe deeply and maintain good posture throughout the exercise.
description: Running in place is a cardiovascular exercise that elevates the heart rate and improves overall endurance. It requires no equipment and can be performed anywhere, making it accessible for most fitness levels.
instructions_pt: Comece standing upright com os pés na largura do quadril.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu upper corpo relaxed.
Begin jogging em posicione, levantando os joelhos para cima em direção ao peitoral e aterrissando softly no balls dos pés.
Mantenha a steady pace e continue jogging pelo desejado duration ou distance.
Remember para breathe deeply e mantenha good posture throughout o exercise.

name: run
instructions: Start by standing upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your upper body relaxed.
Begin jogging in place, lifting your knees up towards your chest and landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Maintain a steady pace and continue jogging for the desired duration or distance.
Remember to breathe deeply and maintain good posture throughout the exercise.
description: Running is a fundamental cardiovascular exercise that involves jogging or running in place or over a distance. It primarily targets the cardiovascular system and also engages the lower body muscles.
instructions_pt: Comece standing upright com os pés na largura do quadril.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu upper corpo relaxed.
Begin jogging em posicione, levantando os joelhos para cima em direção ao peitoral e aterrissando softly no balls dos pés.
Mantenha a steady pace e continue jogging pelo desejado duration ou distance.
Remember para breathe deeply e mantenha good posture throughout o exercise.

name: russian twist
instructions: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lean back slightly while keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Hold your hands together in front of your chest or hold a weight if desired.
Lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your sit bones.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing your hands or weight towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing your hands or weight towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The Russian twist is a core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles and obliques. It involves rotating the torso from side to side while balancing on the sit bones, often with the feet lifted off the ground.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com os joelhos flexionado e pés apoiado no chão.
Incline de volta levemente enquanto mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Segure as mãos juntos em frente ao peitoral ou segure a peso if desejado.
Levante os pés do chão, balancing em seu sente-se bones.
Gire o tronco para a direita, aproximando as mãos ou peso em direção ao lado direito do corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida gire o tronco para a esquerda, aproximando as mãos ou peso em direção ao lado esquerdo do corpo.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: scapular pull-up
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Retract your shoulder blades by pulling them down and back.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, focusing on squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
