description: The scapular pull-up is a bodyweight exercise that targets the trapezius muscles and helps improve scapular control and shoulder stability. It is performed by hanging from a pull-up bar and retracting the shoulder blades without bending the elbows.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging da puxe-para cima bar com suas palmas voltadas para a frente e os braços totalmente estendidos.
Retract o ombro blades por puxando os pesos para baixo e de volta.
Contraia as costas muscles e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, focusing em aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente o corpo de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: seated leg raise
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support.
Keeping your legs straight, slowly raise them up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The seated leg raise is an abdominal exercise performed while sitting on a bench. It primarily targets the abs and also engages the hip flexors. The movement involves raising the legs while keeping them straight, which requires core strength and stability.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na apoiado banco com as costas reto e os pés apoiado no chão.
Posicione as mãos no lados do banco por support.
Mantendo seu pernas reto, lentamente eleve os pesos para cima à sua frente até they estejam paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente as pernas à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: seated lower back stretch
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on your thighs or on the sides of the chair for support.
Slowly lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Feel the stretch in your lower back and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A gentle stretch performed while seated to target the lower back and lats, also engaging the glutes and hamstrings. This exercise is suitable for improving flexibility and relieving tension in the lower back area.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no edge da chair com os pés apoiado no chão.
Posicione as mãos em suas coxas ou no lados do chair por support.
Lentamente incline para a frente do quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Feel o alongamento em seu desça de volta e segure por 20-30 seconds.
Retorne lentamente à posição inicial e Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições.

name: seated side crunch (wall)
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back against a wall and your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lean to one side, bringing your elbow towards your hip.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The seated side crunch (wall) is an abdominal exercise performed while sitting on the floor with your back against a wall. It targets the abs and obliques by having you lean side to side, bringing your elbow toward your hip.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com as costas contra a wall e seu pernas estendidas à sua frente.
Flexione os joelhos e posicione os pés apoiado no chão, na largura do quadril.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraia o abdômen e incline para um lado, aproximando o cotovelo em direção ao quadril.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida retorne à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: self assisted inverse leg curl (on floor)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Lift your hips off the ground, engaging your glutes and hamstrings.
Slowly curl your legs towards your glutes, keeping your hips lifted.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
Lower your hips back down to the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The self assisted inverse leg curl (on floor) is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary emphasis on the glutes and calves. It involves curling the legs towards the glutes while keeping the hips lifted, requiring significant hamstring strength and control.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com seu pernas estendidas e os braços por seu lados.
Flexione os joelhos e posicione os pés apoiado no chão, na largura do quadril.
Levante o quadril do chão, contraindo os glúteos e hamstrings.
Lentamente flexione as pernas em direção aos glúteos, mantendo seus quadris lifted.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida lentamente estenda as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Desça o quadril de volta para baixo para o chão.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: self assisted inverse leg curl
instructions: Lie flat on your back on a mat or bench with your legs extended.
Place your hands by your sides or under your glutes for support.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The self assisted inverse leg curl is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary emphasis on the glutes and calves. It involves curling the legs towards the chest while lying on your back, using your hands for support if needed.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão na mat ou banco com seu pernas estendidas.
Posicione as mãos por seu lados ou sob os glúteos por support.
Flexione os joelhos e levante os pés do chão, aproximando suas coxas em direção ao peitoral.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: shoulder tap push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you push back up, lift your right hand off the ground and tap your left shoulder.
Return your right hand to the ground and repeat the push-up, this time lifting your left hand and tapping your right shoulder.
Continue alternating shoulder taps with each push-up repetition.
Maintain a stable core and avoid excessive hip rotation throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The shoulder tap push-up is a bodyweight exercise that combines a standard push-up with an alternating shoulder tap at the top of each rep. This movement challenges the chest, triceps, and core while also requiring balance and coordination to stabilize the body during the shoulder tap.
instructions_pt: Inicie na alto posição de prancha com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros e o corpo na linha reta de cabeça para calcanhares.
Desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo os pesos próximo a seu lados.
Ao empurre de volta para cima, levante seu mão direita do chão e tap seu ombro esquerdo.
Retorne seu mão direita para o chão e repita o empurre-para cima, this time levantando seu mão esquerda e tapping seu ombro direito.
Continue alternando ombro taps com cada empurre-para cima repetition.
Mantenha a stable core e avoid excessive quadril rotation throughout o exercise.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: side bridge v. 2
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
description: The side bridge v. 2 is a core stability exercise performed on the floor using only body weight. It targets the abs, with secondary emphasis on the obliques and glutes. The movement involves holding a side plank position, which challenges core strength and stability.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de lado com seu pernas estendidas e stacked em topo de cada outro.
Posicione o antebraço no chão directly abaixo o ombro, com o cotovelo flexionado a 90 graus.
Contraia o abdômen e levante o quadril do chão, creating a linha reta da cabeça para os pés.
Sustente essa posição pelo desejado amount de time.
Desça o quadril de volta à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado.

name: side hip (on parallel bars)
instructions: Stand between two parallel bars with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands on the bars and lift your body off the ground, supporting your weight on your arms.
Engage your abs and slowly lift your legs to the side, keeping them straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The side hip (on parallel bars) is a challenging core exercise that targets the abs, obliques, and hip flexors by requiring you to lift your legs to the side while supporting your body weight on parallel bars.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé entre dois barras paralelas com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Posicione as mãos no bars e levante o corpo do chão, supporting seu peso nos braços.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente levante as pernas para o lado, mantendo-os estendidos.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente as pernas à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação Lateral de Quadril nas Barras Paralelas

name: side hip abduction
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight to one leg and lift the opposite leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Side hip abduction is a bodyweight exercise that targets the hip abductors, helping to strengthen the outer thighs and hips. It also engages the glutes and quadriceps as secondary muscles. This movement is commonly used for strengthening, mobility, and rehabilitation purposes.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e as mãos no quadril.
transfira o peso do corpo para uma perna e levante o perna oposta para fora para o lado, mantendo-o reto.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a perna de volta à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Abdução de Quadril Deitado de Lado

name: side neck stretch
instructions: Stand or sit upright with feet hip-width apart, chest tall, and shoulders relaxed and down.
Keep your gaze forward and chin level (neutral neck).
Slowly tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder without lifting or shrugging the shoulder.
Stop at a mild stretch on the left side of the neck and breathe steadily; hold 15–30 seconds.
Return to neutral slowly.
Repeat to the left side for 15–30 seconds; perform 2–3 rounds per side, moving gently and without pain.
description: Stand or sit tall and gently tilt your head to bring one ear toward the same-side shoulder to stretch the opposite side of the neck. Keep shoulders level and relaxed, hold the stretch, then switch sides.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ou Sente-se ereto com pés na largura do quadril, peitoral tall, e ombros relaxed e para baixo.
Mantenha seu gaze para a frente e chin altura (neutral pescoço).
Incline suavemente a cabeça para a direita, aproximando a orelha direita do ombro direito sem elevar ou encolher os ombros.
Stop na mild alongamento à esquerda lado do pescoço e breathe steadily; segure 15-30 seconds.
Retorne para neutral lentamente.
Repita para a esquerda lado por 15-30 seconds; perform 2-3 rounds per lado, moving gently e sem pain.

name: side push neck stretch
instructions: Stand or sit up straight with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Place your right hand on the left side of your head and gently apply pressure to increase the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other side, tilting your head to the left and applying pressure with your left hand.
Repeat the stretch 2-3 times on each side.
description: The side push neck stretch is a gentle stretching exercise targeting the levator scapulae and other neck muscles. It helps improve flexibility and relieve tension in the neck and upper shoulders.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ou sente-se para cima reto com os ombros relaxed.
Incline a cabeça para a direita, aproximando a orelha direita do ombro direito.
Posicione seu mão direita à esquerda lado da cabeça e gently apply pressure para increase o alongamento.
Segure o alongamento por 15-30 seconds.
Repita do outro lado, tilting a cabeça para a esquerda e applying pressure com seu mão esquerda.
Repita o alongamento 2-3 times em cada lado.
name_pt: Alongamento Lateral de Pescoço com Pressão Manual

name: side push-up
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom hand on the ground directly under your shoulder, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your bottom hand to lift your body off the ground, keeping your legs straight and your core engaged.
Extend your top arm straight up towards the ceiling, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The side push-up is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the triceps, while also engaging the shoulders, chest, and core. It is performed by lying on your side and pressing your body up using your bottom arm, which challenges your upper arm strength and stability.
instructions_pt: Comece lying em seu lado com seu pernas estendidas e stacked em topo de cada outro.
Posicione seu bottom mão no chão directly sob o ombro, fingers pointing para a frente.
Empurre através de seu bottom mão para levante o corpo do chão, mantendo seu pernas reto e o core engaged.
Estenda seu topo braço reto para cima em direção ao ceiling, creating a linha reta da cabeça para os calcanhares.
Desça o corpo de volta à posição inicial com control.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de lado.

name: side-to-side chin
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Pull yourself up by bending your elbows and bringing your chin towards the bar, while keeping your body straight.
Once your chin is above the bar, lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The side-to-side chin is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lats, performed by pulling yourself up to a bar and shifting your chin from one side to the other at the top of the movement. This variation increases the challenge to the lats and requires greater strength and control than a standard chin-up.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure a puxe-para cima bar com pegada pronada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso na barra com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo relaxed.
Puxe yourself para cima flexionando os cotovelos e aproximando o queixo em direção à barra, enquanto mantendo seu corpo reto.
Once o queixo está acima a barra, Desça o corpo de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: side wrist pull stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you.
Extend your right arm out to the side, parallel to the ground, with your palm facing down.
With your left hand, grab your right hand and gently pull it towards your body, feeling a stretch in your right forearm.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other side.
description: The side wrist pull stretch is a bodyweight exercise that targets the forearms and helps improve flexibility and mobility in the wrists and hands. It is performed by extending one arm to the side and gently pulling the hand towards the body with the opposite hand, creating a stretch in the forearm.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e seus braços estendidos à sua frente.
Estenda seu braço direito para fora para o lado, paralelos ao chão, com seu palm virado para para baixo.
Com a mão esquerda, segure a mão direita e puxe-a suavemente em direção ao corpo, sentindo o alongamento no antebraço direito.
Segure o alongamento por 15-30 seconds, em seguida solte.
Repita do outro lado.
name_pt: Alongamento de Flexores do Punho Lateral

name: single arm push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and one hand placed slightly wider than the other.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight.
As you lower yourself, shift your weight to one side and lift the opposite arm off the ground, extending it straight out to the side.
Push through your chest and triceps to raise your body back up to the starting position, while simultaneously lowering your extended arm back to the ground.
Repeat the movement, alternating the arm you extend with each repetition.
description: The single arm push-up is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the pectorals while also engaging the triceps, shoulders, and core. It requires significant strength, balance, and coordination, making it suitable for advanced practitioners.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos na largura dos ombros e uma mão placed levemente wider than o outro.
Contraia o abdômen e desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Ao Desça o corpo, transfira o peso do corpo para um lado e levante o braço oposto do chão, estendendo o peso estendidos para o lado.
Empurre através do peitoral e triceps para eleve o corpo de volta para cima à posição inicial, enquanto simultaneamente descendo seu estendido braço de volta para o chão.
Repita o movimento, alternando o braço você estenda com cada repetition.

name: single leg calf raise (on a dumbbell)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
description: The single leg calf raise (on a dumbbell) is a lower leg exercise that targets the calves, with secondary emphasis on the ankles and feet. It involves balancing on one leg while holding a dumbbell and performing a calf raise, which increases the challenge to balance and strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura do quadril e segure um halter em uma mão.
Levante um pé do chão e balance no outro pé.
Lentamente eleve o calcanhar as alto as possible, using seu calf muscles.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o calcanhar de volta para baixo.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e passe para a outra perna.

name: single leg platform slide
instructions: Start by standing with one foot on a platform or slide board.
Bend your knee slightly and slide the foot on the platform backward, extending your leg.
Keep your core engaged and maintain a straight posture throughout the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position by sliding your foot back to the initial position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The single leg platform slide is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary emphasis on the glutes and quadriceps. It involves sliding one foot backward on a platform while maintaining balance and core engagement.
instructions_pt: Comece standing com um pé na platform ou slide board.
Flexione o joelho levemente e slide o pé no platform para trás, estendendo a perna.
Mantenha o abdômen contraído e mantenha a reto posture throughout o movimento.
Retorne lentamente à posição inicial por sliding o pé de volta para o initial posição.
Repita o movimento pelo número desejado de repetições, em seguida troque pernas.

name: sit-up v. 2
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sit-up v. 2 is a bodyweight abdominal exercise that targets the abs and also engages the hip flexors. It involves curling the torso up from a lying position to a 45-degree angle, then lowering back down.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraindo o abdômen, lentamente levante o tronco do chão, flexionando para a frente até o tronco formar um ângulo de 45 graus.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: sled 45° calf press
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Place your feet on the sled platform with your toes pointing forward.
Push the sled platform away from you by extending your ankles and calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled 45° calf press is a machine-based exercise that targets the calves by pressing a weighted sled away using the balls of your feet, focusing on ankle extension.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o sled aparelho para a 45-degree ângulo.
Posicione os pés no sled platform com as pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Empurre o sled platform longe de você por estendendo seu tornozelos e calves.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o sled platform de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: sled 45° leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat and footplate of the sled machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your legs, keeping your heels on the footplate.
Continue pushing until your legs are almost fully extended, but without locking your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the footplate back towards your body by bending your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled 45° leg press is a compound lower body exercise performed on a sled machine. It primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The exercise involves pushing a weighted footplate away from the body while seated at a 45-degree angle, making it a popular choice for building lower body strength.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o seat e footplate do sled aparelho para a comfortable posição.
Sente-se no sled aparelho com as costas contra o backrest e os pés na largura dos ombros no footplate.
Pegada as manoplas no lados do seat por stability.
Empurre o footplate longe do corpo por estendendo as pernas, mantendo seus calcanhares no footplate.
Continue empurrando até as pernas estão almost totalmente estendidos, but sem travar os joelhos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente o footplate de volta em direção ao corpo flexionando os joelhos.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: sled 45° leg wide press
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the foot platform.
Position your feet wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push against the foot platform to extend your legs and straighten your knees.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bend your knees to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled 45° leg wide press is a compound lower body exercise performed on a sled machine set at a 45-degree angle. It targets the glutes primarily, with significant involvement from the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The wide stance emphasizes the glutes and inner thighs more than a standard leg press.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o sled aparelho para a 45-degree ângulo.
Sente-se no sled aparelho com as costas contra o apoio e os pés no pé platform.
Posição os pés wider than na largura dos ombros.
Empurre contra o pé platform para estenda as pernas e straighten os joelhos.
Faça uma breve pausa no end do movimento, em seguida lentamente flexione os joelhos para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: sled closer hack squat
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight and position yourself with your back against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, toes slightly pointed outwards.
Grip the handles on the sides of the machine for stability.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to extend your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled closer hack squat is a lower body exercise performed on a sled machine, primarily targeting the glutes while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves squatting with your back against a pad and feet on a platform, moving the weight by extending and flexing the knees and hips.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o sled aparelho para a comfortable peso e posição yourself com as costas contra o apoio.
Posicione os pés na largura dos ombros no platform, pontas dos pés levemente apontados levemente para fora.
Pegada as manoplas no lados do aparelho por stability.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente desça o corpo flexionando os joelhos e o quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Continue descendo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão ou levemente abaixo.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre pelos calcanhares para estenda as pernas e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: sled forward angled calf raise
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight and position yourself on the machine with your toes on the platform and your heels hanging off.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the machine for support.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels as high as possible, pushing against the resistance of the sled.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled forward angled calf raise is a resistance exercise performed on a sled machine, targeting the calf muscles. The movement involves raising and lowering the heels while the toes remain on the platform, using the sled machine for added resistance.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o sled aparelho para a comfortable peso e posição yourself no aparelho com as pontas dos pés no platform e os calcanhares livres para fora.
Posicione as mãos nas manoplas ou o lados do aparelho por support.
Contraia as panturrilhas e lentamente eleve os calcanhares as alto as possible, empurrando contra o resistance do sled.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente os calcanhares de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Panturrilha Inclinada no Leg Press / Trenó

name: sled hack squat
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable position for your height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, toes slightly pointed outwards.
Hold onto the handles or bars for stability.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to raise your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled hack squat is a lower body strength exercise performed on a sled machine. It primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The movement involves squatting down with the support of the sled machine, which helps guide the motion and provides stability.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o sled aparelho para a comfortable posição por seu altura.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros no platform, pontas dos pés levemente apontados levemente para fora.
Segure-se nas manoplas ou bars por stability.
Desça o corpo flexionando os joelhos e o quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta e peito estufado.
Continue descendo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão ou levemente abaixo.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre pelos calcanhares para eleve o corpo de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: sled lying squat
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Lie on your back on the sled machine with your feet on the footplate.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly angled outwards.
Grip the handles of the sled machine for stability.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Push through your heels and extend your legs to lift the sled.
Lower the sled back down by bending your knees and hips.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled lying squat is a lower body exercise performed on a sled machine, targeting the glutes as the primary muscle group. It also engages the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The movement involves lying on your back, pushing the sled upward with your legs, and then lowering it back down in a controlled manner.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o sled aparelho para a comfortable peso.
Deite-se de costas no sled aparelho com os pés no footplate.
Posição os pés na largura dos ombros e levemente angled outwards.
Pegada as manoplas do sled aparelho por stability.
Contraia os glúteos e core muscles.
Empurre pelos calcanhares e estenda as pernas para levante o sled.
Desça o sled de volta para baixo flexionando os joelhos e o quadril.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith back shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms straight and allow the barbell to hang in front of your thighs.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith back shrug is a strength exercise targeting the trapezius muscles, performed using a smith machine. It involves lifting the shoulders straight up towards the ears while holding a barbell, focusing on squeezing the traps at the top of the movement.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha os braços estendidos e allow a barra para hang em frente a suas coxas.
Levante os ombros reto para cima em direção a seu ears, contraindo seu traps no topo.
Segure por um instante, em seguida desça os ombros de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith behind neck press
instructions: Adjust the seat height of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder level.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Lower the bar down to the back of your neck, keeping your elbows pointing forward.
Press the bar up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith behind neck press is a shoulder exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the deltoids with secondary emphasis on the triceps and upper back. The movement involves pressing a barbell from behind the neck to overhead, requiring good shoulder mobility and stability.
instructions_pt: Atenção Biomecânica: este exercício exige extrema mobilidade de ombros e projeta a cervical à frente, aumentando o risco de impacto subacromial. Dê preferência à execução no plano escapular ou limite a descida até a altura das orelhas. Ajuste a altura do banco do aparelho Smith de modo que a barra esteja na altura dos ombros.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Levante a barra do suporte e dê um passo de volta, mantendo a stable stance.
Desça a barra para baixo para o de volta do pescoço, mantendo seus cotovelos pointing para a frente.
Empurre a barra para cima acima da cabeça até os braços estão totalmente estendidos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento Atrás da Nuca no Smith

name: smith bench press
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to chest level.
Lie flat on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the bar touches your chest.
Push the bar back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith bench press is a chest exercise performed on a smith machine, which provides a guided bar path for pressing movements. It primarily targets the pectorals, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. The smith machine offers additional stability compared to a free-weight bench press, making it accessible for those with less experience or those seeking a safer alternative to heavy pressing.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o altura do aparelho Smith bar até a altura do peito.
Deite-se apoiado no banco com os pés firmly planted no chão.
Pegada a barra com uma pegada pronada um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Unrack a barra e desça o peso em direção ao peitoral, mantendo os cotovelos fechados.
Faça uma breve pausa quando a barra tocar o peitoral.
Empurre a barra de volta para cima à posição inicial, totalmente estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith bent knee good morning
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to raise your torso back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith bent knee good morning is a lower body exercise performed on a Smith machine. It primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. The movement involves hinging at the hips with a slight knee bend, lowering the torso while keeping the back straight, and then returning to the starting position.
instructions_pt: Comece em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Posicione a barra através de seu upper de volta, apoiando o peso em seu traps.
Flexione levemente os joelhos e incline o tronco à frente a partir do quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Desça o tronco até o peso está paralelo ao chão, feeling a alongamento em seu hamstrings.
Contraia os glúteos e hamstrings para eleve o tronco de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Bom Dia no Smith com Joelhos Semiflexionados

name: smith chair squat
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to a comfortable position.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Place the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith chair squat is a lower body exercise performed using a smith machine. It primarily targets the quadriceps, with secondary emphasis on the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. The guided bar path of the smith machine provides stability, making it suitable for those developing squat technique or seeking a safer alternative to free-weight squats.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o altura do aparelho Smith bar para a comfortable posição.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés levemente turned para fora.
Posicione a barra através de seu upper de volta, apoiando o peso em seu traps.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu peito estufado enquanto desce lentamente o corpo flexionando os joelhos e o quadril.
Continue descendo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão, ou as baixo ao can comfortably go.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith close-grip bench press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith close-grip bench press is a compound exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the triceps with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It involves pressing a barbell with a close grip, which increases triceps activation.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no banco com os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure a barra com pegada fechada, levemente narrower than na largura dos ombros.
Desça a barra em direção ao peitoral, mantendo os cotovelos junto ao corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre a barra de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Supino com Pegada Fechada no Smith

name: smith deadlift
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Bend at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight and chest up, and grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lift the bar by extending your hips and knees, keeping the bar close to your body.
Stand up straight, fully extending your hips and knees.
Lower the bar back down by bending at the hips and knees, maintaining control and keeping your back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith deadlift is a compound lower body exercise performed using a smith machine. It primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings, quadriceps, and lower back. The smith machine provides a guided bar path, which can help with stability and form for those learning the deadlift movement.
instructions_pt: Set para cima o aparelho Smith com a barra em quadril altura.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés pointing levemente para fora.
Flexione no quadril e joelhos, mantendo a coluna ereta e peito estufado, e pegada a barra com uma pegada pronada um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e levante a barra por estendendo o quadril e joelhos, mantendo o bar junto ao corpo.
Fique em pé ereto, totalmente estendendo o quadril e joelhos.
Desça a barra de volta para baixo flexionando o quadril e os joelhos, mantendo o controle e mantendo a coluna ereta.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith decline bench press
instructions: Adjust the decline bench to the desired angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith decline bench press is a chest exercise performed on a decline bench using a smith machine. It primarily targets the pectoral muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. The smith machine provides guided movement, making it safer and more stable than a free-weight decline bench press.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o decline banco para o desejado ângulo.
Deite-se no banco com os pés travado sob o pé apoios.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Unrack a barra e desça o peso lentamente em direção ao peitoral, mantendo os cotovelos fechados.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre a barra de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith decline reverse-grip press
instructions: Adjust the smith machine to a decline position.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith decline reverse-grip press is a chest exercise performed on a smith machine in a decline position, using a reverse (underhand) grip to target the lower pectorals and engage the triceps and shoulders.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho Smith para a decline posição.
Deite-se no banco com os pés travado sob o pé apoios.
Segure a barra com a inverta pegada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Unrack a barra e desça o peso em direção ao peitoral, mantendo os cotovelos fechados.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre a barra de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Supino Declinado no Smith com Pegada Invertida

name: smith hack squat
instructions: Adjust the barbell on the smith machine to an appropriate height for your body.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed outwards.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper traps and shoulders.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you unrack the barbell.
Take a step back and position your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Continue descending until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith hack squat is a lower body exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the glutes as the primary muscle group, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves squatting with the barbell resting on the upper traps and shoulders, providing stability and support for the movement.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a barra no aparelho Smith para an appropriate altura pelo corpo.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés levemente apontados levemente para fora.
Posição yourself sob a barra, apoiando o peso em seu upper traps e ombros.
Segure a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu peito estufado ao unrack a barra.
Take a dê um passo de volta e posição os pés levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Flexione os joelhos e desça o corpo para baixo, mantendo seu peito estufado e de volta reto.
Continue descending até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão ou levemente abaixo.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo e empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith hip raise
instructions: Position yourself on the smith machine with your back against the pad and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and glutes, then push through your heels to raise your hips off the ground.
Continue lifting until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith hip raise is an exercise performed on a smith machine that primarily targets the abdominal muscles, with secondary emphasis on the glutes and hamstrings. It involves raising the hips off the ground while keeping the body aligned, engaging the core and lower body.
instructions_pt: Posição yourself no aparelho Smith com as costas contra o apoio e os pés na largura dos ombros.
Posicione as mãos na barra, levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e glutes, em seguida empurre pelos calcanhares para eleve o quadril do chão.
Continue levantando até o corpo forms a linha reta dos joelhos para os ombros.
Segure por um instante no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o quadril de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith incline bench press
instructions: Adjust the bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Sit on the bench with your back flat against the pad and feet firmly on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your upper chest, keeping your elbows slightly tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith incline bench press is a chest exercise performed on a smith machine with the bench set at a 30-45 degree incline. It primarily targets the upper pectorals, with secondary emphasis on the shoulders and triceps. The smith machine provides stability, making it accessible for those with less experience, but still requires proper form and control.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o banco para a 30-45 degree incline.
Sente-se no banco com as costas apoiado contra o apoio e pés firmly no chão.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Unrack a barra e desça o peso lentamente em direção a seu peitoral superior, mantendo seus cotovelos levemente tucked em.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre a barra de volta para cima à posição inicial, totalmente estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith incline reverse-grip press
instructions: Adjust the seat of the smith machine to a comfortable incline angle.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip that is slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the bar is just above your chest.
Push the bar back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith incline reverse-grip press is a chest exercise performed on a smith machine with an incline bench. It targets the pectoral muscles using a reverse (underhand) grip, which also engages the triceps and shoulders. The smith machine provides stability, but the reverse grip and incline angle require good coordination and some experience.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o seat do aparelho Smith para a comfortable incline ângulo.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada that está levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Unrack a barra e desça o peso lentamente em direção ao peitoral, mantendo os cotovelos fechados.
Faça uma breve pausa quando a barra estiver just acima o peitoral.
Empurre a barra de volta para cima à posição inicial, totalmente estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Supino Inclinado no Smith com Pegada Invertida

name: smith incline shoulder raises
instructions: Adjust the smith machine to an incline position.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Raise the barbell up towards the ceiling, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Smith incline shoulder raises target the serratus anterior and are performed on a smith machine. The movement involves raising the barbell upwards while standing at an incline, focusing on shoulder and upper chest engagement.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho Smith para an incline posição.
Fique de frente para o aparelho com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e core engaged.
Eleve a barra para cima em direção ao ceiling, leading com os cotovelos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat and footplate of the smith machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grasp the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push the footplate away from you by extending your legs, keeping your back against the backrest.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position.
Slowly bend your knees and lower the footplate back towards you, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith leg press is a lower body exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the glutes with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves pressing a footplate away from the body while seated, using the legs to extend and flex at the knees and hips.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o seat e footplate do aparelho Smith para a comfortable posição.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o backrest e os pés na largura dos ombros no footplate.
Segure as manoplas ou lados do aparelho por stability.
Empurre o footplate longe de você por estendendo as pernas, mantendo seu de volta contra o backrest.
Faça uma breve pausa no totalmente estendidos posição.
Lentamente flexione os joelhos e desça o footplate de volta em direção a você, retornando à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith narrow row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your chest up as you pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith narrow row is a machine-based rowing exercise targeting the upper back, performed with a narrow grip to emphasize the upper back muscles and rear deltoids. It is performed on a Smith machine, which provides guided movement for added stability.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas com pegada pronada, levemente narrower than na largura dos ombros.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e seu peito estufado ao puxe as manoplas em direção ao corpo, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no pico do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente as manoplas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Remada com Pegada Fechada no Smith

name: smith rear delt row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged as you pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith rear delt row is a machine-based exercise targeting the rear deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the trapezius, rhomboids, and biceps. It involves pulling a bar towards your chest while keeping your chest against a pad, focusing on squeezing the shoulder blades together.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com o peitoral contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído ao puxe as manoplas em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente as manoplas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith reverse calf raises
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
Stand facing the bar with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the bar for support, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith reverse calf raises is a lower leg exercise performed on a smith machine, primarily targeting the calves and secondarily engaging the hamstrings. The movement involves raising and lowering the heels while standing on a step, using the smith machine bar for support.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho Smith bar para a altura logo abaixo os ombros.
Fique de frente para a barra com os pés na largura do quadril e pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Posicione o balls dos pés no edge da dê um passo ou platform, com os calcanhares livres para fora.
Segure-se na barra por support, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Eleve os calcanhares as alto as possible, levantando o corpo peso no balls dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith reverse-grip press
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to chest level.
Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back and position yourself with a slight bend in your knees.
Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the exercise.
Lower the bar towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith reverse-grip press is a chest exercise performed on a smith machine using a reverse (underhand) grip. This variation targets the upper chest and also engages the triceps and shoulders. The smith machine provides stability, making it suitable for those looking to focus on form and muscle activation.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o altura do aparelho Smith bar até a altura do peito.
Fique de frente para a barra com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Dê um passo de volta e posição yourself com a slight flexione nos joelhos.
Mantenha seu peito estufado e core engaged throughout o exercise.
Desça a barra em direção ao peitoral, mantendo os cotovelos fechados.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre a barra de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Supino Reto no Smith com Pegada Invertida

name: smith seated shoulder press
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that the handles are at shoulder level.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and lift them off the supports, extending your arms fully.
Lower the handles down to shoulder level, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Press the handles up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith seated shoulder press is a machine-based exercise targeting the deltoid muscles of the shoulders. It provides stability and support, making it suitable for those looking to build shoulder strength with reduced risk of losing balance. The movement also engages the triceps and upper back as secondary muscles.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco de modo que o manoplas estão na altura dos ombros.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas com pegada pronada e levante os pesos do supports, estendendo os braços totalmente.
Desça as manoplas para baixo até a altura dos ombros, mantendo os cotovelos levemente flexionados.
Empurre as manoplas para cima acima da cabeça até os braços estão totalmente estendidos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente as manoplas de volta para baixo até a altura dos ombros.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento para Ombros Sentado no Smith

name: smith shoulder press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and position it at shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith shoulder press is a compound exercise performed on a smith machine that targets the deltoid muscles of the shoulders. It provides stability for the lifter, making it easier to focus on pressing strength and muscle development.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho Smith com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Levante a barra do suporte e posição o peso na altura dos ombros, com os cotovelos flexionado e palmas voltadas para a frente.
Empurre a barra para cima até os braços estão totalmente estendidos acima da cabeça.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta para baixo até a altura dos ombros.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulders up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith shrug is an exercise performed on a Smith machine to target the trapezius muscles. It involves lifting the shoulders towards the ears while holding a barbell, focusing on squeezing the traps at the top of the movement.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha os braços estendidos e os ombros relaxed.
Levante os ombros para cima em direção a seu ears, contraindo seu traps no topo.
Segure por um instante, em seguida desça lentamente os ombros de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith single leg split squat
instructions: Stand in front of the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one foot behind you on a bench or step, with your toes pointing forward.
Hold onto the smith machine bar for stability.
Bend your front knee and lower your body down into a lunge position, keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The smith single leg split squat is a lower body exercise performed using a smith machine. It targets the quadriceps while also engaging the glutes and hamstrings. The exercise requires balance and unilateral strength, as one leg is elevated behind you on a bench or step.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé em frente ao aparelho Smith com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Posicione um pé atrás você em um banco ou dê um passo, com as pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Segure-se no aparelho Smith bar por stability.
Flexione seu frente joelho e desça o corpo para baixo em um lunge posição, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre através de seu frente calcanhar para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de perna.

name: smith sprint lunge
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step back with your right foot and place it on the barbell, resting the top of your foot on the bar.
Bend your left knee and lower your body into a lunge position, keeping your back straight.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping back with your left foot.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith sprint lunge is a lower body exercise performed using a smith machine. It targets the glutes primarily, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The movement involves stepping back and placing one foot on the barbell, then performing a lunge, which challenges balance, strength, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Set para cima o aparelho Smith com a barra em quadril altura.
Fique de costas para o aparelho com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Dê um passo de volta com seu pé direito e posicione o peso na barra, apoiando o topo do pé na barra.
Flexione seu joelho esquerdo e desça o corpo em um lunge posição, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Empurre através de seu calcanhar esquerdo para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado, stepping de volta com seu pé esquerdo.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith squat
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at an appropriate height for your squat.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper traps and shoulders.
Grip the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and unrack the barbell, stepping back to clear the rack.
Keeping your chest up and back straight, initiate the squat by bending at the hips and knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith squat is a lower body exercise performed using a smith machine. It primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The guided bar path of the smith machine provides stability, making it suitable for those learning proper squat form or looking to focus on muscle activation without balancing a free barbell.
instructions_pt: Set para cima o aparelho Smith com a barra em an appropriate altura por seu squat.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés levemente turned para fora.
Posição yourself sob a barra, apoiando o peso em seu upper traps e ombros.
Pegada a barra com pegada aberta, levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e unrack a barra, stepping de volta para clear o rack.
Mantendo seu peito estufado e de volta reto, initiate o squat flexionando o quadril e os joelhos.
Desça o corpo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão ou levemente abaixo.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre com força pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith standing back wrist curl
instructions: Stand facing the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your body.
Slowly curl your wrists upwards, bringing the barbell towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith standing back wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, performed using a smith machine. It involves curling the wrists upwards while holding the barbell with an overhand grip, focusing on forearm strength.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para o aparelho Smith com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada, mãos na largura dos ombros.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e os cotovelos junto ao corpo.
Lentamente flexione os punhos upwards, aproximando a barra em direção ao corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Rosca Punho em Pé no Smith

name: smith standing behind head military press
instructions: Adjust the seat height of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder level.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Position the bar behind your head, resting on your upper traps.
Keep your core engaged and your chest lifted throughout the exercise.
Press the bar overhead by extending your arms, fully straightening them.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith standing behind head military press is a shoulder exercise performed using a smith machine. The movement targets the deltoids and involves pressing a barbell from behind the head to overhead while standing.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco do aparelho Smith de modo que a barra esteja na altura dos ombros.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Levante a barra do suporte e dê um passo de volta, mantendo a stable stance.
Posição a barra atrás da cabeça, apoiando em seu upper traps.
Mantenha o abdômen contraído e o peitoral lifted throughout o exercise.
Empurre a barra acima da cabeça por estendendo os braços, totalmente estendendo os pesos.
Faça uma pausa breve no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento Militar em Pé Atrás da Nuca no Smith

name: smith standing leg calf raise
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to stand with your feet flat on the ground and your shoulders under the bar.
Position yourself under the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on the bar for stability.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith standing leg calf raise is a lower leg exercise performed using a smith machine. It primarily targets the calves, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and glutes. The movement involves raising the heels to stand on the toes, then lowering back down, using the smith machine for stability and added resistance.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho Smith bar para a altura that allows você para Fique em pé com os pés apoiado no chão e os ombros sob a barra.
Posição yourself sob a barra com os pés na largura dos ombros e as pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Posicione as mãos na barra por stability.
Contraia as panturrilhas e lentamente eleve os calcanhares do chão, levantando o corpo para cima onto as pontas dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação de Panturrilha em Pé no Smith

name: smith standing military press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it down to shoulder level, with your palms facing forward.
Press the barbell upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The Smith standing military press is a compound exercise targeting the deltoid muscles of the shoulders, performed using a Smith machine for added stability. It also engages the triceps and upper back as secondary muscles. The fixed bar path of the Smith machine can make the movement more accessible for those learning the overhead press, but it still requires good shoulder mobility and core stability.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Levante a barra do suporte e aproxime o peso para baixo até a altura dos ombros, com suas palmas voltadas para a frente.
Empurre a barra para cima até os braços estão totalmente estendidos acima da cabeça.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta para baixo até a altura dos ombros.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento Militar em Pé no Smith

name: smith upright row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the smith machine.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the barbell up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith upright row is a shoulder exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the deltoids and also engaging the traps and biceps. It involves pulling a barbell upwards towards the chin while keeping the elbows higher than the wrists.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, virado para o aparelho Smith.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha as costas retas e o abdômen contraído.
Puxe a barra para cima em direção ao peitoral inferior, leading com os cotovelos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: snatch pull
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the ground in front of you.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower into a squat position, gripping the barbell with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and chest up as you drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.
As the barbell reaches hip level, explosively pull it upwards, shrugging your shoulders and pulling your elbows high and to the sides.
As the barbell reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath it, pulling yourself into a deep squat position.
Catch the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended and your knees bent.
Stand up by extending your hips and knees, keeping the barbell overhead.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The snatch pull is a compound Olympic weightlifting movement that develops explosive power and strength in the lower body, particularly targeting the quads, hamstrings, and glutes. It requires coordination, balance, and proper technique to perform safely and effectively.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e a barra no chão à sua frente.
Flexione os joelhos e incline o tronco no quadril para desça em posição de agachamento, gripping a barra com pegada pronada.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e peito estufado ao empurre com força pelos calcanhares para levante a barra do chão, estendendo o quadril e joelhos.
As a barra reaches quadril altura, explosively puxe o peso upwards, shrugging os ombros e puxando os cotovelos alto e para o lados.
As a barra reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath o peso, puxando yourself em um deep squat posição.
Catch a barra acima da cabeça com os braços totalmente estendidos e os joelhos flexionado.
Fique em pé para cima por estendendo o quadril e joelhos, mantendo o barra acima da cabeça.
Desça a barra de volta à posição inicial por reversing o movimento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: spell caster
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the waist, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arm with the dumbbell towards the opposite foot, rotating your torso as you do so.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The spell caster is a rotational core exercise performed with a dumbbell, targeting the abs and obliques. It involves hinging at the waist and rotating the torso while moving the dumbbell from side to side.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure um halter em uma mão.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e incline o tronco para a frente no waist, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Estenda o braço com o halter em direção ao pé oposto, girando o tronco ao do so.
Retorne à posição inicial e Repita do outro lado.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: spider crawl push up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bring your right knee towards your right elbow, keeping it off the ground.
As you bring your right knee back, simultaneously lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the starting position and repeat with your left knee towards your left elbow.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The spider crawl push up is a challenging bodyweight exercise that combines a push-up with a dynamic knee drive, targeting the glutes, core, chest, and shoulders. It requires coordination, strength, and stability.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros e os pés juntos.
Aproxime seu joelho direito em direção a seu cotovelo direito, mantendo o peso do chão.
Ao aproxime seu joelho direito de volta, simultaneamente desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos.
Empurre de volta para cima à posição inicial e repita com seu joelho esquerdo em direção a seu cotovelo esquerdo.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: squat jerk
instructions: Start with the barbell resting on your shoulders, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your legs and push the barbell overhead.
As the barbell reaches its peak, quickly drop into a split position, with one foot forward and one foot back.
Catch the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended and your back knee slightly touching the ground.
Stand up from the split position, bringing your feet back together.
Lower the barbell back to your shoulders and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
