Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the bar towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement.
Slowly release the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable upper row is a compound exercise targeting the upper back, performed using a cable machine and a straight bar. It involves pulling the bar towards the upper chest, engaging the upper back, biceps, and shoulders.
instructions_pt: Prenda a reto bar para a máquina de polia na altura do peito.
Fique de frente para o aparelho com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha as costas retas e o abdômen contraído.
Puxe a barra em direção a seu peitoral superior, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento.
Lentamente solte a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: cable wide grip rear pulldown behind neck
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the pulldown bar is at a height above your head.
Sit down on the seat and grab the pulldown bar with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your chest up as you lean back slightly.
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable wide grip rear pulldown behind neck is a strength exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) and also engaging the biceps, rhomboids, and rear deltoids. It involves pulling a cable bar behind the neck while seated, requiring good shoulder mobility and control.
instructions_pt: Atenção Biomecânica: este exercício exige extrema mobilidade de ombros e projeta a cervical à frente, aumentando o risco de impacto subacromial. Dê preferência à execução no plano escapular ou limite a descida até a altura das orelhas. Ajuste o máquina de polia de modo que o pulldown bar está em um altura acima da cabeça.
Sente-se para baixo no seat e grab o pulldown bar com a wide pegada pronada.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e seu peito estufado ao incline de volta levemente.
Puxe a barra para baixo em direção a seu peitoral superior, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente a barra de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Puxada Alta Pegada Aberta Atrás da Nuca na Polia

name: chin-up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing towards you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The chin-up is a bodyweight exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi (lats) and also works the biceps and forearms. It involves pulling your body up towards a bar with an underhand grip until your chin clears the bar.
instructions_pt: Fique suspenso na barra fixa com suas palmas voltadas para você e suas mãos na largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, leading com o peitoral.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra.
Faça uma pausa no topo e retorne o corpo controladamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: close grip chin-up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with your palms facing towards you and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your feet off the ground.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The close grip chin-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lats, with significant involvement of the biceps and forearms. It requires pulling your body up to a bar with a close, underhand grip, emphasizing upper body strength.
instructions_pt: Grab o puxe-para cima bar com suas palmas voltadas para você e suas mãos na largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso na barra com os braços totalmente estendidos e os pés do chão.
Contraia as costas muscles e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, mantendo os cotovelos junto ao corpo.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra.
Faça uma pausa no topo e retorne o corpo controladamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell lying rear delt row
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Extend your arms straight down towards the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Engaging your back muscles, lift the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying rear delt row targets the upper back and rear deltoids, performed while lying face down on a bench and rowing dumbbells upward.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de bruços na apoiado banco com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para inwards.
Estenda os braços reto para baixo em direção ao chão, mantendo a slight flexione nos cotovelos.
Contraindo as costas muscles, levante os halteres para cima em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os halteres à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Remada Deitada no Banco com Barra

name: dumbbell palm rotational bent over row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Let your arms hang straight down, palms facing your body.
Engage your core and pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you pull the dumbbells up, rotate your palms so they face away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, rotating your palms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell palm rotational bent over row is a compound exercise targeting the upper back, with additional engagement of the biceps and forearms. The rotational component adds a coordination challenge and increases muscle activation.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando um halter em cada mão com pegada pronada.
Flexione para a frente no quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta e os joelhos levemente flexionados.
Mantenha os braços hang reto para baixo, palmas voltadas para o corpo.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe os halteres para cima em direção ao peitoral, mantendo os cotovelos junto ao corpo.
Ao puxe os halteres para cima, gire seu palms so they face longe do corpo.
Aproxime bem as escápulas no topo do movimento.
Lentamente desça os halteres de volta à posição inicial, girando seu palms de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell reverse grip incline bench one arm row
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Place a dumbbell on the floor next to the bench.
Stand facing the bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the waist and place your left knee and left hand on the bench for support.
Pick up the dumbbell with your right hand using a reverse grip (palm facing down).
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with your left arm.
description: The dumbbell reverse grip incline bench one arm row is a strength exercise targeting the upper back, performed on an incline bench using a single dumbbell and a reverse grip.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o banco inclinado a um ângulo de 45 graus.
Posicione um halter no chão next para o banco.
Fique de frente para o banco com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Flexione no waist e posicione seu joelho esquerdo e mão esquerda no banco por support.
Pick para cima o halter com seu mão direita using a inverta pegada (palm virado para para baixo).
Mantenha as costas retas e o abdômen contraído.
Puxe o halter para cima em direção ao peitoral, mantendo seu cotovelo junto ao corpo.
Contraia as costas muscles no topo do movimento.
Desça o halter de volta à posição inicial na controlled manner.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Troque lados e repita o exercise com seu braço esquerdo.

name: dumbbell reverse grip incline bench two arm row
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your chest against the backrest and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip.
Lean forward and let your arms hang straight down, fully extended.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell reverse grip incline bench two arm row is a strength exercise targeting the upper back, performed on an incline bench with dumbbells using an underhand grip. It also engages the biceps and forearms.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o banco inclinado a um ângulo de 45 graus.
Sente-se no banco com o peitoral contra o backrest e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure um halter em cada mão com pegada supinada.
Incline para a frente e Mantenha os braços hang reto para baixo, totalmente estendidos.
Puxe os halteres para cima em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os halteres à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: exercise ball alternating arm ups
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing inwards and your arms extended down by your sides.
Engage your core and slowly lift one arm up towards your shoulder, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise targets the latissimus dorsi (lats) and involves alternating arm lifts while seated on a stability ball, engaging the core and shoulders for balance and control.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no bola suíça com os pés apoiado no chão e as costas reto.
Segure um halter em cada mão com suas palmas voltadas para inwards e seus braços estendidos para baixo por seu lados.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente levante um braço para cima em direção ao ombro, mantendo seu cotovelo levemente flexionados.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o braço de volta à posição inicial.
Repita o movimento com o outro braço.
Continue alternando os braços pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação Alternada de Braços na Bola Suíça

name: exercise ball back extension with arms extended
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and lie face down on top of it, with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall for stability.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, with your palms facing down.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, keeping your back straight and your neck in line with your spine.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The exercise ball back extension with arms extended targets the spinal erectors and helps strengthen the lower back, glutes, and hamstrings. It requires balance and core engagement due to the instability of the ball and the extended arm position.
instructions_pt: Posicione o bola suíça no chão e Deite-se de bruços em topo do peso, com o quadril apoiando no bola e os pés contra a wall por stability.
Estenda os braços estendidos à sua frente, com suas palmas voltadas para baixo.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente levante o tronco da bola, mantendo a coluna ereta e o pescoço alinhados com a coluna.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Extensão Lombar na Bola Suíça com Braços Estendidos

name: exercise ball back extension with hands behind head
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and lie face down on top of it with your hips resting on the ball.
Position your feet against a wall or other stable surface for support.
Cross your arms behind your head, with your hands touching the back of your head.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line from your head to your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise targets the spinal erectors and involves performing back extensions while lying face down on a stability ball, with hands placed behind the head for increased difficulty. It also engages the glutes and hamstrings as secondary muscles.
instructions_pt: Posicione o bola suíça no chão e Deite-se de bruços em topo do peso com o quadril apoiando no bola.
Posição os pés contra a wall ou outro stable surface por support.
Cruze os braços atrás da cabeça, com as mãos tocando o de volta da cabeça.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente levante o tronco da bola, estendendo as costas até o corpo forms a linha reta da cabeça para o quadril.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente o tronco de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Extensão Lombar na Bola Suíça com Mãos na Nuca

name: exercise ball back extension with knees off ground
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and lie face down on top of it, with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall for stability.
Position your hands behind your head or crossed over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise targets the spinal erectors and requires you to perform a back extension while balancing your hips on a stability ball with your knees off the ground. It challenges your core, glutes, and hamstrings, and requires balance and coordination.
instructions_pt: Posicione o bola suíça no chão e Deite-se de bruços em topo do peso, com o quadril apoiando no bola e os pés contra a wall por stability.
Posição as mãos atrás da cabeça ou crossed sobre o peitoral.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente levante o tronco da bola, estendendo as costas até o corpo forms a linha reta da cabeça para os calcanhares.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Extensão Lombar na Bola Suíça com Joelhos Elevados

name: exercise ball back extension with rotation
instructions: Start by lying face down on the stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips and legs stable.
Return to the center and repeat the rotation to the other side.
Lower your upper body back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The exercise ball back extension with rotation is a movement that targets the spinal erectors and involves extending the back while lying face down on a stability ball, then adding a rotational component to engage the obliques and improve core stability.
instructions_pt: Comece lying face para baixo no bola suíça com o quadril apoiando no bola e os pés firmly planted no chão.
Posicione as mãos atrás da cabeça ou cruze os pesos sobre o peitoral.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente levante o tronco da bola, estendendo as costas até o corpo forms a linha reta da cabeça para os calcanhares.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida lentamente gire o tronco para um lado, mantendo seus quadris e pernas stable.
Retorne para o center e repita o rotation para o outro lado.
Desça o tronco de volta à posição inicial e Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições.
name_pt: Extensão Lombar na Bola Suíça com Rotação

name: exercise ball hug
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold the stability ball with both hands, hugging it close to your chest.
Engage your core muscles and slowly lean back, keeping your back straight and your feet planted on the ground.
Continue leaning back until you feel a stretch in your back muscles.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The exercise ball hug is a gentle movement performed on a stability ball, focusing on stretching and mobilizing the spine while engaging the core. It is suitable for improving flexibility and mobility in the back, with secondary engagement of the shoulders and chest.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no bola suíça com os pés apoiado no chão e as costas reto.
Segure o bola suíça com ambas as mãos, hugging o peso próximo ao peitoral.
Contraia os músculos do core e lentamente incline de volta, mantendo a coluna ereta e os pés planted no chão.
Continue inclinando de volta até você sentir um alongamento em seu de volta muscles.
Sustente a posição pela few seconds, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: exercise ball lat stretch
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and extend your arm straight up overhead.
Slowly lean to the opposite side, feeling a stretch in your lat muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
description: The exercise ball lat stretch is a flexibility movement that targets the latissimus dorsi muscles. It involves sitting on a stability ball and leaning to the side while holding a dumbbell overhead, providing a deep stretch to the lats and engaging the shoulders and triceps as secondary muscles.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na bola suíça com os pés apoiado no chão e as costas reto.
Segure um halter em uma mão e estenda o braço reto para cima acima da cabeça.
Lentamente incline para o lado oposto, feeling a alongamento em seu lat muscle.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds, em seguida retorne à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado.

name: exercise ball lower back stretch (pyramid)
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Slowly walk your feet forward, rolling the ball down your back until your lower back is resting on the ball.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lower your upper body towards the ground, allowing your lower back to stretch over the ball.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A stretch performed on a stability ball to target the lower back and lats, also engaging the glutes and hamstrings. It involves rolling the ball under your lower back and gently extending over it to stretch the muscles.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no bola suíça com os pés apoiado no chão e os joelhos flexionado a 90 graus.
Lentamente walk os pés para a frente, rolling o bola para baixo as costas até seu desça de volta está apoiando no bola.
Posicione as mãos atrás da cabeça ou cruze os pesos sobre o peitoral.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente desça o tronco em direção ao chão, allowing seu desça de volta para alongamento sobre o bola.
Segure o alongamento pela few seconds, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Lower Costas Alongamento (pyramid) na Bola Suíça

name: exercise ball lying side lat stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head supported by the stability ball.
Place your top arm on the ball for stability.
Reach your top arm overhead and allow your torso to rotate slightly.
Feel the stretch in your lat muscles on the side of your body.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
description: A stretch performed lying on your side over a stability ball to target the lat muscles, with additional stretching for the shoulders and triceps.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de lado com seu pernas estendidas e a cabeça supported pelo bola suíça.
Posicione seu topo braço no bola por stability.
Alcance seu topo braço acima da cabeça e allow o tronco para gire levemente.
Feel o alongamento em seu lat muscles no lado do corpo.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds, em seguida troque lados e repita.
name_pt: Alongamento Lateral de Dorsais na Bola Suíça

name: exercise ball prone leg raise
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your legs extended and your toes resting on top of the stability ball.
Place your hands on the ground, shoulder-width apart, and engage your core muscles.
Keeping your legs straight, slowly lift them off the ground, using your lower back and glutes to raise them as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The exercise ball prone leg raise is performed by lying face down with your legs extended and toes resting on a stability ball. You lift your legs using your lower back and glutes, targeting the spine and core stabilizers.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de bruços na mat com seu pernas estendidas e as pontas dos pés apoiando em topo do bola suíça.
Posicione as mãos no chão, na largura dos ombros, e contraia os músculos do core.
Mantendo seu pernas reto, lentamente levante os pesos do chão, using seu desça de volta e glutes para eleve os pesos as alto as possible.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente as pernas à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação de Pernas na Bola Suíça

name: ez bar reverse grip bent over row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and hands shoulder-width apart.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up, until your torso is almost parallel to the floor.
Pull the ez barbell towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the ez barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ bar reverse grip bent over row is a compound exercise targeting the upper back, with secondary emphasis on the biceps and forearms. It involves pulling an EZ barbell towards the lower chest while bent over, using an underhand grip.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure o ez barra com pegada supinada, palmas voltadas para cima, e mãos na largura dos ombros.
Flexione para a frente no quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta e peito estufado, até o tronco está almost paralelos ao chão.
Puxe o ez barra em direção a seu desça peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o ez barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: kettlebell two arm row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a kettlebell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the kettlebells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The kettlebell two arm row is a compound exercise targeting the upper back, performed by pulling two kettlebells towards the chest while maintaining a bent-over position.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, joelhos levemente flexionados, e segure a kettlebell em cada mão com suas palmas voltadas para o corpo.
Flexione para a frente no quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Puxe o kettlebells para cima em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o kettlebells de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: kneeling lat stretch
instructions: Kneel on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your toes pointing back.
Extend your arms overhead and interlace your fingers.
Keeping your back straight, slowly lean to the right side, feeling a stretch in your left lat muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the stretch on the left side, leaning to the left and feeling a stretch in your right lat muscle.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The kneeling lat stretch is a bodyweight exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi (lats) and helps improve flexibility and mobility in the upper back and shoulders. It is performed by kneeling, extending the arms overhead, and leaning side to side to stretch each lat muscle.
instructions_pt: Ajoelhe-se no chão com os joelhos na largura do quadril e as pontas dos pés pointing de volta.
Estenda os braços acima da cabeça e interlace seu fingers.
Mantendo a coluna ereta, incline o tronco lentamente para o lado direito até sentir o alongamento na grande dorsal esquerda.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds, em seguida retorne à posição inicial.
Repita o alongamento do lado esquerdo, inclinando-se para a esquerda até sentir o alongamento na grande dorsal direita.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever one arm lateral wide pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handle with an overhand grip and fully extend your arm, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Pull the handle down and across your body towards your opposite hip, squeezing your lat muscle at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return the handle to the starting position, fully extending your arm.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The lever one arm lateral wide pulldown is a machine-based exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi, performed one arm at a time for unilateral strength and muscle development.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com o peitoral contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure a manopla com pegada pronada e totalmente estenda o braço, mantendo a slight flexione no cotovelo.
Puxe a manopla para baixo e através do corpo em direção a seu oposto quadril, contraindo seu lat muscle embaixo no movimento.
Lentamente retorne a manopla à posição inicial, totalmente estendendo o braço.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de lado.
name_pt: Puxada Alta Unilateral na Máquina Articulada

name: lever reverse grip vertical row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate position to ensure proper alignment.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever reverse grip vertical row is a machine-based exercise targeting the upper back, with secondary emphasis on the biceps and forearms. It involves pulling handles with an underhand grip while seated, focusing on squeezing the shoulder blades together.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e footplate posição para ensure proper alignment.
Sente-se no aparelho com o peitoral contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no footplate.
Segure as manoplas com pegada supinada, palmas voltadas para cima.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e contraia o abdômen.
Puxe as manoplas em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente e estenda os braços de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Remada Pegada Supinada na Máquina Articulada

name: lever reverse t-bar row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footplate position on the leverage machine.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever reverse t-bar row is a machine-based exercise targeting the upper back. It involves pulling handles towards the chest while seated, emphasizing scapular retraction and upper back engagement.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e footplate posição no leverage aparelho.
Sente-se no aparelho com o peitoral contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no footplate.
Segure as manoplas com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e contraia o abdômen.
Puxe as manoplas em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente e estenda os braços de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Remada Cavalinho (Barra T) na Máquina Articulada

name: lever seated row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and footrests to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet on the footrests.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement.
Slowly release the handles and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated row is a machine-based exercise targeting the upper back. It involves pulling handles towards the torso while seated, focusing on squeezing the shoulder blades together.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e footrests para a comfortable posição.
Sente-se no aparelho com o peitoral contra o apoio e os pés no footrests.
Segure as manoplas com pegada pronada, na largura dos ombros.
Mantenha as costas retas e o abdômen contraído.
Puxe as manoplas em direção ao corpo, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no pico do movimento.
Lentamente solte as manoplas e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever t-bar reverse grip row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever t-bar reverse grip row is a machine-based exercise targeting the upper back, with secondary emphasis on the biceps and forearms. It involves pulling a lever towards the chest while keeping the chest supported on a pad, promoting upper back strength and muscle development.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com o peitoral contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e contraia o abdômen.
Puxe as manoplas em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente e estenda os braços de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Remada Pegada Supinada na Máquina Articulada

name: lower back curl
instructions: Lie flat on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling your back upwards.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lower back curl is a bodyweight exercise that targets the muscles of the lower back (spine) and also engages the glutes and hamstrings. It involves lying face down and curling the upper body off the ground by contracting the lower back muscles.
instructions_pt: Deite-se apoiado em seu stomach com seu pernas estendidas e os braços por seu lados.
Contraia os glúteos e hamstrings, e lentamente levante o tronco do chão, flexionando as costas upwards.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: medicine ball catch and overhead throw
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball in both hands at chest level.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Explosively extend your hips and legs, while simultaneously throwing the medicine ball overhead.
Release the ball at the top of the movement and catch it on the way down.
Lower your body back into the squat position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The medicine ball catch and overhead throw is a dynamic exercise targeting the lats, shoulders, and core. It involves catching and explosively throwing a medicine ball overhead, combining elements of strength and power.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando a medicine bola em ambos os mãos na altura do peito.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e contraia o abdômen.
Desça o corpo em posição de agachamento, mantendo a coluna ereta e peito estufado.
estenda os quadris com potência e controle e pernas, enquanto simultaneamente throwing o medicine bola acima da cabeça.
Solte o bola no topo do movimento e catch o peso no way para baixo.
Desça o corpo de volta em posição de agachamento posição e Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições.
name_pt: Recepção e Lançamento Acima da Cabeça com Medicine Ball

name: medicine ball overhead slam
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball with both hands above your head.
Engage your core and keep your back straight.
Bend your knees slightly and forcefully slam the medicine ball down to the ground in front of you.
As you slam the ball down, use your entire body to generate power, including your shoulders and core.
Catch the ball on the bounce and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The medicine ball overhead slam is a dynamic exercise that targets the upper back, shoulders, and core by forcefully slamming a medicine ball to the ground from an overhead position. It requires coordination, power, and full-body engagement.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando a medicine bola com ambas as mãos acima da cabeça.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha a coluna ereta.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e forcefully slam o medicine bola para baixo para o chão à sua frente.
Ao slam o bola para baixo, use seu entire corpo para generate power, including os ombros e core.
Catch o bola no bounce e Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições.

name: one arm against wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm straight out in front of you and place your palm against the wall.
Engage your core and lean your body forward, keeping your arm straight and your back flat.
Slowly push against the wall with your palm, activating your lat muscles.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then release and repeat with the other arm.
description: A bodyweight exercise where you stand facing a wall, extend one arm to press against the wall, and engage your lats by pushing, focusing on lat activation and shoulder stability.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a wall com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Estenda um braço estendidos à sua frente e posicione seu palm contra o wall.
Contraia o abdômen e incline o corpo para a frente, mantendo seu braço reto e as costas apoiado.
Lentamente empurre contra o wall com seu palm, activating seu lat muscles.
Sustente a posição pela few seconds, em seguida solte e Repita com o outro braço.
name_pt: Alongamento de Peitoral e Dorsal na Parede Unilateral

name: lever one arm lateral high row
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself facing the machine.
Grasp the handle with one hand and keep your back straight.
Pull the handle towards your body, keeping your elbow close to your side.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement.
Slowly release the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever one arm lateral high row is a machine-based exercise targeting the upper back, with secondary emphasis on the biceps and shoulders. It involves pulling a handle toward the body with one arm, focusing on squeezing the back muscles at the top of the movement.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself virado para o aparelho.
Segure a manopla com uma mão e mantenha a coluna ereta.
Puxe a manopla em direção ao corpo, mantendo seu cotovelo próximo a seu lado.
Contraia as costas muscles no topo do movimento.
Lentamente solte a manopla de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: side lying floor stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your bottom arm extended straight overhead.
Bend your top knee and place your foot on the ground in front of your bottom leg.
Reach your top arm over your head and grab onto something stable, like a wall or a piece of furniture.
Slowly lift your bottom leg off the ground, keeping it straight, until you feel a stretch in your side.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then slowly lower your leg back down.
Repeat on the other side.
description: The side lying floor stretch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the lats, with secondary emphasis on the obliques and glutes. It is performed lying on your side, reaching overhead, and lifting the bottom leg to create a stretch along the side of the body.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de lado com as pernas reto e seu bottom braço estendido em linha reta acima da cabeça.
Flexione seu topo joelho e posicione o pé no chão em frente a seu bottom perna.
Alcance seu topo braço sobre a cabeça e grab onto something stable, like a wall ou a piece de furniture.
Lentamente levante seu bottom perna do chão, mantendo-o reto, até você sentir um alongamento em seu lado.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds, em seguida desça lentamente a perna de volta para baixo.
Repita do outro lado.
name_pt: Alongamento Lateral do Tronco no Chão

name: smith bent over row
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith bent over row is a compound exercise performed using a smith machine. It targets the upper back and also works the biceps and forearms. The exercise involves hinging at the hips, maintaining a straight back, and pulling the bar towards the lower chest.
instructions_pt: Set para cima o aparelho Smith com a barra em quadril altura.
Fique de frente para a barra com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Flexione levemente os joelhos e incline o tronco à frente a partir do quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Puxe a barra em direção a seu desça peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith one arm row
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to waist level.
Stand facing the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Grasp the bar with one hand using an overhand grip, with your palm facing down.
Keep your elbow close to your body and pull the bar towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The smith one arm row is a unilateral back exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the upper back and engaging the biceps and forearms as secondary muscles. It requires stability, coordination, and proper form to execute safely and effectively.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o altura do aparelho Smith bar para waist altura.
Fique de frente para o aparelho Smith com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Flexione levemente os joelhos e incline o tronco à frente a partir do quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Segure a barra com uma mão using uma pegada pronada, com seu palm virado para para baixo.
Mantenha seu cotovelo junto ao corpo e puxe a barra em direção a seu waist, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça a barra lentamente de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e passe para o outro braço.

name: smith reverse grip bent over row
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith reverse grip bent over row is a compound exercise targeting the upper back, performed using a smith machine. It involves pulling a bar with an underhand grip while bent over, focusing on the upper back, biceps, and forearms.
instructions_pt: Set para cima o aparelho Smith com a barra em quadril altura.
Fique de frente para a barra com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Flexione levemente os joelhos e incline o tronco à frente a partir do quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Segure a barra com pegada supinada, mãos na largura dos ombros.
Puxe a barra em direção a seu desça peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Remada Curvada Pegada Supinada no Smith

name: sphinx
instructions: Lie face down on the ground with your forearms flat on the floor, elbows directly under your shoulders.
Engage your core and lift your chest off the ground, keeping your forearms and toes on the floor.
Hold this position for a few seconds, making sure to keep your neck in a neutral position.
Slowly lower your chest back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sphinx exercise is a gentle back extension movement that targets the spine and helps improve flexibility and mobility in the lower back. It is performed lying face down, lifting the chest off the ground while keeping the forearms and toes on the floor.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de bruços no chão com os antebraços apoiado no chão, cotovelos directly sob os ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e levante o peitoral do chão, mantendo seu forearms e pontas dos pés no chão.
Sustente essa posição pela few seconds, making sure para mantenha seu pescoço em posição neutra.
Lentamente desça o peitoral de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: spine stretch
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your hands on the ground behind you, fingers pointing towards your body.
Engage your core and slowly lean back, keeping your back straight.
Continue leaning back until you feel a stretch in your spine.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The spine stretch is a bodyweight exercise that focuses on stretching and mobilizing the spine. It also provides a gentle stretch to the hamstrings and glutes. This movement is performed seated and emphasizes spinal flexibility and posture.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com seu pernas estendidas à sua frente.
Posicione as mãos no chão atrás você, fingers pointing em direção ao corpo.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente incline de volta, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Continue inclinando de volta até você sentir um alongamento em seu spine.
Segure o alongamento pela few seconds, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: standing pelvic tilt
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Place your hands on your hips or let them hang by your sides.
Engage your core muscles and tilt your pelvis forward, pushing your lower back towards the wall behind you.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The standing pelvic tilt is a bodyweight exercise that targets the spine and helps improve core engagement and lower back mobility. It is performed by tilting the pelvis forward while standing, engaging the core and gently mobilizing the lower back.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Posicione as mãos no quadril ou Mantenha os pesos hang por seu lados.
Contraia os músculos do core e tilt seu pelvis para a frente, empurrando seu desça de volta em direção ao wall atrás você.
Sustente a posição pela few seconds, em seguida solte e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: upper back stretch
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Interlace your fingers and rotate your palms away from your body.
Slowly raise your arms overhead, keeping them straight and parallel to each other.
As you raise your arms, squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release and repeat.
description: The upper back stretch is a bodyweight exercise designed to stretch and mobilize the upper back and shoulders. It is performed by extending the arms, interlacing the fingers, and raising the arms overhead while squeezing the shoulder blades together.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Estenda os braços reto à sua frente, paralelos ao chão.
Interlace seu fingers e gire seu palms longe do corpo.
Lentamente eleve os braços acima da cabeça, mantendo-os estendidos e paralelo para cada outro.
Ao eleve os braços, aproxime bem as escápulas.
Segure o alongamento por 15-30 seconds, em seguida solte e repita.

name: upward facing dog
instructions: Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended behind you.
Place your hands on the floor next to your lower ribs, fingers pointing forward.
Press your hands firmly into the floor and straighten your arms, lifting your torso and thighs off the ground.
Roll your shoulders back and down, opening your chest and lifting your gaze towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few breaths, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Upward Facing Dog is a yoga pose that stretches the spine, chest, and shoulders while strengthening the arms and back. It is commonly used to improve spinal mobility and posture.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de bruços no chão com seu pernas estendidas atrás você.
Posicione as mãos no chão next para seu desça ribs, fingers pointing para a frente.
Empurre as mãos firmly no chão e straighten os braços, levantando o tronco e coxas do chão.
Roll os ombros de volta e para baixo, opening o peitoral e levantando seu gaze em direção ao ceiling.
Sustente essa posição pela few breaths, em seguida desça lentamente o corpo de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Postura do Cachorro Olhando para Cima (Yoga)

name: wide grip rear pull-up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with a wide overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The wide grip rear pull-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) and also engaging the biceps and forearms. It requires the user to pull their body up to a bar using a wide overhand grip, emphasizing upper back development.
instructions_pt: Grab o puxe-para cima bar com a wide pegada pronada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso na barra com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo reto.
Contraia as costas muscles e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, leading com o peitoral.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra.
Faça uma pausa no topo e retorne o corpo controladamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: ankle circles
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Lift one leg off the ground and rotate your ankle in a circular motion.
Perform the desired number of circles in one direction, then switch to the other direction.
Repeat with the other leg.
description: Ankle circles are a bodyweight exercise that targets the calves and ankle stabilizers. This movement involves rotating the ankle in a circular motion while seated, helping to improve mobility and flexibility in the ankle joint.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com seu pernas estendidas à sua frente.
Levante uma perna do chão e gire seu tornozelo na circular movimento.
Perform o desejado number de circles em um direction, em seguida troque para o outro direction.
Repita com o outro perna.

name: band two legs calf raise - (band under both legs) v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a resistance band under both feet.
Hold the ends of the band with your hands for stability.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using your calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A resistance band calf raise performed with the band under both feet, targeting the calves and also engaging the ankles and feet.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e posicione a elástico de resistência sob ambos os pés.
Segure o ends do elástico com as mãos por stability.
Eleve os calcanhares do chão as alto as possible, using as panturrilhas.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell floor calf raise
instructions: Place a barbell on the floor in front of you.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of the barbell, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Raise your heels as high as possible, using your calves to lift your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell floor calf raise is a strength exercise targeting the calves. It involves standing with the balls of your feet on a barbell and raising your heels to work the calf muscles.
instructions_pt: Posicione uma barra no chão à sua frente.
Fique em pé com o balls dos pés no edge da barra, com os calcanhares livres para fora.
Segure-se na stable object por balance if needed.
Eleve os calcanhares as alto as possible, using as panturrilhas para levante o corpo.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação de Panturrilha no Chão com Barra

name: barbell seated calf raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the floor and a barbell resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform, such as a block or step.
Lower your heels as far as possible, feeling a stretch in your calves.
Raise your heels as high as possible, contracting your calves.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell seated calf raise targets the calf muscles by having the lifter sit on a bench with a barbell resting on their thighs, raising and lowering their heels to work the calves through a full range of motion.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com os pés apoiado no chão e uma barra apoiando em suas coxas.
Posicione o balls dos pés na raised platform, such as a block ou dê um passo.
Desça os calcanhares as far as possible, feeling a alongamento em seu calves.
Eleve os calcanhares as alto as possible, contraindo as panturrilhas.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell standing calf raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place a barbell across your upper back.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using only your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell standing calf raise is a strength exercise targeting the calves. It involves standing with a barbell across your upper back and raising your heels off the ground to work the calf muscles.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e posicione uma barra através de seu upper de volta.
Eleve os calcanhares do chão as alto as possible, using only as pontas dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: bodyweight standing calf raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a wall or stable surface for balance.
Slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight standing calf raise is a simple exercise that targets the calf muscles. It involves lifting your heels off the ground while standing, using only your body weight for resistance. This movement helps to strengthen and tone the calves, and can also improve ankle stability.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Posicione as mãos na wall ou stable surface por balance.
Lentamente eleve os calcanhares do chão, levantando o corpo peso no balls dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: box jump down with one leg stabilization
instructions: Stand in front of a box or platform with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and jump onto the box, landing softly with one foot on the box and the other foot hanging off the edge.
Stabilize yourself on the box with the foot that is on it, while keeping the other foot off the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, engaging your calf muscles to maintain balance.
Slowly step down with the foot that is on the box, returning to the starting position.
Repeat the exercise with the other leg.
description: The box jump down with one leg stabilization is a plyometric exercise that targets the calves and challenges balance and stability. It involves jumping onto a box and stabilizing on one leg, which also engages the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé em frente à box ou platform com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Flexione os joelhos e salte no box, aterrissando softly com um pé no box e o outro pé livres para fora da borda.
Stabilize yourself no box com o pé that está no peso, enquanto mantendo o outro pé do chão.
Sustente essa posição pela few seconds, contraindo seu calf muscles para mantenha balance.
Lentamente dê um passo para baixo com o pé that está no box, retornando à posição inicial.
Repita o exercise com o outro perna.
name_pt: Salto da Caixa com Aterrissagem Unilateral

name: cable standing calf raise
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold onto the cable machine handles or attach a cable ankle strap to your ankles.
Raise your heels off the ground by extending your ankles as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable standing calf raise is an exercise that targets the calf muscles using a cable machine for resistance. It involves standing upright and raising your heels off the ground to engage the calves, with secondary activation of the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a máquina de polia com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure-se no máquina de polia manoplas ou prenda a cabo tornozelo strap para seu tornozelos.
Eleve os calcanhares do chão por estendendo seu tornozelos as alto as possible.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: cable standing one leg calf raise
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold onto the cable machine for support.
Lift one leg off the ground and balance on the other leg.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The cable standing one leg calf raise is a lower leg exercise that targets the calves using a cable machine for resistance. It is performed on one leg at a time, which increases the balance and stabilization demands.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a máquina de polia com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure-se no máquina de polia por support.
Levante uma perna do chão e balance no outro perna.
Lentamente eleve o calcanhar do chão, levantando o corpo para cima onto as pontas dos pés.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o calcanhar de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de perna.
name_pt: Elevação de Panturrilha em Pé Unilateral na Polia

name: calf stretch with hands against wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step your right foot back, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Bend your left knee and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight and your heel on the ground.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
description: A stretch targeting the calves, performed by leaning against a wall with one leg extended back and the heel pressed to the ground.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a wall com os pés na largura do quadril.
Posicione as mãos contra o wall na altura dos ombros.
Dê um passo seu pé direito de volta, mantendo seu calcanhar no chão e a perna reto.
Flexione seu joelho esquerdo e incline para a frente, mantendo seu de volta perna reto e o calcanhar no chão.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds.
Troque pernas e repita o alongamento.

name: calf stretch with rope
instructions: Stand facing a wall or sturdy object with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the ends of the rope in each hand and place the middle of the rope around the ball of your right foot.
Step back with your left foot, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Lean forward, keeping your back straight, and gently pull on the rope to stretch your calf.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other leg.
description: A static stretching exercise using a rope to increase flexibility in the calves and hamstrings.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a wall ou sturdy object com os pés na largura do quadril.
Segure o ends da corda em cada mão e posicione o middle da corda around o bola de seu pé direito.
Dê um passo de volta com seu pé esquerdo, mantendo seu calcanhar no chão e a perna reto.
Incline para a frente, mantendo a coluna ereta, e gently puxe na corda para alongamento seu calf.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds, em seguida solte.
Repita no outro perna.
name_pt: Alongamento de Panturrilha com Corda ou Fita

name: dumbbell seated calf raise
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your thighs.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface such as a step or block, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Hold onto the dumbbell for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated calf raise is an isolation exercise targeting the calf muscles, performed while seated with a dumbbell resting on the thighs. It is effective for building strength and muscle in the calves.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco ou chair com os pés apoiado no chão e um halter apoiando em suas coxas.
Posicione o balls dos pés na raised surface such as a dê um passo ou block, com os calcanhares livres para fora da borda.
Segure-se no halter por stability.
Eleve os calcanhares as alto as possible, levantando o corpo peso no balls dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell seated one leg calf raise - hammer grip
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your thighs.
Place one foot on a raised surface, such as a step or block, with your heel hanging off the edge.
Hold the dumbbell with a hammer grip, meaning your palms are facing each other and your fingers are wrapped around the handle.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, slowly raise your heel as high as possible by pushing through the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
description: The dumbbell seated one leg calf raise - hammer grip is a lower leg exercise that targets the calves, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and glutes. It is performed seated, using a dumbbell for resistance, and involves raising and lowering the heel to strengthen the calf muscles.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco ou chair com os pés apoiado no chão e um halter apoiando em suas coxas.
Posicione um pé na raised surface, such as a dê um passo ou block, com o calcanhar livres para fora da borda.
Segure o halter com a hammer pegada, meaning seu palms estão virado para cada outro e seu fingers estão wrapped around a manopla.
Mantendo o abdômen contraído e a coluna ereta, lentamente eleve o calcanhar as alto as possible por empurrando através do bola do pé.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o calcanhar de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e passe para a outra perna.
name_pt: Panturrilha Sentado Unilateral com Halter (Pegada Neutra)

name: dumbbell seated one leg calf raise - palm up
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place it on top of your thigh, palm facing up.
Lift one leg off the ground and extend it in front of you, keeping your knee slightly bent.
Raise your heel as high as possible by pushing through the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: The dumbbell seated one leg calf raise - palm up is an isolation exercise targeting the calf muscles, performed while seated with a dumbbell placed on the thigh. It helps build strength and muscle endurance in the calves, with some secondary activation of the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco ou chair com as costas reto e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure um halter em uma mão e posicione o peso em topo de seu coxa, palm virado para para cima.
Levante uma perna do chão e estenda o peso à sua frente, mantendo seu joelho levemente flexionados.
Eleve o calcanhar as alto as possible por empurrando através do bola do pé.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o calcanhar de volta para baixo.
Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições, em seguida troque pernas e repita.
name_pt: Panturrilha Sentado Unilateral com Halter (Palma para Cima)

name: exercise ball on the wall calf raise
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart, with your toes pointing forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise targets the calves by performing a calf raise while standing against a wall with an exercise ball for support and holding dumbbells for added resistance.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com as costas contra a wall e posicione an bola suíça entre seu desça de volta e o wall.
Posição os pés na largura dos ombros, com as pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Segure um halter em cada mão, com seus braços estendidos por seu lados.
Eleve os calcanhares do chão, levantando o corpo peso no balls dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Panturrilha na Parede com Bola Suíça

name: hack calf raise
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Stand on the sled machine with your toes on the platform and your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible by pushing through the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The hack calf raise is a lower leg exercise performed on a sled machine, primarily targeting the calves. It involves raising and lowering the heels while standing on the platform, focusing on calf muscle contraction.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o sled aparelho para a comfortable peso.
Fique em pé sobre o sled aparelho com as pontas dos pés no platform e os calcanhares livres para fora.
Segure-se nas manoplas por stability.
Eleve os calcanhares as alto as possible por empurrando através do balls dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: hack one leg calf raise
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to an appropriate weight.
Stand on the sled machine with one foot, keeping the other foot off the ground.
Hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heel as high as possible, lifting your body up on the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch legs and repeat the exercise.
description: The hack one leg calf raise is performed on a sled machine, targeting the calves with additional engagement of the hamstrings and glutes. It is executed one leg at a time, requiring balance and unilateral strength.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o sled aparelho para an appropriate peso.
Fique em pé sobre o sled aparelho com um pé, mantendo o outro pé do chão.
Segure-se nas manoplas por stability.
Eleve o calcanhar as alto as possible, levantando o corpo para cima no bola do pé.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o calcanhar de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Troque pernas e repita o exercise.

name: lever seated squat calf raise on leg press machine
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the footplate, shoulder-width apart.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the footplate, keeping your heels off the edge.
Release the safety handles and push the footplate away from you by extending your knees.
Once your knees are fully extended, slowly lower your heels by flexing your calves.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the footplate back up by extending your calves.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated squat calf raise on leg press machine is an isolation exercise targeting the calves, performed on a leg press machine by extending and flexing the ankles while seated.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o seat do perna empurre aparelho de modo que seus joelhos estão levemente flexionados when os pés estão no footplate.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o backrest e os pés apoiado no footplate, na largura dos ombros.
Posicione as pontas dos pés e o balls dos pés no footplate, mantendo seus calcanhares da borda.
Solte o safety manoplas e empurre o footplate longe de você por estendendo os joelhos.
Assim que os joelhos estiverem totalmente estendidos, lentamente desça os calcanhares por flexing as panturrilhas.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre o footplate de volta para cima por estendendo as panturrilhas.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: one leg donkey calf raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a stable surface for support, such as a wall or a bar.
Lift one leg off the ground, keeping your knee slightly bent.
Raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The one leg donkey calf raise is a bodyweight exercise targeting the calves, performed by raising the heel of one foot while the other leg is lifted, often using a wall or bar for balance.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Posicione as mãos na stable surface por support, such as a wall ou uma barra.
Levante uma perna do chão, mantendo seu joelho levemente flexionados.
Eleve o calcanhar as alto as possible, using seu calf muscles.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o calcanhar de volta para baixo.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de perna.

name: one leg floor calf raise
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place your hands on a wall or sturdy object for balance.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body up onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: The one leg floor calf raise is a bodyweight exercise targeting the calves, performed by standing on one leg and raising the heel to engage the calf muscles. It also involves the ankles and feet as secondary muscles.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura do quadril e posicione as mãos na wall ou sturdy object por balance.
Levante um pé do chão e balance no outro pé.
Lentamente eleve o calcanhar do chão, levantando o corpo para cima no bola do pé.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o calcanhar de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições, em seguida troque pernas e repita.
name_pt: Elevação de Panturrilha Unilateral no Chão

name: peroneals stretch
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Loop the rope around the ball of your foot and hold the ends of the rope with your hands.
Gently pull the rope towards you, flexing your foot and stretching your calf muscles.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Release the tension on the rope and repeat the stretch on the other leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The peroneals stretch is a flexibility exercise targeting the calf muscles, ankles, and feet. It uses a rope to assist in stretching the lower leg, improving mobility and reducing tightness.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com seu pernas estendidas à sua frente.
Loop a corda around o bola do pé e segure o ends da corda com as mãos.
Gently puxe a corda em direção a você, flexing o pé e stretching seu calf muscles.
Segure o alongamento por 15-30 seconds.
Solte o tension na corda e repita o alongamento no outro perna.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: posterior tibialis stretch
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Loop the rope around the ball of your foot and hold the ends of the rope with your hands.
Gently pull the rope towards you, flexing your foot and stretching your calf muscles.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the tension on the rope and relax your foot.
Repeat the stretch on the other leg.
description: A stretch targeting the calves using a rope to assist in flexing the foot and lengthening the posterior tibialis and calf muscles.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com seu pernas estendidas à sua frente.
Loop a corda around o bola do pé e segure o ends da corda com as mãos.
Gently puxe a corda em direção a você, flexing o pé e stretching seu calf muscles.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds.
Solte o tension na corda e relax o pé.
Repita o alongamento no outro perna.

name: seated calf stretch (male)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair or bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you, keeping your heel on the ground.
Lean forward slightly, feeling a stretch in your calf muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
description: The seated calf stretch (male) is a flexibility exercise targeting the calf muscles. It is performed while seated, requiring no equipment other than a chair or bench, and focuses on stretching the calves and, to a lesser extent, the hamstrings.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no edge da chair ou banco com os pés apoiado no chão.
Estenda uma perna estendidos à sua frente, mantendo seu calcanhar no chão.
Incline para a frente levemente, feeling a alongamento em seu calf muscle.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds.
Troque pernas e repita o alongamento.

name: sled calf press on leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the sled.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the sled, with your toes pointing forward.
Release the safety handles and push the sled away from you by extending your knees and ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the sled back down by bending your knees and ankles.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled calf press on leg press is an exercise that targets the calves using a sled (leg press) machine. It also engages the hamstrings and quadriceps as secondary muscles. The movement involves pressing the sled away using the balls of your feet, focusing on ankle extension.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o seat do perna empurre aparelho de modo que seus joelhos estão levemente flexionados when os pés estão no sled.
Posicione os pés na largura dos ombros no sled, com as pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Solte o safety manoplas e empurre o sled longe de você por estendendo os joelhos e tornozelos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente o sled de volta para baixo flexionando os joelhos e tornozelos.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: sled one leg calf press on leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are slightly bent when your feet are on the sled.
