Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the sled, shoulder-width apart.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the sled, keeping your heels off.
Push the sled forward by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled back down by flexing your ankles.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled one leg calf press on leg press is a machine-based exercise targeting the calves, performed one leg at a time for increased isolation and intensity. It also engages the hamstrings and glutes as secondary muscles.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o seat do perna empurre aparelho de modo que seus joelhos estão levemente flexionados when os pés estão no sled.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o backrest e os pés no sled, na largura dos ombros.
Posicione as pontas dos pés e o balls dos pés no sled, mantendo seus calcanhares de.
Empurre o sled para a frente por estendendo seu tornozelos, mantendo os joelhos levemente flexionados.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o sled de volta para baixo por flexing seu tornozelos.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith one leg floor calf raise
instructions: Position yourself on the floor under the smith machine bar, facing away from the machine.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface, such as a weight plate or block.
Position the smith machine bar across your lower legs, just above your ankles.
Hold onto the bar with your hands for stability.
Raise your heels off the ground by extending your ankles, lifting your body up.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith one leg floor calf raise is a lower leg exercise performed using a Smith machine. It targets the calves and also engages the hamstrings and glutes as secondary muscles. The exercise involves raising your heel off the ground while balancing on one leg, with the Smith machine bar providing resistance.
instructions_pt: Posição yourself no chão sob o aparelho Smith bar, virado para longe do aparelho.
Posicione o balls dos pés na raised surface, such as a peso plate ou block.
Posição o aparelho Smith bar através de seu desça pernas, just acima seu tornozelos.
Segure-se na barra com as mãos por stability.
Eleve os calcanhares do chão por estendendo seu tornozelos, levantando o corpo para cima.
Faça uma pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente os calcanhares de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação de Panturrilha Unilateral no Chão no Smith

name: smith reverse calf raises
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
Stand facing the bar with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the bar for support.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Smith reverse calf raises are performed using a Smith machine and primarily target the calves, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings. The exercise involves raising the heels while standing on the balls of the feet on a step or platform, using the Smith machine bar for support.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho Smith bar para a altura logo abaixo os ombros.
Fique de frente para a barra com os pés na largura do quadril e pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Posicione o balls dos pés no edge da dê um passo ou platform, com os calcanhares livres para fora.
Segure-se na barra por support.
Eleve os calcanhares as alto as possible, levantando o corpo para cima onto as pontas dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith seated one leg calf raise
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the footrest.
Place one leg on the footrest and keep the other leg off the footrest.
Using your calf muscles, raise your heel as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: The smith seated one leg calf raise is a lower leg exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the calf muscles by raising one heel at a time while seated.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o apoio e os pés no footrest.
Posicione uma perna no footrest e mantenha o outro perna do footrest.
Using seu calf muscles, eleve o calcanhar as alto as possible.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o calcanhar de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições, em seguida troque pernas e repita.
name_pt: Elevação de Panturrilha Sentado Unilateral no Smith

name: smith toe raise
instructions: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to comfortably stand with your feet flat on the ground.
Position yourself under the bar with your shoulders directly below it and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised platform or weight plates, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your back straight throughout the exercise.
Slowly raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith toe raise is a calf exercise performed on a Smith machine, focusing on raising the heels to strengthen the calves. It uses a raised platform to increase the range of motion and is performed with the barbell resting on the shoulders.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho Smith bar para a altura that allows você para comfortably Fique em pé com os pés apoiado no chão.
Posição yourself sob a barra com os ombros directly abaixo o peso e os pés na largura dos ombros.
Posicione o balls dos pés na raised platform ou peso plates, com os calcanhares livres para fora da borda.
Segure a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha a coluna ereta throughout o exercise.
Lentamente eleve os calcanhares as alto as possible, levantando o corpo peso no balls dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação de Ponta dos Pés no Smith (Tibial Anterior)

name: standing calves
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, standing on your toes.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The standing calves exercise is a bodyweight movement targeting the calf muscles. It involves raising your heels off the ground to stand on your toes, then lowering them back down, which helps build strength and endurance in the calves.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Eleve os calcanhares do chão as alto as possible, standing nas pontas dos pés.
Sustente a posição pela instante, em seguida desça lentamente os calcanhares de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: standing calves calf stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall or sturdy object, about an arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall or object at shoulder height.
Step back with one foot, keeping your heel flat on the ground.
Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, keeping your back leg straight.
You should feel a stretch in your calf muscle.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other leg.
description: The standing calves calf stretch is a bodyweight exercise designed to stretch the calf muscles. It is performed by standing facing a wall, placing your hands on the wall, stepping one foot back, and leaning forward to stretch the calf of the back leg.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a wall ou sturdy object, about an comprimento dos braços longe.
Posicione as mãos no wall ou object na altura dos ombros.
Dê um passo de volta com um pé, mantendo seu calcanhar apoiado no chão.
Flexione seu frente joelho levemente e incline para a frente, mantendo seu de volta perna reto.
Você should sentir um alongamento em seu calf muscle.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds.
Repita no outro perna.

name: bench dip on floor
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bench dip on floor is a bodyweight exercise targeting the triceps, with secondary activation of the chest and shoulders. It is performed by supporting your body on your hands at the edge of a bench or chair, lowering your body by bending your elbows, and then pressing back up.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na ponta do banco ou chair com as mãos gripping o edge, fingers pointing para a frente.
Slide seu butt do banco, supporting seu peso com as mãos.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos até os braços estejam paralelas ao chão.
Empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Mergulho nas Paralelas no Banco no Chão

name: muscle-up (on vertical bar)
instructions: Start by hanging from a vertical bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you pull yourself up, lean back slightly and bring your elbows towards your sides.
Continue pulling until your chest reaches the bar and your elbows are fully bent.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The muscle-up on a vertical bar is a challenging bodyweight exercise that combines a pull-up with a dip, requiring significant upper body strength, coordination, and technique. It primarily targets the lats, with secondary emphasis on the biceps, triceps, and forearms.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging da vertical bar com suas palmas voltadas para a frente e os braços totalmente estendidos.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, leading com o peitoral.
Ao puxe yourself para cima, incline de volta levemente e aproxime os cotovelos em direção a seu lados.
Continue puxando até o peitoral reaches a barra e os cotovelos estão totalmente flexionado.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente yourself de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: neck side stretch
instructions: Stand or sit up straight with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to one side, bringing your ear towards your shoulder.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other side.
Perform 2-4 sets on each side.
description: A gentle stretch targeting the side of the neck, primarily the levator scapulae, performed by tilting the head to the side while standing or sitting.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ou sente-se para cima reto com os ombros relaxed.
Tilt a cabeça para um lado, aproximando seu ear em direção ao ombro.
Segure o alongamento por 15-30 seconds.
Repita do outro lado.
Perform 2-4 sets em cada lado.

name: back pec stretch
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Cross your arms in front of your body, with your right arm over your left arm.
Interlock your fingers and rotate your palms away from your body.
Slowly raise your arms up and away from your body, feeling a stretch in your back and chest.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the opposite side.
description: The back pec stretch is a bodyweight exercise designed to stretch the lats, shoulders, and chest. It involves crossing the arms, interlocking the fingers, and raising the arms to feel a stretch across the upper back and chest.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Estenda os braços estendidos à sua frente, paralelos ao chão.
Cruze os braços em frente ao corpo, com seu braço direito sobre seu braço esquerdo.
Interlock seu fingers e gire seu palms longe do corpo.
Lentamente eleve os braços para cima e longe do corpo, feeling a alongamento em seu de volta e peitoral.
Segure o alongamento por 15-30 seconds, em seguida solte.
Repita no lado oposto.

name: calf push stretch with hands against wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands against the wall at shoulder height.
Step back with one foot, keeping your heel on the ground and your leg straight.
Bend your front knee slightly and lean forward, feeling a stretch in your calf.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat the stretch.
description: The calf push stretch with hands against wall is a bodyweight exercise that targets the calves and also stretches the hamstrings. It is performed by standing facing a wall, placing your hands against it, stepping one foot back, and leaning forward to stretch the calf muscle.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a wall com os pés na largura do quadril.
Posicione as mãos contra o wall na altura dos ombros.
Dê um passo de volta com um pé, mantendo seu calcanhar no chão e a perna reto.
Flexione seu frente joelho levemente e incline para a frente, feeling a alongamento em seu calf.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds.
Troque pernas e repita o alongamento.
name_pt: Alongamento de Panturrilha com Empurrão na Parede

name: band hip lift
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place a resistance band just above your knees.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Press your heels into the ground and lift your hips off the floor, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The band hip lift is a glute-focused exercise performed on the floor with a resistance band placed above the knees. It targets the glutes and also works the hamstrings and quadriceps. The movement involves lifting the hips off the ground while keeping the core engaged and squeezing the glutes at the top.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas com os joelhos flexionado e pés apoiado no chão.
Posicione a elástico de resistência just acima os joelhos.
Contraia os glúteos e core muscles.
Empurre os calcanhares no chão e levante o quadril do chão, contraindo os glúteos no topo.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o quadril de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell glute bridge
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place a barbell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Engage your glutes and core muscles, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell glute bridge is a strength exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It involves lifting the hips off the ground while supporting a barbell across the hips, requiring core engagement and proper form to ensure safety and effectiveness.
instructions_pt: Comece lying apoiado nas costas no chão com os joelhos flexionado e pés apoiado no chão.
Posicione uma barra através do quadril, segurando o peso securely com ambas as mãos.
Contraia os glúteos e core muscles, em seguida levante o quadril do chão até o corpo forms a linha reta dos joelhos para os ombros.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, contraindo bem os glúteos.
Lentamente desça o quadril de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell lateral lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Take a big step to the side with your right foot, keeping your left foot planted.
Bend your right knee and lower your body down into a lunge position, keeping your left leg straight.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping with your left foot.
description: The barbell lateral lunge is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes and also works the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping laterally while supporting a barbell on your upper back, requiring strength, balance, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando uma barra através de seu upper de volta.
Take a big dê um passo para o lado com seu pé direito, mantendo seu pé esquerdo planted.
Flexione seu joelho direito e desça o corpo para baixo em um lunge posição, mantendo seu perna esquerda reto.
Impulsione-se com seu pé direito e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado, stepping com seu pé esquerdo.

name: barbell palms down wrist curl over a bench
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your forearms resting on your thighs, palms facing down.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell towards the ground by flexing your wrists, keeping your forearms stationary.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise the barbell back up by extending your wrists.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell palms down wrist curl over a bench is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, specifically the wrist extensors. It is performed by sitting on a bench, resting the forearms on the thighs or a bench, and curling a barbell upward using only the wrists.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com os pés apoiado no chão e os antebraços apoiando em suas coxas, palmas voltadas para baixo.
Segure uma barra com pegada pronada, mãos na largura dos ombros.
Desça a barra em direção ao chão por flexing os punhos, mantendo seu forearms stationary.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida lentamente eleve a barra de volta para cima por estendendo os punhos.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Rosca Punho no Banco com Barra

name: barbell palms up wrist curl over a bench
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Rest your forearms on the bench, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Keeping your forearms stationary, exhale and curl your wrists upwards as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell palms up wrist curl over a bench is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, specifically the wrist flexors. It is performed by sitting on a bench, resting the forearms on the bench with wrists hanging off, and curling a barbell upwards using only the wrists.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com os pés apoiado no chão e segure uma barra com pegada supinada, palmas voltadas para cima.
Apoie os antebraços no banco, allowing os punhos para livres para fora da borda.
Mantendo seu forearms stationary, expire e flexione os punhos upwards as far as possible.
Sustente a posição contraída pela breve faça uma pausa, em seguida inspire e desça a barra lentamente de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Rosca Punho no Banco com Barra

name: cable reverse one arm curl
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable handle with an underhand grip, palm facing down.
Keep your elbow close to your side and slowly curl your forearm up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable reverse one arm curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps and forearms, performed using a cable machine. It involves curling the handle with a reverse grip to emphasize the forearms and brachialis.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a máquina de polia com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure o cabo manopla com pegada supinada, palm virado para para baixo.
Mantenha seu cotovelo próximo a seu lado e lentamente flexione o antebraço para cima em direção ao ombro.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o antebraço de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell one arm reverse preacher curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your chest against the pad and your arm extended over the edge of the bench, holding a dumbbell with an underhand grip.
Lower the dumbbell slowly until your arm is fully extended.
Curl the dumbbell back up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell one arm reverse preacher curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed on a preacher bench with a single dumbbell. It emphasizes strict form and control, helping to build biceps and forearm strength.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na preacher banco com o peitoral contra o apoio e o braço estendido sobre o edge do banco, segurando um halter com pegada supinada.
Desça o halter lentamente até o braço está totalmente estendidos.
Flexione o halter de volta para cima em direção ao ombro, mantendo seu upper braço stationary.
Contraia os bíceps no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente o halter de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de braço.

name: dumbbell one arm seated neutral wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Rest your forearm on your thigh, allowing your wrist to hang off the edge.
Keeping your forearm stationary, curl your wrist upward as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your wrist back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other hand.
description: The dumbbell one arm seated neutral wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearm muscles, particularly the wrist flexors. It is performed seated, with the forearm resting on the thigh and the wrist curling a dumbbell upward.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com os pés apoiado no chão e segure um halter em uma mão, palm virado para para cima.
Apoie o antebraço em seu coxa, allowing o punho para livres para fora da borda.
Mantendo seu forearm stationary, flexione o punho para cima as far as possible.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o punho de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições, em seguida troque para o outro mão.
name_pt: Rosca Punho Sentado Unilateral Pegada Neutra com Halteres

name: exercise ball one leg prone lower body rotation
instructions: Lie face down on the stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your legs extended straight behind you.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for support.
Engage your glutes and core muscles to stabilize your body.
Slowly lift one leg off the ground, keeping it straight and parallel to the floor.
Rotate your leg outward, away from your body, while keeping your hips and upper body stable.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat the rotation with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise involves lying face down on a stability ball and performing one-leg lower body rotations, targeting the glutes and engaging the core for stabilization.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de bruços no bola suíça com o quadril apoiando no bola e as pernas estendido em linha reta atrás você.
Posicione as mãos no chão à sua frente por support.
Contraia os glúteos e core muscles para stabilize o corpo.
Lentamente levante uma perna do chão, mantendo-o reto e paralelos ao chão.
Gire a perna para fora, longe do corpo, enquanto mantendo seus quadris e upper corpo stable.
Faça uma breve pausa no end do rotation, em seguida retorne lentamente a perna à posição inicial.
Repita o rotation com o outro perna.
Continue alternando as pernas pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Rotação de Tronco Unilateral em Prancha na Bola Suíça

name: exercise ball one legged diagonal kick hamstring curl
instructions: Start by lying on your back with your legs extended and your heels resting on top of the stability ball.
Place your arms by your sides for stability.
Engage your glutes and core muscles to lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your shoulders to your heels.
Bend your right knee and bring it towards your chest, keeping your left leg extended and your foot flexed.
Kick your right leg diagonally across your body, extending it fully and engaging your hamstrings.
Slowly return your right leg to the starting position, maintaining control and stability.
Repeat the movement with your left leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise targets the glutes and also works the hamstrings and calves. It requires balance and coordination as you perform a single-leg hamstring curl and diagonal kick on a stability ball.
instructions_pt: Comece lying nas costas com seu pernas estendidas e os calcanhares apoiando em topo do bola suíça.
Posicione os braços por seu lados por stability.
Contraia os glúteos e core muscles para levante o quadril do chão, creating a linha reta dos ombros para os calcanhares.
Flexione seu joelho direito e aproxime o peso em direção ao peitoral, mantendo seu perna esquerda estendido e o pé flexed.
Kick seu perna direita diagonally através do corpo, estendendo o peso totalmente e contraindo os posteriores de coxa.
Lentamente retorne seu perna direita à posição inicial, mantendo o controle e stability.
Repita o movimento com seu perna esquerda, alternando lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: hug knees to chest
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down into a squat position.
As you squat down, bring your knees up towards your chest and hug them with your arms.
Hold this position for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The 'hug knees to chest' exercise is a bodyweight movement that involves squatting down and hugging your knees to your chest, targeting the glutes and also engaging the hamstrings and quadriceps.
instructions_pt: Comece em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Flexione os joelhos e desça o corpo para baixo em posição de agachamento.
Ao squat para baixo, aproxime os joelhos para cima em direção ao peitoral e hug os pesos com os braços.
Sustente essa posição pela instante, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Abraço dos Joelhos no Peito (Alongamento Lombar)

name: iron cross stretch
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended out to the sides.
Raise your legs up towards the ceiling, keeping them straight.
Slowly lower your legs to one side, aiming to touch the floor with your feet.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then return your legs to the starting position.
Repeat the stretch on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The iron cross stretch is a dynamic movement that targets the glutes and also stretches the hamstrings and quadriceps. It involves lying on your back, raising your legs, and rotating them side to side to touch the floor, promoting flexibility and mobility in the hips and lower back.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os braços estendidos para fora para o lados.
Eleve as pernas para cima em direção ao ceiling, mantendo-os estendidos.
Lentamente desça as pernas para um lado, aiming para toque o chão com os pés.
Segure o alongamento pela few seconds, em seguida retorne as pernas à posição inicial.
Repita o alongamento no outro lado.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: kneeling jump squat
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your feet hip-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Hold a barbell across your upper back, resting it on your shoulders.
Engage your core and glutes, then explosively jump up into the air, extending your hips and knees.
As you jump, push through your toes and fully extend your ankles, knees, and hips.
Land softly back on the ground, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Immediately go into the next repetition, repeating the jump squat motion.
description: The kneeling jump squat is a dynamic lower body exercise that targets the glutes and also works the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves starting from a kneeling position and explosively jumping into the air while holding a barbell across the upper back.
instructions_pt: Comece kneeling no chão com os pés na largura do quadril e as pontas dos pés pointing para a frente.
Segure uma barra através de seu upper de volta, apoiando o peso nos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e glutes, em seguida explosively salte para cima no air, estendendo o quadril e joelhos.
Ao salte, empurre através das pontas dos pés e totalmente estenda seu tornozelos, joelhos, e quadril.
Aterrisse suavemente de volta no chão, flexionando os joelhos para absorb o impact.
Immediately go no next repetition, repeating o salte squat movimento.

name: modified push up to lower arms
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body down towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Once your elbows are at a 90-degree angle, lower your forearms to the ground, keeping your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Pause for a moment, then push through your palms to lift your forearms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The modified push up to lower arms is a bodyweight exercise targeting the forearms, with secondary emphasis on the triceps, chest, and shoulders. It involves transitioning from a push-up position to lowering the forearms to the ground and then pressing back up.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos directly sob os ombros e o corpo na linha reta.
Desça o corpo para baixo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo os pesos próximo a seu lados.
Once os cotovelos estão na 90-degree ângulo, desça os antebraços para o chão, mantendo seus cotovelos directly sob os ombros.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre através de seu palms para levante os antebraços de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Flexão de Braço com Transição para Antebraços

name: pelvic tilt into bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Tilt your pelvis upward, lifting your hips off the ground.
Hold the bridge position for a few seconds.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The pelvic tilt into bridge is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes, while also engaging the hamstrings and core. It involves tilting the pelvis and lifting the hips off the ground to form a bridge, then lowering back down.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas com os joelhos flexionado e pés apoiado no chão.
Posicione os braços por seu lados com suas palmas voltadas para baixo.
Contraia os glúteos e core muscles.
Tilt seu pelvis para cima, levantando o quadril do chão.
Segure o bridge posição pela few seconds.
Lentamente desça o quadril de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Basculamento Pélvico para Ponte de Glúteos

name: reverse hyper on flat bench
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your hips at the edge and your legs hanging off the bench.
Hold onto the bench for stability.
Keeping your legs straight, raise them up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The reverse hyper on flat bench is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It involves lying face down on a flat bench and lifting the legs upward, focusing on squeezing the glutes at the top of the movement.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de bruços na apoiado banco com o quadril no edge e as pernas hanging do banco.
Segure-se no banco por stability.
Mantendo seu pernas reto, eleve os pesos para cima em direção ao ceiling as alto ao can.
Contraia os glúteos no topo do movimento.
Lentamente desça as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: seated glute stretch
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and cross your right ankle over your left thigh.
Place your right hand on the ground behind you for support.
With your left hand, gently press down on your right knee to deepen the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: The seated glute stretch is a flexibility exercise targeting the gluteal muscles. It is performed seated on the ground, crossing one ankle over the opposite thigh and gently pressing down on the knee to deepen the stretch. This exercise helps improve hip mobility and relieve tension in the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com seu pernas estendidas à sua frente.
Flexione seu joelho direito e cruze seu tornozelo direito sobre seu coxa esquerda.
Posicione seu mão direita no chão atrás você por support.
Com seu mão esquerda, gently empurre para baixo em seu joelho direito para deepen o alongamento.
Segure o alongamento por 30 seconds para 1 minute.
Troque lados e repita.

name: sled 45 degrees one leg press
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the footplate.
Place one foot on the footplate and extend your leg, pushing the sled away from you.
Slowly bend your knee and lower the sled back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled 45 degrees one leg press is a lower body exercise performed on a sled machine at a 45-degree angle, focusing on one leg at a time to target the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It helps build unilateral leg strength and muscle balance.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o sled aparelho para a 45-degree ângulo.
Sente-se no sled aparelho com as costas contra o apoio e os pés no footplate.
Posicione um pé no footplate e estenda a perna, empurrando o sled longe de você.
Lentamente flexione o joelho e desça o sled de volta à posição inicial.
Repita com o outro perna.
Continue alternando as pernas pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith seated wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench in front of a Smith machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the barbell towards your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith seated wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, performed using a Smith machine. It involves curling the wrists upward while seated, with the forearms resting on the thighs.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco em frente à aparelho Smith com os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure a barra com pegada supinada, mãos na largura dos ombros.
Apoie os antebraços em suas coxas, allowing os punhos para livres para fora.
Lentamente flexione os punhos para cima, aproximando a barra em direção aos antebraços.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: straight leg outer hip abductor
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Engage your core and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The straight leg outer hip abductor is a bodyweight exercise performed lying on your side, targeting the hip abductor muscles. It helps strengthen the outer thighs and hips, and also engages the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de lado com as pernas reto e stacked em topo de cada outro.
Posicione seu bottom braço sob a cabeça por support.
Contraia o abdômen e levante seu topo perna as alto as possible sem girando o quadril ou inclinando para trás.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a perna de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de lado.
name_pt: Abdução de Quadril com Perna Estendida no Solo

name: wrist circles
instructions: Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Make a fist with both hands.
Rotate your wrists in a circular motion, keeping your arms still.
Continue the wrist circles for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Wrist circles are a bodyweight exercise focused on improving mobility and flexibility in the wrists and forearms. This movement is commonly used as a warm-up or rehabilitation exercise to increase blood flow and prepare the wrists for more strenuous activities.
instructions_pt: Estenda os braços estendidos à sua frente.
Make a fist com ambas as mãos.
Gire os punhos na circular movimento, mantendo seus braços still.
Continue o wrist circles pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: wide grip pull-up
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The wide grip pull-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) with significant involvement of the biceps and forearms. It requires hanging from a pull-up bar with a grip wider than shoulder-width, pulling the chin above the bar, and lowering back down with control.
instructions_pt: Fique suspenso na barra fixa com suas palmas voltadas para a frente e as mãos wider than na largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e aproxime bem as escápulas.
Puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra até o queixo está acima a barra.
Desça o corpo de volta à posição inicial com control.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: chest dip (on dip-pull-up cage)
instructions: Adjust the dip bars to a height that allows you to comfortably grip them.
Stand between the bars and place your hands on each bar, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Jump up and straighten your arms, supporting your body weight on the bars.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles behind you.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your chest up and your shoulders down.
Continue lowering until your shoulders are below your elbows or until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Push through your palms and extend your elbows to raise your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The chest dip (on dip-pull-up cage) is a bodyweight exercise targeting the pectoral muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. It involves supporting your body weight on parallel bars, lowering yourself by bending your elbows, and then pushing back up.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o dip bars para a altura that allows você para comfortably pegada os pesos.
Fique em pé entre o bars e posicione as mãos em cada bar, levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Salte para cima e straighten os braços, supporting o corpo peso no bars.
Flexione os joelhos e cruze seu tornozelos atrás você.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo seu peito estufado e os ombros para baixo.
Continue descendo até os ombros estão abaixo os cotovelos ou até você sentir um alongamento em seu peitoral.
Empurre através de seu palms e estenda os cotovelos para eleve o corpo de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: assisted standing chin-up
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired assistance level.
Stand on the foot platform and grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back, engage your core, and slightly bend your knees.
Pull your body up by flexing your elbows and driving your elbows down towards your sides.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The assisted standing chin-up is a machine-based exercise that helps users perform chin-ups with added support, making it easier to build strength in the lats, biceps, and forearms. The leverage machine reduces the amount of body weight lifted, allowing for proper form and gradual progression.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho para seu desejado assistance altura.
Fique em pé sobre o pé platform e pegada as manoplas com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Mantenha seu peito estufado e ombros de volta, contraia o abdômen, e levemente flexione os joelhos.
Puxe o corpo para cima por flexing os cotovelos e driving os cotovelos para baixo em direção a seu lados.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra.
Faça uma pausa no topo e retorne o corpo controladamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Barra Fixa Supinada em Pé Assistido

name: assisted standing pull-up
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired weight and height settings.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your lats and biceps, and pull yourself up towards the handles.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your back muscles.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The assisted standing pull-up is a machine-based exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) with assistance to help perform the pull-up movement. It is suitable for those building strength to perform unassisted pull-ups.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho para seu ajustes desejados de carga e altura.
Fique de frente para o aparelho com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure as manoplas com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Contraia as dorsais e biceps, e puxe yourself para cima em direção às manoplas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, contraindo as costas muscles.
Lentamente Desça o corpo de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith front squat (clean grip)
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at shoulder height.
Stand facing the barbell with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back and position the barbell on your front shoulders, resting it on your collarbone and deltoids.
Keep your chest up, back straight, and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith front squat (clean grip) is a lower body exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the glutes with significant involvement from the quadriceps, hamstrings, calves, and core. The clean grip requires good shoulder and wrist mobility, and the movement demands proper technique to maintain balance and safety.
instructions_pt: Set para cima o aparelho Smith com a barra na altura dos ombros.
Fique de frente para a barra com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Dê um passo de volta e posição a barra em seu frente ombros, apoiando o peso em seu clavícula e deltoids.
Mantenha seu peito estufado, de volta reto, e core engaged.
Desça o corpo flexionando os joelhos e o quadril, como se sentando em uma cadeira.
Continue descendo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão ou levemente abaixo.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith low bar squat
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at a height that allows you to comfortably rest it on your upper back.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned outwards.
Step under the bar and position it across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar by straightening your legs and stepping back from the rack.
Take a deep breath and brace your core.
Initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith low bar squat is a compound lower body exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the glutes as the primary muscle group, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The smith machine provides stability, making it accessible for those learning squat mechanics while still offering a challenging strength workout.
instructions_pt: Set para cima o aparelho Smith com a barra na altura that allows você para comfortably apoie o peso em seu upper de volta.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés levemente turned outwards.
Dê um passo sob a barra e posição o peso através de seu upper de volta, apoiando o peso em seu traps.
Pegada a barra com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Unrack a barra por estendendo as pernas e stepping de volta do rack.
Take a deep breath e brace o core.
Initiate o squat por empurrando o quadril de volta e flexionando os joelhos.
Desça o corpo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão ou levemente abaixo.
Mantenha seu peito estufado e as costas reto throughout o movimento.
Empurre com força pelos calcanhares para ficar em pé novamente, estendendo o quadril e joelhos.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell low bar squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell resting on your upper back.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, slowly lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell low bar squat is a compound lower body exercise that targets the glutes, with significant involvement of the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It is performed with a barbell positioned lower on the back (across the rear deltoids), requiring good technique, core stability, and hip mobility.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e a barra apoiando em seu upper de volta.
Mantendo seu peito estufado e core engaged, lentamente desça o corpo flexionando os joelhos e empurrando o quadril de volta.
Continue descendo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão ou levemente abaixo.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell high bar squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Place the barbell on your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to squat down, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell high bar squat is a compound lower body exercise that primarily targets the glutes, with significant involvement from the quadriceps, hamstrings, calves, and core. It requires placing a barbell on the upper back (traps) and performing a squat movement.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés levemente turned para fora.
Posicione a barra em seu upper de volta, apoiando o peso em seu traps.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu peito estufado ao begin para squat para baixo, empurrando o quadril de volta e flexionando os joelhos.
Desça o corpo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão, ou as baixo ao can comfortably go.
Empurre com força pelos calcanhares para ficar em pé novamente, estendendo o quadril e joelhos.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell finger curls
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip, resting your forearm on your thigh, palm facing up.
Allow the dumbbell to roll down to your fingertips, then curl it back up by flexing your fingers.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other hand.
description: Dumbbell finger curls are an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, specifically the muscles responsible for finger flexion. This exercise helps improve grip strength and forearm development.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco ou chair com os pés apoiado no chão e as costas reto.
Segure um halter em uma mão com pegada supinada, apoiando o antebraço em seu coxa, palm virado para para cima.
Allow o halter para roll para baixo para seu fingertips, em seguida flexione o peso de volta para cima por flexing seu fingers.
Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições, em seguida troque para o outro mão.

name: kettlebell seated two arm military press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Press the kettlebells overhead by extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebells back to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The kettlebell seated two arm military press is a shoulder exercise performed while seated, pressing two kettlebells overhead to target the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and upper back.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com as costas retas e os pés firmes no chão.
Segure a kettlebell em cada mão na altura dos ombros com suas palmas voltadas para a frente.
Empurre o kettlebells acima da cabeça por estendendo os braços totalmente.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o kettlebells de volta até a altura dos ombros.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever gripless shrug v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles or bars with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight.
Keeping your back straight, lift your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever gripless shrug v. 2 is performed on a leverage machine and targets the trapezius muscles. It involves elevating the shoulders while keeping the arms straight, focusing on the upper back and traps.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com as costas contra o apoio.
Segure as manoplas ou bars com pegada pronada, mantendo os braços estendidos.
Mantendo a coluna ereta, levante os ombros para cima em direção a seu ears as alto as possible.
Segure o contração pela instante, em seguida desça lentamente os ombros de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell over bench one arm reverse wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing down.
Rest your forearm on the bench with your wrist hanging off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards, bringing the dumbbell towards your forearm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell over bench one arm reverse wrist curl targets the forearms, specifically the extensors, and is performed by curling the wrist upwards while the forearm is supported on a bench.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com os pés apoiado no chão e segure um halter em uma mão, palm virado para para baixo.
Apoie o antebraço no banco com o punho livres para fora da borda.
Lentamente flexione o punho upwards, aproximando o halter em direção ao antebraço.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o halter de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e passe para o outro braço.
name_pt: Rosca Punho Inversa Unilateral no Banco com Halteres

name: lever seated dip
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your feet are flat on the ground and your knees are at a 90-degree angle.
Grasp the handles of the leverage machine with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated dip is a machine-based exercise targeting the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It involves pressing down on handles while seated, simulating a dip movement in a controlled environment.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco de modo que seus pés estão apoiado no chão e os joelhos estão na 90-degree ângulo.
Segure as manoplas do leverage aparelho com suas palmas voltadas para baixo e os braços totalmente estendidos.
Lentamente desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos até os braços estejam paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Mergulho nas Paralelas Sentado na Máquina Articulada

name: lever seated crunch
instructions: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles or place your hands on the side pads for support.
Engage your abs and slowly lean back, allowing the pad to move with you.
Once your upper body is at a 45-degree angle, contract your abs and crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated crunch is an abdominal exercise performed on a leverage machine. It targets the abs and also engages the obliques. The movement involves crunching forward against resistance, making it a controlled and effective core strengthening exercise.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no leverage aparelho com as costas contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas ou posicione as mãos no lado apoios por support.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente incline de volta, allowing o apoio para move com você.
Once o tronco forma um ângulo de 45 graus, contraia o abdômen e crunch para a frente, aproximando o peitoral em direção aos joelhos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida solte lentamente e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Abdominal Supra Sentado na Máquina Articulada

name: barbell standing close grip military press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly closer than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press the barbell overhead, extending your arms fully.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell standing close grip military press is a compound strength exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and upper back. It is performed by pressing a barbell overhead from shoulder height with a close grip, requiring core stability and shoulder strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure a barra com pegada pronada, mãos levemente closer than na largura dos ombros.
Levante a barra até a altura dos ombros, mantendo os cotovelos junto ao corpo.
Empurre a barra acima da cabeça, estendendo os braços totalmente.
Desça a barra de volta até a altura dos ombros.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento Militar em Pé Pegada Fechada com Barra

name: barbell standing wide military press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lift the barbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Press the barbell overhead, extending your arms fully.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell standing wide military press is a compound exercise that targets the deltoid muscles of the shoulders. It also engages the triceps and upper back as secondary muscles. The movement requires pressing a barbell overhead from shoulder height while standing, with a grip wider than shoulder-width.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure a barra com pegada pronada, levemente wider than ombro-largura.
Levante a barra até a altura dos ombros, mantendo seus cotovelos levemente em frente à barra.
Empurre a barra acima da cabeça, estendendo os braços totalmente.
Desça a barra de volta até a altura dos ombros e Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento Militar em Pé com Barra

name: ez barbell seated curls
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your upper arms on your thighs, allowing the ez barbell to hang down in front of you.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the ez barbell upwards towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the ez barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell seated curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed while seated to minimize body movement and focus on the arms. It uses an EZ barbell, which is easier on the wrists than a straight bar.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com os pés apoiado no chão e as costas reto.
Segure o ez barra com pegada supinada, palmas voltadas para cima, e suas mãos na largura dos ombros.
Apoie os braços em suas coxas, allowing o ez barra para hang para baixo à sua frente.
Mantendo os braços firmes e imóveis, expire e flexione o ez barra upwards em direção aos ombros.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, contraindo bem os bíceps.
Inspire e lentamente desça o ez barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell romanian deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing your knees to bend slightly.
Lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then push through your heels and engage your glutes to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell Romanian deadlift is a strength exercise targeting the glutes, hamstrings, and lower back. It involves hinging at the hips while holding dumbbells, emphasizing posterior chain development and hip hinge mechanics.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando um halter em cada mão com pegada pronada.
Mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído, incline o tronco no quadril e desça os halteres em direção ao chão, allowing os joelhos para flexione levemente.
Desça os halteres até você sentir um alongamento em seu hamstrings, em seguida empurre pelos calcanhares e contraia os glúteos para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: walking lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right leg, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee aligned with your ankle.
Push off with your right foot and bring your left foot forward, stepping into a lunge position with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs and walking forward, maintaining a controlled and steady pace.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The walking lunge is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping forward into a lunge and alternating legs as you walk forward, requiring balance, coordination, and lower body strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Take a dê um passo para a frente com seu perna direita, descendo o corpo em um lunge posição.
Mantenha seu tronco upright e seu frente joelho aligned com seu tornozelo.
Impulsione-se com seu pé direito e aproxime seu pé esquerdo para a frente, stepping em um lunge posição com seu perna esquerda.
Continue alternando pernas e walking para a frente, mantendo a controlled e steady pace.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell full squat (back pov)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower your body down.
Bend at the knees and hips, pushing your hips back and down as if sitting into a chair.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your weight in your heels.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell full squat (back POV) is a compound lower body exercise that targets the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, calves, and core. It involves holding a barbell across the upper back and performing a deep squat, requiring strength, balance, and proper technique.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés levemente turned para fora.
Segure a barra através de seu upper de volta, apoiando o peso em seu traps ou rear delts.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu peito estufado ao begin para desça o corpo para baixo.
Flexione no joelhos e quadril, empurrando o quadril de volta e para baixo como se sitting em uma cadeira.
Desça o corpo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão ou levemente abaixo.
Mantenha seus joelhos alinhados com as pontas dos pés e seu peso nos calcanhares.
Empurre com força pelos calcanhares para ficar em pé novamente, estendendo o quadril e joelhos.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell full squat (side pov)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Hold the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps or rear delts.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you begin to lower your body down.
Bend at the knees and hips, pushing your hips back and down as if sitting into a chair.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Keep your knees in line with your toes and your weight in your heels.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell full squat (side POV) is a compound lower body exercise that targets the glutes, quadriceps, and hamstrings, while also engaging the calves and core for stability. It involves lowering the body with a barbell across the upper back and then driving back up to a standing position.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés levemente turned para fora.
Segure a barra através de seu upper de volta, apoiando o peso em seu traps ou rear delts.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu peito estufado ao begin para desça o corpo para baixo.
Flexione no joelhos e quadril, empurrando o quadril de volta e para baixo como se sitting em uma cadeira.
Desça o corpo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão ou levemente abaixo.
Mantenha seus joelhos alinhados com as pontas dos pés e seu peso nos calcanhares.
Empurre com força pelos calcanhares para ficar em pé novamente, estendendo o quadril e joelhos.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: sled 45° leg press (side pov)
instructions: Adjust the seat of the sled machine so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the sled machine with your back flat against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Push against the footplate to extend your legs, straightening them completely.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly bend your knees to lower the footplate back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled 45° leg press (side pov) is a compound lower body exercise performed on a sled machine. It primarily targets the glutes and also works the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The movement involves pressing a weighted footplate away from the body by extending the legs, then returning to the starting position by bending the knees.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o seat do sled aparelho de modo que seus joelhos estão na 90-degree ângulo when os pés estão no footplate.
Sente-se no sled aparelho com as costas apoiado contra o backrest e os pés na largura dos ombros no footplate.
Pegada as manoplas no lados do seat por stability.
Empurre contra o footplate para estenda as pernas, estendendo os pesos completely.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida lentamente flexione os joelhos para desça o footplate de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: sled 45° leg press (back pov)
instructions: Adjust the seat of the sled machine so that your knees are at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your legs, keeping your heels on the footplate.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position.
Slowly bend your knees and lower the footplate back towards your body, controlling the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled 45° leg press (back POV) is a compound lower body exercise performed on a sled machine. It primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The movement involves extending and flexing the legs to press a weighted footplate away from and toward the body.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o seat do sled aparelho de modo que seus joelhos estão na 45-degree ângulo.
Sente-se no sled aparelho com as costas contra o backrest e os pés na largura dos ombros no footplate.
Pegada as manoplas no lados do seat por stability.
Empurre o footplate longe do corpo por estendendo as pernas, mantendo seus calcanhares no footplate.
Faça uma breve pausa no totalmente estendidos posição.
Lentamente flexione os joelhos e desça o footplate de volta em direção ao corpo, controlling o movimento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: twist hip lift
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands by your sides for support.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
While keeping your hips lifted, twist your lower body to the right side, bringing your knees towards the ground.
Return to the starting position and repeat the twist to the left side.
Continue alternating twists for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The twist hip lift is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, with additional engagement of the obliques and hamstrings. It involves lifting the hips off the ground and twisting the lower body side to side, challenging core stability and hip strength.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas com os joelhos flexionado e pés apoiado no chão.
Posicione as mãos por seu lados por support.
Contraia os glúteos e levante o quadril do chão, forming a linha reta dos joelhos para os ombros.
Enquanto mantendo seus quadris lifted, gire os membros inferiores para a direita lado, aproximando os joelhos em direção ao chão.
Retorne à posição inicial e repita o gire para a esquerda lado.
Continue alternando twists pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: push-up on lower arms
instructions: Start in a plank position with your forearms on the ground and elbows directly below your shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The push-up on lower arms is a bodyweight exercise targeting the triceps, performed from a plank position on the forearms. It also engages the chest and shoulders.
instructions_pt: Inicie na posição de prancha com os antebraços no chão e cotovelos directly abaixo os ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu corpo na linha reta de cabeça para ponta do pé.
Desça o peitoral em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo os pesos junto ao corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: crab twist toe touch
instructions: Start by sitting on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind you, fingers pointing towards your feet, and lift your hips off the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you while simultaneously reaching your opposite hand towards your toes.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The crab twist toe touch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, with additional engagement of the obliques and hip flexors. It involves a dynamic movement pattern that requires coordination and balance, as you alternate reaching your hand to the opposite foot while supporting your body in a crab position.
instructions_pt: Comece sitting no chão com os joelhos flexionado e pés apoiado no chão.
Posicione as mãos atrás você, fingers pointing em direção aos pés, e levante o quadril do chão.
Estenda uma perna estendidos à sua frente enquanto simultaneamente alcançando seu mão oposta em direção às pontas dos pés.
Retorne à posição inicial e Repita do outro lado.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Toque no Pé em Posição de Caranguejo com Giro

name: inchworm
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend forward at the waist and place your hands on the ground in front of you.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a high plank position, with your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Pause for a moment, then walk your hands back towards your feet, keeping your legs as straight as possible.
Once your hands reach your feet, stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The inchworm is a bodyweight exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the shoulders and hamstrings. It involves bending forward, walking your hands out to a plank, and then returning to standing, which challenges core stability, flexibility, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Inicie na posição em pé com os pés na largura do quadril.
Flexione para a frente no waist e posicione as mãos no chão à sua frente.
Walk as mãos para a frente até você estão na alto posição de prancha, com o corpo na linha reta de cabeça para ponta do pé.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida walk as mãos de volta em direção aos pés, mantendo seu pernas as reto as possible.
Once as mãos alcance os pés, fique em pé novamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: forward jump
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Swing your arms back for momentum.
Jump forward explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next jump.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The forward jump is a plyometric exercise that targets the quadriceps and also works the calves, hamstrings, and glutes. It involves jumping forward explosively from a squat position and landing softly, then repeating the movement.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Flexione os joelhos e desça o corpo em posição de agachamento.
Swing os braços de volta por momentum.
Salte para a frente explosively, estendendo o quadril, joelhos, e tornozelos.
Aterrisse suavemente no balls dos pés e immediately go no next salte.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: backward jump
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and jump backwards, pushing off with both feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The backward jump is a plyometric exercise that targets the quadriceps while also engaging the hamstrings, glutes, and calves. It involves jumping backward from a standing position, requiring coordination, balance, and explosive power.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e salte backwards, empurrando de com ambos os pés.
Aterrisse suavemente no balls dos pés, flexionando os joelhos para absorb o impact.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: one leg squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one leg forward, keeping it off the ground.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down as if sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
description: The one leg squat, also known as a pistol squat, is a challenging lower body exercise that targets the glutes while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It requires significant balance, strength, and coordination, as you lower your body on one leg while keeping the other leg extended off the ground.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Estenda uma perna para a frente, mantendo o peso do chão.
Flexione seu standing perna e desça o corpo para baixo como se sentando em uma cadeira.
Mantenha seu peito estufado e as costas reto.
Empurre pelo calcanhar para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita com o outro perna.

name: lever incline chest press v. 2
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest angle on the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles forward and away from your body until your arms are fully extended, but without locking your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly bend your elbows and lower the handles back towards your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever incline chest press v. 2 is a machine-based exercise that targets the pectoral muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. It involves pressing handles away from the body while seated on a leverage machine, simulating an incline bench press motion.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e backrest ângulo no leverage aparelho para a comfortable posição.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o backrest e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas com pegada pronada e posição suas mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Empurre as manoplas para a frente e longe do corpo até os braços estão totalmente estendidos, but sem travar os cotovelos.
Faça uma breve pausa no totalmente estendidos posição, em seguida lentamente flexione os cotovelos e desça as manoplas de volta em direção ao peitoral.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
