instructions: Adopt a fighting stance with the rear foot behind, knees soft, hands up, and core braced.
Pivot on the ball of the lead foot to open the hips while keeping the torso tall.
Chamber the rear leg by lifting the knee out to the side (hip abduction) with the knee bent and foot dorsiflexed.
Sweep the lower leg inward in a horizontal arc, adducting the hip to ‘hook’ the target and striking with the heel or back of the foot.
Re-chamber the leg immediately, then place it back to the starting stance under control.
Exhale on the strike, keep the supporting knee soft, and avoid locking the kicking knee or over-rotating the hips.
description: From a fighting stance, lift the rear leg to the side and sweep the heel inward across the target in a hooking motion. Pivot on the lead foot, keep the core braced, and maintain your guard throughout.
instructions_pt: Adopt a fighting stance com o rear pé atrás, joelhos soft, mãos para cima, e core braced.
Pivot no bola do lead pé para open o quadril enquanto mantendo o tronco tall.
Chamber o rear perna por levantando o joelho para fora para o lado (quadril abduction) com o joelho flexionado e pé dorsiflexed.
Sweep o desça perna para dentro na horizontal arc, adducting o quadril para 'hook' o target e striking com o calcanhar ou de volta do pé.
Recolha a perna imediatamente e retorne à posição inicial de guarda com controle.
Expire no strike, mantenha o supporting joelho soft, e avoid locking o kicking joelho ou sobre-girando o quadril.

name: front leg hook kick
instructions: Stand in fighting stance with the lead foot forward, hands up, and most of your weight on the rear leg.
Pivot on the rear/support foot to open the hips and point the heel slightly outward.
Chamber the lead leg: lift the knee to hip height with the thigh slightly out to the side; dorsiflex the ankle so the toes pull back.
Extend the lower leg a bit past the target, then sweep the foot inward across the midline in a hooking arc, striking with the heel/edge of the sole.
Keep the core braced and the torso upright; do not hyperextend the knee at extension.
Retract the leg immediately along the same path and place the foot down to the starting stance.
Repeat for controlled reps, then switch sides.
description: From a fighting stance, lift the lead knee and perform a hook kick by extending slightly past the target, then sweeping inward to strike with the heel. Return the foot to the floor under control while keeping the torso tall and guard up.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé em fighting stance com o lead pé para a frente, mãos para cima, e most de seu peso no rear perna.
Pivot no rear/support pé para open o quadril e point o calcanhar levemente para fora.
Chamber o lead perna: levante o joelho para quadril altura com o coxa levemente para fora para o lado; dorsiflex o tornozelo so o pontas dos pés puxe de volta.
Estenda o desça perna a bit past o target, em seguida sweep o pé para dentro através do midline na hooking arc, striking com o calcanhar/edge do sole.
Mantenha o core braced e o tronco upright; do not hyperextend o joelho em extension.
Recolha a perna imediatamente pela mesma trajetória e apoie o pé no chão na base inicial.
Repita por controlled reps, em seguida troque lados.

name: front groin kick
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance, feet hip-width apart, knees soft, hands guarding your chin.
Brace your core and center your weight over the support leg without leaning back.
Lift the lead knee toward your chest to chamber the kick, toes pointed slightly downward.
Snap the lower leg forward to groin height, striking with the instep/top of the foot.
Do not lock the knee at extension; stop the kick under control.
Immediately bend the knee to retract the leg along the same path.
Set the foot back under your hip to your original stance and reestablish balance.
Repeat for reps, then switch legs, maintaining posture throughout.
description: Stand in a fighting stance with hands up. Lift the knee and snap the foot forward to groin height striking with the instep, then quickly retract and return to stance.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé na staggered stance, pés na largura do quadril, joelhos soft, mãos guarding o queixo.
Brace o core e center seu peso sobre o support perna sem inclinando de volta.
Levante o lead joelho toward o peitoral para chamber o kick, pontas dos pés pointed levemente para baixo.
Snap o desça perna para a frente para groin altura, striking com o instep/topo do pé.
Do not lock o joelho em extension; stop o kick sob control.
Immediately flexione o joelho para retract o perna along o same path.
Set o pé de volta sob o quadril para seu original stance e reestablish balance.
Repita por reps, em seguida troque pernas, mantendo posture throughout.

name: rear axe kick
instructions: Adopt a fighting stance with feet staggered, hands up, and core braced.
Shift weight to the lead leg and lift the rear knee, dorsiflexing the ankle (toes toward shin).
Extend the rear leg upward in front of you, keeping the leg mostly straight and torso tall.
At your top range, hinge from the hip and drive the heel straight down along the same line.
Land softly with the heel first, then the whole foot, near your centerline.
Retract the leg immediately and return to your fighting stance.
Keep the pelvis neutral, avoid hyperextending the low back, and do not lock the knee at the bottom.
description: From a fighting stance, lift the rear leg straight up in front of you and then drive the heel straight down like an axe before returning to stance. Keep the core braced and the foot dorsiflexed to strike with the heel.
instructions_pt: Adopt a fighting stance com pés staggered, mãos para cima, e core braced.
Shift peso para o lead perna e levante o rear joelho, dorsiflexing o tornozelo (pontas dos pés toward shin).
Estenda o rear perna para cima à sua frente, mantendo o perna mostly reto e tronco tall.
Em seu topo range, incline o tronco do quadril e empurre com força o calcanhar reto para baixo along o same line.
Aterrisse suavemente com o calcanhar first, em seguida o whole pé, near seu centerline.
Retract o perna immediately e retorne para seu fighting stance.
Mantenha o pelvis neutral, avoid hyperextending o baixo de volta, e do not lock o joelho embaixo.

name: front snap kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with one foot forward, hands up, and core braced.
Shift weight to the support leg, keeping a slight bend in that knee and hips square.
Chamber the kick: lift the knee of the kicking leg to about hip height; plantarflex the ankle and pull the toes back to expose the ball of the foot.
Snap the kick forward by rapidly extending the knee, striking a low–to–mid target; exhale and keep the torso tall.
Re-chamber immediately by bending the knee and bringing the heel back under the hip (do not lock the kicking knee).
Set the foot down under control into your stance and repeat for reps, then switch sides.
description: From a fighting stance, lift (chamber) the knee and snap the lower leg forward to strike with the ball of the foot. Re-chamber immediately and return to your stance while maintaining balance and a braced core.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé na fighting stance com um pé para a frente, mãos para cima, e core braced.
Shift peso para o support perna, mantendo a slight flexione em that joelho e quadril square.
Chamber o kick: levante o joelho do kicking perna para about quadril altura; plantarflex o tornozelo e puxe o pontas dos pés de volta para expose o bola do pé.
Snap o kick para a frente por rapidly estendendo o joelho, striking a baixo-para-mid target; expire e mantenha o tronco tall.
Re-chamber immediately por flexionando o joelho e aproximando o calcanhar de volta sob o quadril (do not lock o kicking joelho).
Set o pé para baixo sob control into seu stance e repita por reps, em seguida troque lados.

name: spin hook kick
instructions: Start in a fighting stance with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and hands up.
Pivot on the lead foot and turn your head and shoulders first to spot the target, initiating the spin.
Rotate hips and torso, keeping the support heel turned outward to protect the knee.
Chamber the kicking leg by lifting the knee to the side (abduction) with the knee slightly bent.
Extend the leg and sweep the heel across in a hooking path, striking with the back of the heel at the target height.
Keep the core braced and torso upright; do not hyperextend the knee on contact.
Re-chamber the leg after the strike and place it down under control, returning to stance.
Reset balance, then repeat on the same or opposite side.
description: From a fighting stance, rotate and extend the leg in a sweeping arc to strike with the heel as you complete a spin. Maintain a tall posture and controlled re-chamber to return to stance.
instructions_pt: Inicie na fighting stance com pés na largura dos ombros, joelhos soft, e mãos para cima.
Pivot no lead pé e turn a cabeça e ombros first para spot o target, initiating o spin.
Gire quadril e tronco, mantendo o support calcanhar turned para fora para protect o joelho.
Chamber o kicking perna por levantando o joelho para o lado (abduction) com o joelho levemente flexionados.
Estenda o perna e sweep o calcanhar através de na hooking path, striking com o de volta do calcanhar no target altura.
Mantenha o core braced e tronco upright; do not hyperextend o joelho em contact.
Re-chamber o perna after o strike e posicione o peso para baixo sob control, retornando para stance.
Reset balance, em seguida repita no same ou lado oposto.

name: side kick
instructions: Stand tall in a fighting stance, feet hip-width, hands up, core braced.
Shift weight to the supporting leg, bend it slightly, and pivot the supporting foot so toes turn away from the kicking side.
Lift the opposite knee toward the chest (chamber), heel tucked, toes pulled back, hips stacked.
Extend the leg out to the side, driving the heel toward the target at about hip height; keep the knee soft—do not lock out.
Keep torso upright and pelvis level; maintain a neutral spine throughout.
Briefly hold, then re-chamber the knee along the same path.
Lower the foot to the floor under control and repeat; switch sides evenly.
description: From an athletic stance, chamber the knee and drive a controlled side kick, leading with the heel. Pivot on the supporting foot, then re-chamber and lower under control.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé tall na fighting stance, pés quadril-largura, mãos para cima, core braced.
Shift peso para o supporting perna, flexione o peso levemente, e pivot o supporting pé so pontas dos pés turn longe do kicking lado.
Levante o joelho oposto toward o peitoral (chamber), calcanhar tucked, pontas dos pés pulled de volta, quadril stacked.
Estenda o perna para fora para o lado, driving o calcanhar toward o target em about quadril altura; mantenha o joelho soft-do not Estenda sem travar bruscamente.
Mantenha tronco upright e pelvis altura; mantenha a neutral spine throughout.
Briefly segure, em seguida re-chamber o joelho along o same path.
Desça o pé para o chão sob control e repita; troque lados evenly.

name: roundhouse kick
instructions: Stand in fighting stance with feet shoulder-width, rear heel slightly raised and hands up to guard.
Shift weight to the support leg, pivot that foot so the heel turns outward and the hips open.
Chamber the kicking leg by lifting the knee across the body with the shin parallel to the floor.
Snap the kick by rapidly extending the knee, striking with the shin or instep; exhale on impact.
Keep the torso upright, core tight, and eyes on target throughout.
Re-chamber the leg immediately, then place it down under control and return to stance.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides.
description: From a fighting stance, pivot on the support foot, rotate the hips, and snap the lead leg across the target, then re-chamber and return to stance. Strike with the shin or instep while keeping the core braced and guard up.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé em fighting stance com pés ombro-largura, rear calcanhar levemente raised e mãos para cima para guard.
Shift peso para o support perna, pivot that pé so o calcanhar turns para fora e o quadril open.
Chamber o kicking perna por levantando o joelho através do corpo com o shin paralelos ao chão.
Snap o kick por rapidly estendendo o joelho, striking com o shin ou instep; expire em impact.
Mantenha o tronco upright, core tight, e eyes em target throughout.
Re-chamber o perna immediately, em seguida posicione o peso para baixo sob control e retorne para stance.
Repita por reps, em seguida troque lados.

name: heel push kick
instructions: Stand in a staggered stance with hands up, feet hip‑width, core braced, and eyes forward.
Lift the lead knee toward the chest (hip flex), keeping the ankle dorsiflexed so toes point up.
Drive the hips forward and extend the knee to push straight out, striking with the center of the heel.
Keep the supporting foot rooted and pelvis level; avoid leaning back or rotating the hips.
Stop short of locking the knee, then immediately re‑chamber by bending the knee and pulling the leg back.
Return the foot to the floor under control and reset in your stance.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides to train both legs.
description: Stand in a fighting stance, raise the lead knee (chamber), then drive the heel straight forward to push the target before quickly re‑chambering and returning to stance. Keep the torso tall and strike with the heel by pulling the toes up.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé na staggered stance com mãos para cima, pés quadril‑largura, core braced, e eyes para a frente.
Levante o lead joelho toward o peitoral (quadril flex), mantendo o tornozelo dorsiflexed so pontas dos pés point para cima.
Empurre com força o quadril para a frente e estenda o joelho para empurre estendidos, striking com o center do calcanhar.
Mantenha o supporting pé rooted e pelvis altura; avoid inclinando de volta ou girando o quadril.
Stop short de locking o joelho, em seguida immediately re‑chamber por flexionando o joelho e puxando o perna de volta.
Retorne o pé para o chão sob control e reset em seu stance.
Repita por reps, em seguida troque lados para train ambos os pernas.

name: spin back kick
instructions: Stand in a fighting stance with feet shoulder-width and hands up.
Shift weight to the lead leg and pivot on its ball, turning your hips and head to spot the target over your shoulder.
Chamber the rear leg by bringing the knee across and heel toward the glute, toes pointing down.
Extend the hip and knee to drive the heel straight back along a linear path, striking with the heel.
Keep the core braced and torso slightly inclined forward; maintain balance on the supporting foot.
Re-chamber the leg immediately after contact, then set it down and return to your stance.
description: From a fighting stance, rotate on the lead foot, look over your shoulder, then chamber the rear leg and drive the heel straight back. Re-chamber and return to your stance under control.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé na fighting stance com pés ombro-largura e mãos para cima.
Shift peso para o lead perna e pivot em its bola, turning o quadril e cabeça para spot o target sobre o ombro.
Chamber o rear perna por aproximando o joelho através de e calcanhar toward o glute, pontas dos pés pointing para baixo.
Estenda o quadril e joelho para empurre com força o calcanhar reto de volta along a linear path, striking com o calcanhar.
Mantenha o core braced e tronco levemente inclined para a frente; mantenha balance no supporting pé.
Re-chamber o perna immediately after contact, em seguida set o peso para baixo e retorne para seu stance.

name: walking on stepmill
instructions: Adjust the stepmill machine to a comfortable level.
Step onto the machine and place your hands on the handrails for support.
Start walking by placing one foot on a step and then the other, alternating between legs.
Maintain an upright posture and engage your core muscles.
Continue walking for the desired duration or distance.
Gradually increase the intensity or speed as you become more comfortable with the exercise.
Remember to cool down and stretch after completing the exercise.
description: Walking on a stepmill is a cardiovascular exercise performed on a machine that simulates stair climbing. It primarily targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the lower body muscles.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o stepmill aparelho para a comfortable altura.
Dê um passo no aparelho e posicione as mãos no handrails por support.
Inicie walking por placing um pé na dê um passo e em seguida o outro, alternando entre pernas.
Mantenha an upright posture e contraia os músculos do core.
Continue walking pelo desejado duration ou distance.
Gradually increase o intensity ou speed ao become more comfortable com o exercise.
Remember para cool para baixo e alongamento after completing o exercise.

name: lying elbow to knee
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ground, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight out and lift it off the ground.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time bringing your left elbow towards your right knee and extending your left leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lying elbow to knee is a bodyweight abdominal exercise that targets the abs, with secondary emphasis on the hip flexors and lower back. It involves alternating elbow-to-knee movements while lying on your back, engaging the core and promoting coordination.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraia o abdômen e levante o tronco do chão, aproximando seu cotovelo direito em direção ao joelho esquerdo.
No same time, estenda seu perna direita estendidos e levante o peso do chão.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida retorne à posição inicial.
Repita o movimento, this time aproximando seu cotovelo esquerdo em direção ao joelho direito e estendendo seu perna esquerda.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever rotary calf
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet, raising your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever rotary calf exercise targets the calves using a leverage machine. It involves raising and lowering the heels while seated, focusing on the calf muscles and ankle stabilizers.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco de modo que seus joelhos estão levemente flexionados e os pés estão apoiado no footplate.
Posicione as pontas dos pés no footplate, com os calcanhares livres para fora da borda.
Segure as manoplas ou o lados do aparelho por stability.
Empurre através do balls dos pés, elevando os calcanhares as alto as possible.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell seated bent arm lateral raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body and your arms bent at a 90-degree angle.
Keeping your elbows bent, raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated bent arm lateral raise targets the deltoid muscles in the shoulders, with secondary emphasis on the trapezius and rhomboids. It is performed while seated, which helps stabilize the body and focus the effort on the shoulders.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com as costas retas e os pés firmes no chão.
Segure um halter em cada mão com suas palmas voltadas para o corpo e os braços flexionado a 90 graus.
Mantendo seus cotovelos flexionado, eleve os braços para fora para o lados até they estejam paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os braços de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação Lateral Sentado com Braços Dobrados

name: lever shoulder press v. 3
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles of the machine with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles upward and forward until your arms are fully extended, but not locked.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever shoulder press v. 3 is a machine-based exercise targeting the deltoid muscles of the shoulders. It also engages the triceps and chest as secondary muscles. The movement involves pressing handles upward and forward while seated, providing a stable and controlled environment for developing shoulder strength.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e backrest do leverage aparelho para a comfortable posição.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o backrest e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas do aparelho com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Empurre as manoplas para cima e para a frente até os braços estão totalmente estendidos, but not locked.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente as manoplas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento para Ombros na Máquina Articulada

name: dumbbell standing inner biceps curl v. 2
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
While holding your upper arms stationary, curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing inner biceps curl v. 2 is a strength exercise that targets the biceps, with secondary emphasis on the forearms. It involves curling dumbbells while standing, focusing on strict form and biceps contraction.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para o tronco.
Mantenha seus cotovelos próximo ao tronco e gire o palms das mãos até they estão virado para para a frente.
Enquanto segurando os braços stationary, flexione os pesos enquanto contraindo os bíceps.
Continue para eleve os pesos até os bíceps estão totalmente contraído e os halteres estão na altura dos ombros.
Sustente a posição contraída por um instante, contraindo ao máximo os bíceps.
Lentamente begin para aproxime os halteres de volta à posição inicial as seu breathe em.
Repita pelo recommended amount de repetições.
name_pt: Rosca Bíceps em Pé com Halteres

name: dumbbell reverse grip row (female)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let your arms hang straight down, fully extended, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell reverse grip row is a strength exercise targeting the upper back, performed with dumbbells and a reverse (underhand) grip. It also engages the biceps and forearms.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure um halter em cada mão com pegada pronada, palmas voltadas para o corpo.
Flexione para a frente no waist, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Mantenha os braços hang reto para baixo, totalmente estendidos, com a slight flexione nos cotovelos.
Puxe os halteres para cima em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os halteres à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: narrow push-up on exercise ball
instructions: Place the stability ball on the ground and position yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the ball, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Lower your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The narrow push-up on an exercise ball is a challenging upper body exercise that targets the triceps while also engaging the chest and shoulders. The instability of the ball increases the demand on core stability and balance.
instructions_pt: Posicione o bola suíça no chão e posição yourself na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos no bola, levemente narrower than na largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu corpo na linha reta de cabeça para ponta do pé.
Desça o peitoral em direção ao bola flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo os pesos junto ao corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Flexão de Braço Pegada Fechada na Bola Suíça

name: spine twist
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to the right, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the left side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The spine twist is a bodyweight exercise that targets the abs, obliques, and lower back. It involves sitting on the ground, engaging the core, and twisting the torso side to side, which helps improve core strength and mobility.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com seu pernas estendidas à sua frente.
Flexione os joelhos e posicione os pés apoiado no chão, na largura do quadril.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente gire o tronco para a direita, aproximando seu cotovelo direito em direção ao joelho esquerdo.
Faça uma breve pausa no end do gire, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita o gire para a esquerda lado, aproximando seu cotovelo esquerdo em direção ao joelho direito.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: cable lat pulldown full range of motion
instructions: Sit on the lat pulldown machine with your knees positioned under the pads.
Grasp the cable bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable lat pulldown full range of motion is a strength exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) using a cable machine. It also engages the biceps, rhomboids, and rear deltoids. The movement involves pulling a cable bar down towards the chest while seated, emphasizing a full range of motion for optimal muscle activation.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no lat pulldown aparelho com os joelhos positioned sob o apoios.
Segure o cabo bar com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Incline de volta levemente e mantenha seu peito estufado, mantendo a slight arch em seu desça de volta.
Puxe a barra para baixo em direção a seu peitoral superior, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: cycle cross trainer
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the cycle cross trainer.
Place your feet on the pedals and grip the handlebars.
Start pedaling in a smooth and controlled motion.
Maintain a steady pace and increase the resistance if desired.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
description: The cycle cross trainer is a cardiovascular exercise performed on a leverage machine, targeting the cardiovascular system while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes. It is performed by pedaling in a smooth and controlled motion, with adjustable resistance for varying intensity.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no cycle cruze trainer.
Posicione os pés no pedals e pegada o handlebars.
Inicie pedaling na smooth e controlled movimento.
Mantenha a steady pace e increase o resistance if desejado.
Continue pedaling pelo desejado duration de seu cardio workout.

name: arm slingers hanging straight legs
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your legs straight down.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The arm slingers hanging straight legs exercise involves hanging from a pull-up bar and lifting your straight legs up in front of you, targeting the abdominal muscles while also engaging the shoulders and back.
instructions_pt: Fique suspenso na barra fixa com os braços totalmente estendidos e as pernas reto para baixo.
Contraia o abdômen e levante as pernas para cima à sua frente até they estejam paralelas ao chão.
Segure por um instante no topo, em seguida desça lentamente as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação de Pernas Estendidas nas Tiras de Braço (Ab Straps)

name: sled lying calf press
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the platform.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform, with your heels hanging off.
Push the platform away from you by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Continue pushing until your calves are fully contracted.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower the platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled lying calf press is a machine-based exercise targeting the calves, performed by pressing a weighted sled away using the balls of the feet while lying on the machine.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o sled aparelho para a comfortable peso.
Sente-se no sled aparelho com as costas contra o apoio e os pés no platform.
Posicione as pontas dos pés e o balls dos pés no edge do platform, com os calcanhares livres para fora.
Empurre o platform longe de você por estendendo seu tornozelos, mantendo os joelhos levemente flexionados.
Continue empurrando até as panturrilhas estão totalmente contraído.
Segure o contração pela instante, em seguida desça lentamente o platform de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Panturrilha no Leg Press Horizontal / Trenó

name: lever seated calf press
instructions: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Place your toes on the lower portion of the platform and position your knees under the lever pad.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Press the lever pad down by extending your ankles, lifting your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated calf press is a machine-based exercise targeting the calf muscles. It involves pressing a weighted lever with the balls of your feet while seated, focusing on ankle extension to work the calves.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o seat do aparelho de modo que seus ombros estão aligned com o lever apoio.
Posicione as pontas dos pés no desça portion do platform e posição os joelhos sob o lever apoio.
Segure as manoplas no lados do seat por stability.
Empurre o lever apoio para baixo por estendendo seu tornozelos, levantando os calcanhares as alto as possible.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente os calcanhares de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: arm slingers hanging bent knee legs
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, bringing them as close to your elbows as possible.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The arm slingers hanging bent knee legs exercise targets the abdominal muscles by requiring you to hang from a pull-up bar and lift your knees towards your chest. This movement also engages the shoulders and back for stabilization.
instructions_pt: Fique suspenso na barra fixa com os braços totalmente estendidos e os joelhos flexionado a 90 graus.
Contraia o abdômen e levante os joelhos em direção ao peitoral, aproximando os pesos as próximo aos cotovelos as possible.
Lentamente desça as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação de Joelhos nas Tiras de Braço (Ab Straps)

name: wide-grip chest dip on high parallel bars
instructions: Position yourself on the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Lean forward slightly and lower your body by bending your elbows until your chest is just above the bars.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The wide-grip chest dip on high parallel bars is a bodyweight exercise that targets the pectoral muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. It requires significant upper body strength, stability, and control, as well as experience with dip movements.
instructions_pt: Posição yourself no barras paralelas com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo suspended no air.
Incline para a frente levemente e desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos até o peitoral está just acima o bars.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: assisted wide-grip chest dip (kneeling)
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired height and secure your knees on the pad.
Grasp the handles with a wide grip and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The assisted wide-grip chest dip (kneeling) is a machine-based exercise targeting the pectorals, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. The assistance from the machine makes it accessible for those who may not yet have the strength for unassisted dips.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho para seu altura desejada e trave os joelhos no apoio.
Segure as manoplas com pegada aberta e mantenha seus cotovelos levemente flexionados.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos até os braços estejam paralelas ao chão.
Empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Mergulho nas Paralelas Ajoelhado Pegada Aberta Assistido

name: split squats
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with one foot and place it about two feet in front of the other foot.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: Split squats are a lower body exercise that primarily targets the quadriceps, while also engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. This bodyweight movement involves stepping forward into a split stance and lowering the body until the front thigh is parallel to the ground, then returning to the starting position.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Take a dê um passo para a frente com um pé e posicione o peso about dois pés em frente ao outro pé.
Desça o corpo flexionando os joelhos e o quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Continue descendo até seu frente coxa está paralelo ao chão, e as costas joelho está hovering just acima o chão.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre através de seu frente calcanhar para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições, em seguida troque pernas e repita.

name: weighted russian twist v. 2
instructions: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold the weight with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly to engage your core muscles.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the weight towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted Russian twist v.2 is a core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles, particularly the obliques, by incorporating rotational movement with added resistance. It requires balance, coordination, and core strength.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com os joelhos flexionado e pés apoiado no chão.
Segure a carga com ambas as mãos em frente ao peitoral.
Incline de volta levemente para contraia os músculos do core.
Gire o tronco para a direita, aproximando a carga em direção ao lado direito do corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida gire o tronco para a esquerda, aproximando a carga em direção ao lado esquerdo do corpo.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Russian Twist V. 2 com Carga Adicional

name: dumbbell scott press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell Scott press is a shoulder exercise performed while seated, pressing dumbbells overhead to target the deltoid muscles.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para a frente.
Eleve os halteres até a altura dos ombros, com os cotovelos flexionado e palmas voltadas para a frente.
Empurre os halteres para cima até os braços estão totalmente estendidos.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os halteres à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: close-grip push-up (on knees)
instructions: Start by getting on your hands and knees, with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees hip-width apart.
Lower your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The close-grip push-up (on knees) is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It is performed from a kneeling position, making it more accessible for beginners and those building upper body strength.
instructions_pt: Comece getting nas mãos e joelhos, com as mãos na largura dos ombros e os joelhos na largura do quadril.
Desça o tronco em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo os pesos próximo a seu lados.
Faça uma breve pausa when o peitoral está just acima o chão.
Empurre através de seu palms para straighten os braços e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: cable seated twist
instructions: Sit on a cable machine with your feet flat on the ground and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the cable handle with both hands and extend your arms straight in front of you.
Keeping your core engaged, slowly rotate your torso to one side, pulling the cable across your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the range of motion, then slowly rotate back to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable seated twist is an exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, particularly the obliques, using a cable machine. It involves rotating the torso while seated, providing resistance throughout the movement.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na máquina de polia com os pés apoiado no chão e os joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure o cabo manopla com ambas as mãos e estenda os braços reto à sua frente.
Mantendo o abdômen contraído, lentamente gire o tronco para um lado, puxando o cabo através do corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa no end do range de movimento, em seguida lentamente gire de volta à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Rotação de Tronco Sentado na Polia

name: inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine)
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle straps are at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs extended and the ankle straps attached to your feet.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Bend your knees and curl your legs towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstrings.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine) is a bodyweight exercise targeting the hamstrings, with secondary emphasis on the glutes and calves. It involves lying face down, attaching ankle straps to a cable machine, and curling the legs towards the glutes.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o máquina de polia de modo que o tornozelo straps estão no lowest setting.
Deite-se de bruços no banco com seu pernas estendidas e o tornozelo straps preso para os pés.
Segure-se nas manoplas do banco por stability.
Flexione os joelhos e flexione as pernas em direção aos glúteos, contraindo os posteriores de coxa.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell biceps curl (with arm blaster)
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell biceps curl (with arm blaster) is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, using a specialized arm blaster to maintain strict form and minimize shoulder involvement. This exercise is performed with dumbbells and emphasizes biceps strength and hypertrophy.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para a frente.
Mantenha seus cotovelos próximo ao tronco e os braços stationary.
Expire e flexione os pesos enquanto contraindo os bíceps.
Continue para eleve os pesos até os bíceps estão totalmente contraído e os halteres estão na altura dos ombros.
Sustente a posição contraída por um instante, contraindo ao máximo os bíceps.
Inspire e comece a descer lentamente os halteres de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell hammer curls (with arm blaster)
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
This will be your starting position.
Now, while holding your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell hammer curl with arm blaster is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps and forearms. The arm blaster helps maintain proper form by preventing the elbows from moving forward, increasing biceps activation.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para o tronco.
Mantenha seus cotovelos próximo ao tronco e gire o palms das mãos até they estão virado para para a frente.
This will be seu posição inicial.
Now, enquanto segurando o braço stationary, expire e flexione os pesos enquanto contraindo os bíceps.
Continue para eleve os pesos até os bíceps estão totalmente contraído e os halteres estão na altura dos ombros.
Sustente a posição contraída por um instante, contraindo ao máximo os bíceps.
Em seguida, inspire e lentamente begin para desça os halteres de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo recommended amount de repetições.
name_pt: Rosca Martelo com Halteres e Arm Blaster

name: dumbbell alternate biceps curl (with arm blaster)
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Place the arm blaster on your upper arms, ensuring a secure fit.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with the opposite arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell alternate biceps curl (with arm blaster) is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, using an arm blaster to maintain strict form and minimize shoulder involvement. This exercise is performed by alternately curling dumbbells while keeping the upper arms stationary against the arm blaster.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para a frente.
Posicione o braço blaster nos braços, garantindo que a trave fit.
Mantendo os braços firmes e imóveis, expire e flexione um halter para cima em direção ao ombro enquanto contraindo os bíceps.
Continue para eleve o halter até os bíceps estão totalmente contraído e o halter está na altura dos ombros.
Sustente a posição contraída por um instante, contraindo ao máximo os bíceps.
Inspire e desça lentamente o halter de volta à posição inicial.
Repita o movimento com o braço oposto.
Continue alternando os braços pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: ez-bar biceps curl (with arm blaster)
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Place your upper arms against the arm blaster, keeping them stationary throughout the exercise.
Keeping your elbows close to your body, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ-bar biceps curl (with arm blaster) is a strength exercise targeting the biceps, using an EZ barbell and an arm blaster to isolate the upper arms and minimize cheating. It is performed standing, with the upper arms stabilized against the arm blaster, curling the barbell upward and then lowering it under control.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure o ez barra com pegada supinada, palmas voltadas para cima.
Posicione os braços contra o braço blaster, mantendo os pesos stationary throughout o exercise.
Mantendo os cotovelos junto ao corpo, expire e flexione a barra para cima em direção aos ombros.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, contraindo bem os bíceps.
Inspire e desça a barra lentamente de volta à posição inicial, totalmente estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: cable triceps pushdown (v-bar) (with arm blaster)
instructions: Attach a v-bar attachment to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Engage your triceps and exhale as you push the v-bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your triceps.
Inhale as you slowly return the v-bar to the starting position, maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable triceps pushdown (v-bar) with arm blaster is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed using a cable machine and a v-bar attachment. The arm blaster helps keep the upper arms stationary, increasing triceps engagement.
instructions_pt: Prenda a v-bar attachment para o máquina de polia no highest setting.
Fique de frente para a polia com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Segure o v-bar com pegada pronada, palmas voltadas para baixo, e suas mãos na largura dos ombros.
Mantenha seus cotovelos próximo a seu lados e os braços stationary throughout o exercise.
Contraia os tríceps e expire ao empurre o v-bar para baixo até os braços estão totalmente estendidos.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo do movimento, contraindo os tríceps.
Inspire enquanto retorna lentamente o v-bar à posição inicial, mantendo o controle.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Tríceps Pulley na Polia com Barra V e Arm Blaster

name: cable reverse grip triceps pushdown (sz-bar) (with arm blaster)
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Engage your triceps and slowly push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable reverse grip triceps pushdown (sz-bar) with arm blaster is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, using a cable machine and an underhand grip for increased emphasis on the triceps' long head. The arm blaster helps keep the upper arms stationary, improving form and muscle engagement.
instructions_pt: Prenda a reto bar para o máquina de polia no highest setting.
Fique de frente para a polia com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Segure a barra com pegada supinada, palmas voltadas para cima, e suas mãos na largura dos ombros.
Mantenha seus cotovelos próximo a seu lados e os braços stationary throughout o exercise.
Contraia os tríceps e lentamente empurre a barra para baixo até os braços estão totalmente estendidos.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida retorne lentamente a barra à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Tríceps Pulley Pegada Supinada na Polia

name: barbell biceps curl (with arm blaster)
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Place your upper arms against the arm blaster, keeping your elbows close to your torso.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell biceps curl with arm blaster is a strength exercise that isolates the biceps by preventing elbow movement and reducing cheating. The arm blaster helps maintain proper form, making the exercise more effective for targeting the biceps.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure uma barra com pegada supinada, palmas voltadas para cima.
Posicione os braços contra o braço blaster, mantendo seus cotovelos próximo ao tronco.
Mantendo os braços firmes e imóveis, expire e flexione os antebraços contraindo os bíceps.
Continue para eleve a barra até os bíceps estão totalmente contraído e a barra está na altura dos ombros.
Sustente a posição contraída por um instante, contraindo ao máximo os bíceps.
Inspire e lentamente begin para desça a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: weighted lying neck extension (with head harness)
instructions: Set an incline bench and attach the head harness so the chain and plate hang directly below the back of your head.
Lie prone with chest on the bench, hips anchored, toes on the floor, and head past the edge.
Brace your core, depress and retract the shoulders; begin with the neck slightly flexed (chin gently tucked).
Extend the neck to lift your head until it aligns with your torso—avoid hyperextension or swinging.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping the torso still.
Lower your head slowly to the start position, maintaining control and a neutral upper back.
Use light to moderate load and stop if you feel sharp neck discomfort.
description: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest supported and head hanging off the edge, wearing a head harness with a weight plate attached. Extend the neck to lift the head to neutral, then lower slowly under control.
instructions_pt: Aviso de Segurança (Uso Avançado / Lutas): exercício de alta exigência cervical indicado exclusivamente para preparação física específica e reabilitação orientada. Utilize cargas mínimas e movimento lento e estritamente controlado. Interrompa em caso de dor ou formigamento. Set an incline banco e prenda o fita de cabeça (head harness) so o chain e plate hang directly abaixo o de volta da cabeça.
Deite-se prone com peitoral no banco, quadril anchored, pontas dos pés no chão, e cabeça past o edge.
Brace o core, depress e retract o ombros; begin com o pescoço levemente flexed (chin gently tucked).
Estenda o pescoço para levante a cabeça até o peso aligns com o tronco-avoid hyperextension ou swinging.
Faça uma pausa breve no topo enquanto mantendo o tronco still.
Desça a cabeça lentamente para o inicie posição, mantendo o controle e a neutral upper de volta.
Use light para moderate load e stop if você feel sharp pescoço discomfort.
name_pt: Extensão Cervical Deitado com Carga (Head Harness)

name: weighted lying neck flexion (with head harness)
instructions: Set a flat bench and lie on your back with shoulders near the edge so your head can move freely; plant your feet and brace your torso.
Fit the head harness snugly and attach a light plate so it provides resistance as you flex the neck.
Start with the neck slightly extended below neutral, eyes up, shoulders relaxed and down.
Initiate with a gentle nod, then curl your chin toward your chest by segmentally flexing the cervical spine.
Pause briefly in the top position without lifting the shoulders or hips.
Lower slowly for 2–3 seconds back to a slight, comfortable extension; keep the motion smooth and pain‑free.
Maintain steady breathing and keep reps strict; stop if form or control degrades.
description: Lie supine on a bench with your head off the edge, wearing a head harness attached to a light weight. Flex the neck to bring the chin toward the chest, then lower under control through a comfortable range.
instructions_pt: Aviso de Segurança (Uso Avançado / Lutas): exercício de alta exigência cervical indicado exclusivamente para preparação física específica e reabilitação orientada. Utilize cargas mínimas e movimento lento e estritamente controlado. Interrompa em caso de dor ou formigamento. Set a apoiado banco e Deite-se de costas com ombros near o edge so a cabeça can move freely; plant os pés e brace o tronco.
Fit o fita de cabeça (head harness) snugly e Prenda uma anilha leve so o peso provides resistance ao flex o pescoço.
Comece com o pescoço levemente estendido abaixo neutral, eyes para cima, ombros relaxed e para baixo.
Initiate com a gentle nod, em seguida flexione o queixo toward o peitoral por segmentally flexing o cervical spine.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo posição sem levantando o ombros ou quadril.
Desça lentamente por 2-3 seconds de volta para a slight, comfortable extension; mantenha o movimento smooth e pain‑free.
Mantenha steady breathing e mantenha reps strict; stop if form ou control degrades.
name_pt: Flexão Cervical Deitado com Carga (Head Harness)

name: weighted standing neck extension (with head harness)
instructions: Fit the head harness snugly above the ears and across the forehead/occiput; clip the plate to the chain.
Stand feet hip‑width with soft knees, hinge slightly at the hips, and brace your core while keeping the back neutral.
Let the weight hang vertically; depress the shoulders and keep the torso still.
Begin with the neck slightly flexed (chin gently toward chest) without rounding your upper back.
Exhale and extend the neck by driving the back of your head upward until your face is level; avoid hyperextending past neutral.
Pause briefly, then inhale and lower the chin under control for 2–3 seconds; repeat for reps, stopping if you feel neck joint pain or dizziness.
description: With a head harness attached to a weight plate, stand and hinge slightly so the plate hangs freely. Extend the neck to bring the head to neutral, then lower back under control.
instructions_pt: Aviso de Segurança (Uso Avançado / Lutas): exercício de alta exigência cervical indicado exclusivamente para preparação física específica e reabilitação orientada. Utilize cargas mínimas e movimento lento e estritamente controlado. Interrompa em caso de dor ou formigamento. Fit o fita de cabeça (head harness) snugly acima o ears e através do forehead/occiput; clip o plate para o chain.
Fique em pé pés quadril‑largura com soft joelhos, incline o tronco levemente no quadril, e brace o core enquanto mantendo o de volta neutral.
Mantenha a carga hang vertically; depress o ombros e mantenha o tronco still.
Begin com o pescoço levemente flexed (chin gently toward peitoral) sem rounding seu upper de volta.
Expire e estenda o pescoço por driving o de volta da cabeça para cima até o rosto está altura; avoid hyperextending past neutral.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida inspire e desça o chin sob control por 2-3 seconds; repita por reps, stopping if você feel pescoço joint pain ou dizziness.
name_pt: Extensão Cervical em Pé com Carga (Head Harness)

name: cable seated neck extension (with head harness)
instructions: Set a low pulley and clip the head harness ring to the carabiner.
Sit facing the stack with feet flat and torso upright; slide back until the cable is taut.
Put on the harness with the pad centered on your forehead and the strap snug.
Start with a slight chin tuck and mild neck flexion; keep shoulders down and core braced.
Exhale and extend your neck back until your head reaches neutral or a slight extension—do not arch the lower back.
Pause briefly, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position under control.
Maintain a smooth tempo, avoid jerking, and keep the range pain‑free; do not hyperextend.
Use small load increases and stop if you feel neck joint discomfort or tingling.
description: Sit facing a low cable stack wearing a snug head harness attached to the cable. From a slightly flexed neck position, extend the neck against the cable to neutral or slight extension, then return under control.
instructions_pt: Aviso de Segurança (Uso Avançado / Lutas): exercício de alta exigência cervical indicado exclusivamente para preparação física específica e reabilitação orientada. Utilize cargas mínimas e movimento lento e estritamente controlado. Interrompa em caso de dor ou formigamento. Set a baixo pulley e clip o fita de cabeça (head harness) ring para o carabiner.
Sente-se de frente para o stack com pés apoiado e tronco upright; slide de volta até o cabo está taut.
Put no harness com o apoio centered em seu forehead e o strap snug.
Comece com a slight chin tuck e mild pescoço flexion; mantenha ombros para baixo e core braced.
Expire e estenda o pescoço de volta até a cabeça reaches neutral ou a slight extension-do not arch o desça de volta.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida inspire e retorne lentamente à posição inicial sob control.
Mantenha a smooth tempo, avoid jerking, e mantenha o range pain‑free; do not hyperextend.
Use small load increases e stop if você feel pescoço joint discomfort ou tingling.

name: cable seated neck flexion (with head harness)
instructions: Set a cable pulley roughly at seated head height and select a very light weight.
Sit on a bench facing away from the machine; clip the head harness D‑ring behind your head to the cable.
Sit tall with feet flat, core braced, shoulders relaxed, and neck in neutral alignment.
Pre-tension the cable by scooting forward slightly without extending the neck.
Exhale and flex the neck, nodding the chin toward the chest through a comfortable range without rounding the torso.
Pause briefly, then slowly return to neutral while resisting the pull—do not hyperextend.
Keep the motion smooth and small; stop immediately if you feel pain or dizziness.
description: Sit facing away from a cable machine with a head harness attached to the cable at about head height. Keeping the torso still, flex the neck to bring the chin toward the chest against the cable’s pull, then return under control.
instructions_pt: Aviso de Segurança (Uso Avançado / Lutas): exercício de alta exigência cervical indicado exclusivamente para preparação física específica e reabilitação orientada. Utilize cargas mínimas e movimento lento e estritamente controlado. Interrompa em caso de dor ou formigamento. Set a cabo pulley roughly em seated cabeça altura e select a very light peso.
Sente-se no banco virado para longe do aparelho; clip o fita de cabeça (head harness) D‑ring atrás da cabeça para o cabo.
Sente-se ereto com pés apoiado, core braced, ombros relaxed, e pescoço em neutral alignment.
Pre-tension o cabo por scooting para a frente levemente sem estendendo o pescoço.
Expire e flex o pescoço, nodding o chin toward o peitoral através da comfortable range sem rounding o tronco.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida retorne lentamente para neutral enquanto resisting o puxe-do not hyperextend.
Mantenha o movimento smooth e small; stop immediately if você feel pain ou dizziness.

name: barbell standing concentration curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Rest your opposite hand on your thigh for support.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weight up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the weight back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The barbell standing concentration curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed standing with a barbell in one hand while the other hand supports the body. It emphasizes strict form and muscle contraction.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure uma barra em uma mão, palm virado para para cima.
Apoie seu mão oposta em seu coxa por support.
Mantendo seu upper braço stationary, expire e flexione a carga para cima em direção ao ombro.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, contraindo bem os bíceps.
Inspire e lentamente desça a carga de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de braço.
name_pt: Rosca Concentrada em Pé com Barra

name: frog crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The frog crunch is a bodyweight abdominal exercise that targets the abs and also engages the hip flexors. It is performed lying on your back, curling your torso up while keeping your feet together and knees bent.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraindo o abdômen, levante o tronco do chão, flexionando para a frente até o tronco formar um ângulo de 45 graus.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: ez-bar close-grip bench press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the ez barbell with a close grip, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing forward.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ-bar close-grip bench press is a compound upper body exercise that primarily targets the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It is performed lying on a bench, using a close grip on an EZ barbell to emphasize triceps activation.
instructions_pt: Deite-se no banco reto com os pés firmes no chão e as costas apoiadas firmemente no banco.
Segure o ez barra com pegada fechada, mãos na largura dos ombros, palmas voltadas para a frente.
Levante a barra do suporte e segure o peso directly acima o peitoral com os braços totalmente estendidos.
Lentamente desça a barra em direção ao peitoral, mantendo os cotovelos junto ao corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa quando a barra tocar o peitoral.
Empurre a barra de volta para cima à posição inicial, totalmente estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: tire flip
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the tire.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips, lowering into a squat position.
Reach down and grab the bottom edge of the tire with both hands, fingers facing towards you.
Engage your glutes and leg muscles, and explosively drive through your legs to lift the tire off the ground.
As the tire flips over, use your upper body strength to guide it and maintain control.
Once the tire is fully flipped, quickly step back and reset your stance.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The tire flip is a full-body, explosive strength exercise that primarily targets the glutes, with significant involvement from the hamstrings, quadriceps, and core. It requires lifting and flipping a heavy tire, demanding power, coordination, and proper technique to perform safely.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, virado para o tire.
Flexione os joelhos e incline o tronco no quadril, descendo em posição de agachamento.
Alcance para baixo e grab o bottom edge do tire com ambas as mãos, fingers virado para em direção a você.
Contraia os glúteos e perna muscles, e explosively empurre com força através das pernas para levante o tire do chão.
As o tire flips sobre, use o tronco strength para guide o peso e mantenha control.
Once o tire está totalmente flipped, quickly dê um passo de volta e reset seu stance.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: chest dip on straight bar
instructions: Grab the parallel bars with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles.
Lower your body by bending your arms until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The chest dip on a straight bar is a bodyweight exercise that targets the pectoral muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. It requires significant upper body strength, stability, and control.
instructions_pt: Grab o barras paralelas com suas palmas voltadas para baixo e os braços totalmente estendidos.
Flexione os joelhos e cruze seu tornozelos.
Desça o corpo por flexionando os braços até os ombros estão abaixo os cotovelos.
Empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Mergulho na Barra Reta (Straight Bar Dip)

name: cable thibaudeau kayak row
instructions: Attach a cable handle to a low pulley and sit facing the machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handle with your right hand and extend your arm fully, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight and your abs engaged.
Pull the handle towards your torso by retracting your shoulder blade and bending your elbow, keeping your arm close to your body.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform with your left arm.
description: The cable Thibaudeau kayak row is a unilateral rowing exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi using a cable machine. It mimics the motion of a kayak paddle, emphasizing back engagement and unilateral strength.
instructions_pt: Prenda a cabo manopla para a baixo pulley e Sente-se de frente para o aparelho com os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure a manopla com seu mão direita e estenda o braço totalmente, mantendo a slight flexione no cotovelo.
Incline para a frente do quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen engaged.
Puxe a manopla em direção ao tronco por retracting o ombro blade e flexionando o cotovelo, mantendo seu braço junto ao corpo.
Contraia as costas muscles no topo do movimento, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições, em seguida troque lados e perform com seu braço esquerdo.

name: bridge - mountain climber (cross body)
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and lift your right foot off the ground, bringing your right knee towards your left elbow.
Return your right foot to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left foot towards your right elbow.
Continue alternating sides, moving at a controlled pace.
Keep your hips level and avoid lifting your hips too high or sagging them too low.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bridge - mountain climber (cross body) is a dynamic bodyweight exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, shoulders, and triceps. It combines core stabilization with a cross-body knee drive, challenging both strength and coordination.
instructions_pt: Inicie na alto posição de prancha com as mãos directly sob os ombros e o corpo na linha reta.
Contraia o abdômen e levante seu pé direito do chão, aproximando seu joelho direito em direção a seu cotovelo esquerdo.
Retorne seu pé direito à posição inicial e Repita o movimento com seu pé esquerdo em direção a seu cotovelo direito.
Continue alternando lados, moving na controlled pace.
Mantenha seus quadris altura e avoid levantando o quadril too alto ou sagging os pesos too baixo.
Mantenha a steady breathing pattern throughout o exercise.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell lying on floor rear delt raise
instructions: Lie face down on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Engaging your shoulder muscles, lift your arms up and out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying on floor rear delt raise is an isolation exercise targeting the rear deltoids. It is performed lying face down on the floor, lifting dumbbells out to the sides to engage the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de bruços no chão com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas uma para a outra.
Estenda os braços estendidos à sua frente, mantendo a slight flexione nos cotovelos.
Contraindo o ombro muscles, levante os braços para cima e para fora para o lados, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os braços de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Crucifixo Inverso Deitado no Chão com Halteres

name: seated piriformis stretch
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left knee.
Place your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently twist your torso to the right.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
description: The seated piriformis stretch targets the glutes and helps improve flexibility and relieve tension in the piriformis muscle. It is performed seated on the ground, crossing one leg over the other and gently twisting the torso to stretch the gluteal region.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com seu pernas estendidas à sua frente.
Flexione seu joelho direito e posicione seu pé direito no outside de seu joelho esquerdo.
Posicione seu cotovelo esquerdo no outside de seu joelho direito e gently gire o tronco para a direita.
Segure o alongamento por 20-30 seconds, em seguida troque lados e repita.

name: rocking frog stretch
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for support.
Slowly lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands and extending your legs behind you.
Keep your back straight and engage your glutes as you push your hips back and up towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few seconds, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your knees and lowering your hips back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The rocking frog stretch is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes and also stretches the hamstrings and quadriceps. It involves kneeling, leaning forward, and rocking the hips back to stretch the lower body muscles.
instructions_pt: Comece kneeling no chão com os joelhos na largura do quadril.
Posicione as mãos no chão à sua frente por support.
Lentamente incline para a frente, shifting seu peso onto as mãos e estendendo as pernas atrás você.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e contraia os glúteos ao empurre o quadril de volta e para cima em direção ao ceiling.
Sustente essa posição pela few seconds, feeling a alongamento em seu glutes.
Retorne lentamente à posição inicial flexionando os joelhos e descendo o quadril de volta para baixo.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: roll overs into v sits
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight together and arms overhead; brace your core and press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift legs to 90°, posteriorly tilt the pelvis, and articulate the spine off the floor to roll the legs overhead, keeping weight on upper back/shoulders and the neck relaxed.
Stop where you can control the position without cervical pressure, legs long and together.
Sweep the arms forward and begin a controlled reverse roll, segmenting the spine back down as you unfold the legs.
Hinge at the hips to sit up and balance on your sit bones in a V-sit, torso and legs about 45–60 degrees, arms reaching toward toes, chest lifted.
Pause briefly with abs braced, then tuck the pelvis and round the spine to roll back with control.
Exhale as you rise to the V-sit; inhale as you roll back. Move smoothly and do not let the heels slam to the floor.
description: From a supine position, roll your legs overhead into a controlled rollover, then reverse to balance in a V-sit on your sit bones. Use your core to drive the motion and avoid loading the neck.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas com pernas reto juntos e braços acima da cabeça; brace o core e empurre seu desça de volta gently no chão.
Levante pernas para 90°, posteriorly tilt o pelvis, e articulate o spine do chão para roll o pernas acima da cabeça, mantendo peso em upper de volta/ombros e o pescoço relaxed.
Stop where você can control o posição sem cervical pressure, pernas long e juntos.
Sweep o braços para a frente e begin a controlled inverta roll, segmenting o spine de volta para baixo ao unfold o pernas.
