Incline o tronco no quadril para sente-se para cima e balance em seu sente-se bones na V-sente-se, tronco e pernas about 45-60 graus, braços alcançando toward pontas dos pés, peitoral lifted.
Faça uma breve pausa com abs braced, em seguida tuck o pelvis e round o spine para roll de volta com control.
Expire ao rise para o V-sente-se; inspire ao roll de volta. Move smoothly e do not Mantenha o calcanhares slam para o chão.

name: lever horizontal one leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your leg, keeping your back against the backrest.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly bend your leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The lever horizontal one leg press is a lower body strength exercise performed on a leverage machine. It primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The exercise involves pressing a footplate away from the body using one leg at a time, which increases the demand for unilateral strength and stability.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o seat do aparelho de modo que seus joelhos estão na 90-degree ângulo when os pés estão no footplate.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o backrest e os pés na largura dos ombros no footplate.
Posicione as mãos nas manoplas ou lados do aparelho por stability.
Empurre o footplate longe do corpo por estendendo a perna, mantendo seu de volta contra o backrest.
Faça uma breve pausa no totalmente estendidos posição, em seguida lentamente flexione a perna para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de perna.

name: jump rope
instructions: Hold the handles of the jump rope with your hands, palms facing inward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing the rope over your head and jump over it as it comes towards your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and repeat the jump as the rope comes around again.
Continue jumping for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description: Jump rope is a cardiovascular exercise that involves continuously jumping over a swinging rope. It primarily targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the calves, quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes.
instructions_pt: Segure as manoplas do salte corda com as mãos, palmas voltadas para dentro.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Swing a corda sobre a cabeça e salte sobre o peso as o peso comes em direção aos pés.
Aterrisse suavemente no balls dos pés e repita o salte as a corda comes around again.
Continue saltando pelo desejado duration ou number de repetições.

name: cable lateral pulldown with v-bar
instructions: Sit down on the cable pulldown machine and grab the v-bar attachment with an overhand grip.
Adjust the knee pad so that your thighs are secured under it.
Keep your back straight and lean back slightly.
Pull the v-bar down towards your upper chest while keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back muscles at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return the v-bar to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable lateral pulldown with v-bar is a strength exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) using a cable machine and v-bar attachment. It also engages the biceps and forearms as secondary muscles.
instructions_pt: Sente-se para baixo no cabo pulldown aparelho e grab o v-bar attachment com pegada pronada.
Ajuste o joelho apoio de modo que suas coxas estão travado sob o peso.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e incline de volta levemente.
Puxe o v-bar para baixo em direção a seu peitoral superior enquanto mantendo os cotovelos junto ao corpo.
Contraia as costas muscles embaixo no movimento.
Lentamente retorne o v-bar à posição inicial e Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições.
name_pt: Puxada Alta com Barra V na Polia

name: dumbbell lying pronation on floor
instructions: Lie flat on the floor with your face down and your arms extended straight out in front of you, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rotate your palms so they are facing down towards the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, lift the dumbbells off the floor by contracting your forearms.
Continue lifting until your forearms are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying pronation on floor targets the forearms by requiring you to rotate your palms downward while lifting dumbbells, emphasizing forearm strength and stability.
instructions_pt: Deite-se apoiado no chão com o rosto para baixo e os braços estendido em linha reta para fora à sua frente, segurando um halter em cada mão.
Gire seu palms so they estão virado para para baixo em direção ao chão.
Mantendo os braços estendidos, levante os halteres do chão por contraindo os antebraços.
Continue levantando até os antebraços estão totalmente contraído e os halteres estão na altura dos ombros.
Segure por um instante, em seguida desça lentamente os halteres de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Pronação de Punho no Chão com Halter

name: dumbbell lying supination on floor
instructions: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your arms by your sides, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rotate your palms to face up, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Slowly curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying supination on floor is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, with secondary engagement of the biceps and shoulders. It involves lying on your back and performing a supination curl motion with dumbbells.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão no chão com seu pernas estendidas e os braços por seu lados, segurando um halter em cada mão.
Gire seu palms para face para cima, mantendo seus cotovelos próximo a seu lados.
Lentamente flexione os halteres em direção aos ombros, contraindo os antebraços.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os halteres à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Supinação de Punho no Chão com Halter

name: lever reverse grip lateral pulldown
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your chest out and shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the handles down towards your chest, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever reverse grip lateral pulldown is a machine-based exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) with a reverse (underhand) grip, also engaging the biceps, rhomboids, and rear deltoids. It is performed on a leverage machine, making it accessible and safe for most users.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com os joelhos sob o apoios e os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Sente-se ereto com o peitoral para fora e ombros de volta, mantendo a slight arch em seu desça de volta.
Puxe as manoplas para baixo em direção ao peitoral, leading com os cotovelos e aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente as manoplas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Puxada Alta Pegada Supinada na Máquina Articulada

name: ez-barbell standing wide grip biceps curl
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Curl the barbell up towards your shoulders by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ-barbell standing wide grip biceps curl is a strength exercise targeting the biceps, with secondary emphasis on the forearms. It involves curling an EZ barbell with a wide grip while standing.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure o ez barra com pegada supinada, mãos wider than na largura dos ombros.
Mantenha seus cotovelos próximo ao tronco e os braços stationary throughout o movimento.
Flexione a barra para cima em direção aos ombros por contraindo os bíceps.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça a barra lentamente de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Rosca Bíceps em Pé Pegada Aberta

name: ankle dorsal flexion
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart; lightly hold a wall or chair for balance if needed.
Keep knees soft, torso upright, and weight centered over your heels.
Actively pull your toes up toward your shins (ankle dorsiflexion) without lifting the heels.
Pause briefly at end range while keeping ankles aligned and not turning the feet out/in.
Lower the forefeet slowly to the floor; avoid letting them drop or slapping the ground.
Repeat for controlled reps, staying within a pain-free range and even between sides.
description: Stand upright with feet hip-width, heels on the floor. Lift the forefeet by pulling the toes toward your shins, then lower under control.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé tall com pés na largura do quadril; lightly segure a wall ou chair por balance if needed.
Mantenha joelhos soft, tronco upright, e peso centered sobre os calcanhares.
Actively puxe as pontas dos pés para cima toward seu shins (tornozelo dorsiflexion) sem levantando o calcanhares.
Faça uma breve pausa em end range enquanto mantendo tornozelos aligned e not turning o pés para fora/em.
Desça o forefeet lentamente para o chão; avoid letting os pesos drop ou slapping o chão.
Repita por controlled reps, staying within a pain-free range e even entre lados.

name: dumbbell step up lunge
instructions: Place two sturdy benches about a stride apart; hold dumbbells at your sides, chest up, core braced.
Put your front foot flat on the front bench and the top of your rear foot on the rear bench; hips square, eyes forward.
Inhale and descend straight down by bending both knees, keeping the front knee tracking over the middle toes and heel grounded.
Lower until the front foot lightly touches the floor (or front thigh is at least parallel), torso tall and neutral spine.
Exhale and drive through the front heel and mid‑foot to extend the knee and hip, returning to the start atop the benches.
Minimize push from the rear leg; keep dumbbells still and shoulders down.
Pause, re-balance, and complete all reps before switching legs.
description: Hold dumbbells at your sides and set up in a long split stance with the front foot on a bench and the rear foot elevated on a bench behind you. Lower straight down until the front foot lightly taps the floor, then drive through the front heel to step back up onto the front bench.
instructions_pt: Posicione dois sturdy benches about a stride afastados; segure halteres em seu lados, peito estufado, core braced.
Put seu frente pé apoiado no frente banco e o topo de seu rear pé no rear banco; quadril square, eyes para a frente.
Inspire e descend reto para baixo por flexionando ambos os joelhos, mantendo o frente joelho tracking sobre o middle pontas dos pés e calcanhar grounded.
Desça até o frente pé lightly touches o chão (ou frente coxa está em least paralelo), tronco tall e neutral spine.
Expire e empurre com força através do frente calcanhar e mid‑pé para estenda o joelho e quadril, retornando para o inicie atop o benches.
Minimize empurre do rear perna; mantenha halteres still e ombros para baixo.
Faça uma pausa, re-balance, e complete all reps before switching pernas.
name_pt: Subida no Banco com Afundo e Halteres

name: dumbbell step-up lunge
instructions: Stand in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Place your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is on the surface.
Push through your right heel and lift your body up onto the step, bringing your left foot up as well.
Once both feet are on the step, lower your left foot back down to the starting position, keeping your right foot on the step.
Repeat the movement, alternating which foot you step up with each time.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell step-up lunge is a compound lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps while also engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping onto a raised platform while holding dumbbells, requiring balance, coordination, and lower body strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé em frente à dê um passo ou platform com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para seu lados.
Posicione seu pé direito no dê um passo, garantindo que seu entire pé está no surface.
Empurre através de seu calcanhar direito e levante o corpo para cima no dê um passo, aproximando seu pé esquerdo para cima as well.
Once ambos os pés estão no dê um passo, desça seu pé esquerdo de volta à posição inicial, mantendo seu pé direito no dê um passo.
Repita o movimento, alternando which pé você dê um passo para cima com cada time.
Continue pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell squat jump step rear lunge
instructions: Rack the barbell across your upper traps with a shoulder-width grip; stand 15–30 cm in front of a sturdy step, feet hip-width and toes slightly out.
Brace your core, set a neutral spine, and sit into a quarter–half squat.
Drive through your feet and jump onto the step, landing softly on both feet with knees tracking over toes and heels down.
Stand tall on the step, then step one foot back to the floor and lower into a controlled rear lunge (front shin vertical, back knee under hip).
Push through the front heel to return to standing on the floor at the start position.
Repeat the jump and alternate the lunge leg each rep while keeping the torso upright and the bar stable.
Use a low step and light load; stop the set if landing control or balance is lost.
description: Set a barbell on your upper back and stand facing a low, stable step. Perform a squat jump to land on the step, then step back into a rear lunge before returning to the start.
instructions_pt: Rack a barra através de seu upper traps com a ombro-largura pegada; fique em pé 15-30 cm em frente à sturdy dê um passo, pés quadril-largura e pontas dos pés levemente para fora.
Brace o core, set a neutral spine, e sente-se em um quarter-half squat.
Empurre com força através dos pés e salte no dê um passo, aterrissando softly em ambos os pés com joelhos tracking sobre pontas dos pés e calcanhares para baixo.
Fique em pé tall no dê um passo, em seguida dê um passo um pé de volta para o chão e desça em um controlled rear lunge (frente shin vertical, de volta joelho sob quadril).
Empurre através do frente calcanhar para retorne para standing no chão no inicie posição.
Repita o salte e alterne o lunge perna cada rep enquanto mantendo o tronco upright e a barra stable.
Use a baixo dê um passo e light load; stop o set if aterrissando control ou balance está lost.
name_pt: Agachamento com Salto e Afundo com Barra

name: barbell squat jump step rear lunge
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Explode upwards, jumping off the ground as high as you can.
Land softly on your feet and immediately step back with one leg into a reverse lunge.
Lower your body down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat the jump and lunge sequence on the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell squat jump step rear lunge is a dynamic lower body exercise that combines a squat jump with a reverse lunge, performed while holding a barbell across the upper back. This movement targets the quadriceps, glutes, hamstrings, and calves, and requires strength, coordination, and balance.
instructions_pt: Comece em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando uma barra através de seu upper de volta.
Desça o corpo em posição de agachamento flexionando os joelhos e empurrando o quadril de volta.
suba com potência explosiva, saltando do chão as alto ao can.
Aterrisse suavemente nos pés e immediately dê um passo de volta com uma perna em um inverta lunge.
Desça o corpo para baixo até seu frente coxa está paralelo ao chão, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Empurre através de seu frente calcanhar para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita o salte e lunge sequence no outro perna.
Continue alternando as pernas pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Agachamento com Salto e Afundo com Barra

name: barbell sitted alternate leg raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and hold a barbell across your thighs.
Keeping your legs straight, lift one leg up as high as possible while keeping the other leg on the ground.
Lower the raised leg back down and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell sitted alternate leg raise is an exercise targeting the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. Performed while seated on a bench with a barbell across the thighs, it involves alternately raising each leg while keeping the back straight.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com as costas retas e segure uma barra através de suas coxas.
Mantendo seu pernas reto, levante uma perna para cima as alto as possible enquanto mantendo o outro perna no chão.
Desça o raised perna de volta para baixo e Repita com o outro perna.
Continue alternando as pernas pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell sitted alternate leg raise (female)
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and hold a barbell across your thighs.
Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support.
Keeping your legs straight, lift one leg up as high as possible while keeping it parallel to the ground.
Lower the leg back down and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell sitted alternate leg raise (female) targets the abdominal muscles while also engaging the hip flexors and quadriceps. The exercise is performed seated on a bench, holding a barbell across the thighs, and alternately raising each leg while keeping it straight.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com as costas retas e segure uma barra através de suas coxas.
Posicione as mãos no lados do banco por support.
Mantendo seu pernas reto, levante uma perna para cima as alto as possible enquanto mantendo o peso paralelos ao chão.
Desça o perna de volta para baixo e Repita com o outro perna.
Continue alternando as pernas pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: twisted leg raise (female)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, bringing them towards your chest.
As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your knees towards your opposite shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The twisted leg raise (female) is an abdominal exercise that targets the abs, obliques, and hip flexors. It involves lying on your back, lifting your legs, and twisting your hips to engage the core muscles more dynamically.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com seu pernas estendidas e os braços por seu lados.
Flexione os joelhos e levante as pernas do chão, aproximando os pesos em direção ao peitoral.
Ao levante as pernas, gire o quadril para um lado, aproximando os joelhos em direção a seu oposto ombro.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente as pernas à posição inicial.
Repita o movimento, this time girando o quadril para o outro lado.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: twisted leg raise
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your abs and lift both legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your legs towards your opposite shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The twisted leg raise is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, with an emphasis on the obliques and hip flexors. It involves lifting the legs while twisting the hips to engage the core from different angles.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com seu pernas estendidas e os braços por seu lados.
Posicione as mãos sob os glúteos por support.
Contraia o abdômen e levante ambos os pernas do chão, mantendo-os estendidos.
Ao levante as pernas, gire o quadril para um lado, aproximando as pernas em direção a seu oposto ombro.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente as pernas à posição inicial.
Repita o movimento, this time girando o quadril para o outro lado.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell supported squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell supported squat is a lower body exercise targeting the quadriceps, with additional activation of the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It involves holding dumbbells at your sides while performing a squat, enhancing strength and stability.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando um halter em cada mão em seu lados.
Mantendo seu peito estufado e core engaged, lentamente desça o corpo para baixo flexionando os joelhos e empurrando o quadril de volta.
Continue descendo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão, ou as baixo ao can comfortably go.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo e empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell supported squat
instructions: Adjust the support so your ankles are snug under the roller and your calves contact the rear pad; stand tall with feet hip-width and toes forward on the platform.
Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest (goblet) or two dumbbells at your shoulders; brace your core and keep a neutral spine.
Inhale and initiate the descent by bending your knees forward, allowing them to track over your second–third toes while keeping hips relatively extended and torso upright.
Keep heels down and shins guided by the support; do not let the lower back round or knees cave inward.
Lower under control until thighs reach parallel or your comfortable depth without losing foot pressure or spinal position.
Drive through the mid-foot to extend the knees and return to standing, exhaling as you pass the sticking point.
Pause briefly, reset your brace, and repeat for the target reps with smooth, controlled tempo.
description: Set up in a sissy-squat/support bench with ankles secured and calves against the pad, holding one or two dumbbells at the chest. Squat by flexing the knees while keeping the torso upright, then drive through the feet to return to standing.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o support so seu tornozelos estão snug sob o rolo e as panturrilhas contact o rear apoio; fique em pé tall com pés quadril-largura e pontas dos pés para a frente no platform.
Segure um halter vertically no peitoral (goblet) ou dois halteres nos ombros; brace o core e mantenha a neutral spine.
Inspire e initiate o descent flexionando os joelhos para a frente, allowing os pesos para track sobre seu second-third pontas dos pés enquanto mantendo quadril relatively estendido e tronco upright.
Mantenha calcanhares para baixo e shins guided pelo support; do not Mantenha o desça de volta round ou joelhos cave para dentro.
Desça sob control até coxas alcance paralelo ou seu comfortable depth sem losing pé pressure ou spinal posição.
Empurre com força através do mid-pé para estenda o joelhos e retorne para standing, exhaling ao pass o sticking point.
Faça uma breve pausa, reset seu brace, e repita pelo target reps com smooth, controlled tempo.

name: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Place your left foot on a stepbox or elevated surface behind you.
Keeping your back straight and core engaged, hinge forward at the hips, lowering the dumbbell towards the ground.
As you lower the dumbbell, simultaneously lift your left leg behind you, maintaining a straight line from head to heel.
Lower the dumbbell until you feel a stretch in your right hamstring, then return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support is a unilateral lower body exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It challenges balance, stability, and strength, making it suitable for those with some experience in weight training.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura do quadril, segurando um halter em seu mão direita.
Posicione seu pé esquerdo na stepbox ou elevated surface atrás você.
Mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído, incline o tronco para a frente no quadril, descendo o halter em direção ao chão.
Ao desça o halter, simultaneamente levante seu perna esquerda atrás você, mantendo a linha reta de cabeça para calcanhar.
Desça o halter até sentir o alongamento nos posteriores da coxa direita e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de lado.

name: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support
instructions: Place a low step/box 30–45 cm behind you and lightly rest the toes of the non-working foot on it; stand tall on the working leg holding a dumbbell in the same-side hand, arm straight.
Set the working foot under the hip, keep a soft knee (10–20° bend), brace your core, and keep hips and shoulders square.
Hinge at the hips by pushing them back, keeping the dumbbell close to your shin and the working knee angle nearly constant.
Maintain a neutral spine from head to pelvis; lower until you feel a firm hamstring stretch or your torso nears parallel without rounding.
Keep 80–90% of your weight on the working leg; the rear foot is for balance only, not to push from.
Drive through the working heel, extend the hip, and return to stand without hyperextending the lower back.
Reset your brace and repeat for reps, then switch sides.
description: Stand on one leg with the other foot lightly supported on a low step/box behind you. Hold a dumbbell in the same-side hand and perform a controlled hip hinge to load the hamstrings, then return to stand tall.
instructions_pt: Posicione a baixo dê um passo/box 30-45 cm atrás você e lightly apoie o pontas dos pés do non-working pé no peso; fique em pé tall no working perna segurando um halter no same-lado mão, braço reto.
Set o working pé sob o quadril, mantenha a soft joelho (10-20° flexione), brace o core, e mantenha quadril e ombros square.
Incline o tronco no quadril por empurrando os pesos de volta, mantendo o halter próximo a seu shin e o working joelho ângulo nearly constant.
Mantenha a neutral spine de cabeça para pelvis; desça até você feel a firm hamstring alongamento ou o tronco nears paralelo sem rounding.
Mantenha 80-90% de seu peso no working perna; o rear pé está por balance only, not para empurre de.
Empurre com força através do working calcanhar, estenda o quadril, e retorne para fique em pé sem hyperextending o desça de volta.
Reset seu brace e repita por reps, em seguida troque lados.

name: dumbbell sumo pull through
instructions: Set feet wider than shoulder width with toes turned out 30–45°, grip one head of the dumbbell with both hands, arms straight and hanging between the legs.
Brace the core, keep a neutral spine, and push the hips back while bending the knees slightly; let the dumbbell travel between the thighs.
Keep shins near vertical, knees tracking over toes, shoulders packed, and weight through mid‑foot to heels.
At the end of the hinge, pause with the torso angled forward without rounding the back.
Drive the feet into the floor and snap the hips forward, squeezing the glutes to stand tall; let the arms stay straight as the dumbbell is pulled forward by hip extension.
Finish with hips and knees fully extended, ribs down, and no low‑back hyperextension.
Repeat by hinging again, guiding the dumbbell back between the legs under control; maintain a smooth tempo and neutral neck throughout.
description: Stand in a wide sumo stance holding a dumbbell with both hands between the legs. Hinge the hips to let the weight pass back between the thighs, then drive the hips forward to stand tall, pulling the dumbbell through without using the arms.
instructions_pt: Set pés wider than ombro largura com pontas dos pés turned para fora 30-45°, pegada um cabeça do halter com ambas as mãos, braços reto e hanging entre o pernas.
Brace o core, mantenha a neutral spine, e empurre o quadril de volta enquanto flexionando o joelhos levemente; Mantenha o halter travel entre o coxas.
Mantenha shins near vertical, joelhos tracking sobre pontas dos pés, ombros packed, e peso através de mid‑pé para calcanhares.
No end do incline o tronco, faça uma pausa com o tronco angled para a frente sem rounding o de volta.
Empurre com força o pés no chão e snap o quadril para a frente, contraindo o glutes para fique em pé tall; Mantenha o braços stay reto as o halter está pulled para a frente por quadril extension.
Finish com quadril e joelhos totalmente estendidos, ribs para baixo, e no baixo‑de volta hyperextension.
Repita por hinging again, guiding o halter de volta entre o pernas sob control; mantenha a smooth tempo e neutral pescoço throughout.

name: dumbbell sumo pull through
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointed outwards.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended.
Bend your knees and lower your hips down into a squat position, keeping your back straight.
Lower the dumbbell down between your legs, keeping your arms straight.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips forward, pulling the dumbbell up and in front of your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, then lower the dumbbell back down between your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell sumo pull through is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings, quadriceps, and core. It involves a wide-stance squat and a hip hinge movement, using a dumbbell for resistance.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés wider than na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés apontados levemente para fora.
Segure um halter com ambas as mãos em frente ao corpo, braços estendidos.
Flexione os joelhos e desça o quadril para baixo em posição de agachamento, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Desça o halter para baixo entre as pernas, mantendo os braços estendidos.
Empurre com força pelos calcanhares e estenda o quadril para a frente, puxando o halter para cima e em frente ao corpo.
Contraia os glúteos no topo do movimento, em seguida desça o halter de volta para baixo entre as pernas.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell split squat (version 2)
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with an overhand grip just outside your thighs; feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot forward into a long split stance (front foot flat, back heel lifted, toes pointing forward).
Brace your abs, keep your chest up, hips square, and the bar close to your thighs.
Lower straight down by bending both knees; keep the torso tall and the front knee tracking over the middle toes.
Descend until the front thigh is near parallel and the back knee hovers just above the floor; keep weight through the front mid-foot/heel.
Press through the front foot and the ball of the back foot to return to standing without locking the knees.
Keep the bar level and close to the body; avoid letting the front knee cave inward or the heel lift.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat.
description: Hold a barbell with both hands at arm’s length in front of your hips and set up in a split stance. Lower straight down into a split squat and drive through the front foot to stand, keeping the bar close and level.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé tall segurando uma barra com uma pegada pronada just outside suas coxas; pés na largura do quadril.
Dê um passo um pé para a frente em um long split stance (frente pé apoiado, de volta calcanhar lifted, pontas dos pés pointing para a frente).
Brace o abdômen, mantenha seu peito estufado, quadril square, e a barra próximo a suas coxas.
Desça reto para baixo por flexionando ambos os joelhos; mantenha o tronco tall e o frente joelho tracking sobre o middle pontas dos pés.
Descend até o frente coxa está near paralelo e o de volta joelho hovers just acima o chão; mantenha peso através do frente mid-pé/calcanhar.
Empurre através do frente pé e o bola do de volta pé para retorne para standing sem travar os joelhos.
Mantenha o bar altura e próximo ao corpo; avoid letting o frente joelho cave para dentro ou o calcanhar levante.
Complete all reps de um lado, em seguida troque pernas e repita.

name: barbell split squat v. 2
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Take a large step forward with your right foot, keeping your torso upright.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg forward for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell split squat v. 2 is a lower body strength exercise that targets the quadriceps, while also engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping forward into a split stance and lowering the body with a barbell across the upper back.
instructions_pt: Comece em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando uma barra através de seu upper de volta.
Take a large dê um passo para a frente com seu pé direito, mantendo seu tronco upright.
Desça o corpo flexionando os joelhos e o quadril até seu coxa direita está paralelo ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre através de seu calcanhar direito para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita com seu perna esquerda para a frente pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell leg twist press
instructions: Lie supine on the floor, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder width, and press to full lockout over the mid‑chest with shoulders set down and back.
Brace your core, press your low back gently into the floor, and lift your legs so hips and knees are at about 90 degrees with feet together.
Keep the bar stacked over your shoulders and elbows locked as you slowly rotate both legs together to the right until your thighs approach the floor without lifting your shoulders or low back.
Pull the legs back to center using your abs, then rotate to the left the same distance.
Maintain a slow, controlled tempo and steady breathing; keep wrists neutral and the bar from drifting.
Limit range if your low back arches or the bar wobbles; use a light load you can stabilize throughout.
description: Lie on your back holding a barbell locked out over your chest while rotating bent legs side‑to‑side. This combines a static press with controlled leg twists to train the abs and challenge shoulder stability.
instructions_pt: Deite-se supine no chão, pegada a barra levemente wider than ombro largura, e empurre para full lockout sobre o mid‑peitoral com ombros set para baixo e de volta.
Brace o core, empurre seu baixo de volta gently no chão, e levante as pernas so quadril e joelhos estão em about 90 graus com pés juntos.
Mantenha o bar stacked sobre os ombros e cotovelos locked enquanto lentamente gire ambos os pernas juntos para a direita até suas coxas approach o chão sem levantando os ombros ou baixo de volta.
Puxe o pernas de volta para center using o abdômen, em seguida gire para a esquerda o same distance.
Mantenha a slow, controlled tempo e steady breathing; mantenha wrists neutral e a barra de drifting.
Limit range if seu baixo de volta arches ou a barra wobbles; use a light load você can stabilize throughout.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento com Rotação de Quadril e Barra

name: dumbbell step-up split squat
instructions: Stand in front of a bench or step with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your right foot on the bench or step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Step up onto the bench or step with your right foot, pushing through your heel to lift your body up.
As you step up, simultaneously lift your left knee towards your chest.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your left foot back to the ground while keeping your right foot on the bench or step.
Repeat the movement with your left foot on the bench or step.
Continue alternating between your right and left foot for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell step-up split squat is a lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps, with additional emphasis on the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping up onto a bench or step while holding dumbbells, requiring balance, coordination, and strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé em frente a um banco ou dê um passo com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para o corpo.
Posicione seu pé direito no banco ou dê um passo, garantindo que seu entire pé está em contact com o surface.
Dê um passo para cima no banco ou dê um passo com seu pé direito, empurrando pelo calcanhar para levante o corpo para cima.
Ao dê um passo para cima, simultaneamente levante seu joelho esquerdo em direção ao peitoral.
Faça uma pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente seu pé esquerdo de volta para o chão enquanto mantendo seu pé direito no banco ou dê um passo.
Repita o movimento com seu pé esquerdo no banco ou dê um passo.
Continue alternando entre os pés direito e esquerdo pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: captains chair straight leg raise
instructions: Sit on the captain's chair with your back against the backrest and your forearms resting on the arm pads.
Keep your upper body stable and your back straight.
Engage your abs and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The captain's chair straight leg raise is an abdominal exercise performed on a captain's chair apparatus. It primarily targets the abdominal muscles and also engages the hip flexors. The movement requires core strength and stability to lift and control the legs while keeping the upper body stable.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no captain's chair com as costas contra o backrest e os antebraços apoiando no braço apoios.
Mantenha seu upper corpo stable e as costas reto.
Contraia o abdômen e levante as pernas para cima à sua frente, mantendo-os estendidos.
Continue levantando até as pernas estejam paralelas ao chão ou as alto ao can comfortably go.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente as pernas à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação de Pernas na Cadeira do Capitão

name: weighted close grip chin-up on dip cage
instructions: Stand in front of the dip cage and grab the parallel bars with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bars with your arms fully extended, feet off the ground, and body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bars, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bars, then pause for a moment.
Slowly lower your body back down to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted close grip chin-up on dip cage is a challenging upper body exercise that targets the lats, with significant involvement from the biceps and forearms. It requires the use of additional weight, increasing the demand on strength and control.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé em frente ao dip cage e grab o barras paralelas com pegada supinada, mãos na largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso nas barras com os braços totalmente estendidos, pés do chão, e corpo reto.
Contraia as costas muscles e puxe o corpo para cima em direção ao bars, mantendo seus cotovelos próximo a seu lados.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima o bars, em seguida faça uma breve pausa.
Lentamente desça o corpo de volta à posição inicial, totalmente estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Barra Fixa Supinada Pegada Fechada com Carga Adicional

name: resistance band seated hip abduction
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on the sides of the chair or bench for support.
Engage your abductors (outer thigh muscles) and slowly push your knees apart, against the resistance of the band.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your knees back together.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A seated exercise using a resistance band to target the hip abductors by pushing the knees apart against resistance. This movement also engages the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na chair ou banco com as costas reto e pés apoiado no chão.
Wrap o elástico de resistência around suas coxas, just acima os joelhos.
Posicione as mãos no lados do chair ou banco por support.
Contraia seu abductors (outer coxa muscles) e lentamente empurre os joelhos afastados, contra o resistance do elástico.
Faça uma breve pausa no end do movimento, em seguida lentamente aproxime os joelhos de volta juntos.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: resistance band leg extension
instructions: Attach the resistance band to a sturdy anchor point and secure it around your ankle.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged and your upper body stable, extend your leg straight out in front of you.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly return your leg to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The resistance band leg extension targets the quadriceps by extending the leg against the resistance of a band, helping to build strength and endurance in the upper legs.
instructions_pt: Prenda o elástico de resistência para a sturdy ponto de fixação e trave o peso around seu tornozelo.
Fique de frente para o ponto de fixação com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Mantendo o abdômen contraído e o tronco stable, estenda a perna estendidos à sua frente.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida retorne lentamente a perna à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de perna.

name: ez bar lying bent arms pullover
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold the EZ barbell with a pronated grip (palms facing away from you) and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight above your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the barbell in an arc motion behind your head, maintaining the slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then return the barbell to the starting position by reversing the arc motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ bar lying bent arms pullover is a strength exercise targeting the lats, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and chest. It involves lying on a bench and moving the EZ barbell in an arc over and behind the head, requiring control and stability.
instructions_pt: Deite-se no banco reto com a cabeça em um end e os pés no chão.
Segure o EZ barra com a pronated pegada (palmas voltadas para a frente) e suas mãos na largura dos ombros.
Estenda os braços reto acima o peitoral, mantendo a slight flexione nos cotovelos.
Desça a barra em an arc movimento atrás da cabeça, mantendo o slight flexione nos cotovelos.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida retorne a barra à posição inicial por reversing o arc movimento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: incline scapula push up
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Place your hands on the bench slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your feet on the ground, hip-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the bench, keeping your elbows tucked in.
As you lower, retract your shoulder blades, squeezing your scapulae together.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The incline scapula push up is a bodyweight exercise performed on an incline bench that primarily targets the serratus anterior. It also engages the triceps and shoulders. The movement emphasizes scapular retraction and protraction, helping to improve shoulder stability and strength.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o banco inclinado a um ângulo de 45 graus.
Posicione as mãos no banco levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Posição os pés no chão, na largura do quadril.
Desça o peitoral em direção ao banco, mantendo os cotovelos fechados.
Ao desça, retract o ombro blades, contraindo seu scapulae juntos.
Empurre através de seu palms para estenda os braços e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: scapula dips
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows and retracting your shoulder blades, as if you are trying to squeeze a pencil between them.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to extend your elbows and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Scapula dips are a bodyweight exercise targeting the traps and upper back, focusing on scapular retraction and depression. This movement helps improve shoulder stability and strength.
instructions_pt: Comece em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e seus braços estendidos à sua frente.
Flexione levemente os joelhos e incline o tronco à frente a partir do quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos e retracting o ombro blades, como se estivesse trying para contraia a pencil entre os pesos.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre através das mãos para estenda os cotovelos e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: low glute bridge on floor
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your arms by your sides, palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and core, then lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The low glute bridge on floor is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes while also engaging the hamstrings and core. It is performed by lying on your back, lifting your hips off the ground, and squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione os braços por seu lados, palmas voltadas para baixo.
Contraia os glúteos e core, em seguida levante o quadril do chão até o corpo forms a linha reta dos joelhos para os ombros.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, contraindo bem os glúteos.
Lentamente desça o quadril de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: curl-up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The curl-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles. It involves lying on your back, bending your knees, and curling your upper body towards your knees to engage the abs.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraindo o abdômen, lentamente levante o tronco do chão, flexionando para a frente até o tronco formar um ângulo de 45 graus.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell pendlay row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Pull the barbell towards your upper abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell Pendlay row is a strength exercise targeting the upper back, performed by pulling a barbell from the floor to the upper abdomen with strict form.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Flexione para a frente no quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta e seu peito estufado.
Segure a barra com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Puxe a barra em direção a seu upper abdomen, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Desça a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: bench pull-ups
instructions: Position yourself under a bar or a sturdy horizontal surface that is at chest height.
Grab the bar or surface with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Pull your chest towards the bar or surface by squeezing your shoulder blades together and bending your elbows.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar or surface.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Bench pull-ups are a bodyweight exercise targeting the lats, performed by pulling your chest up to a horizontal bar or surface while keeping your body straight. This movement also engages the biceps and forearms.
instructions_pt: Posição yourself sob uma barra ou a sturdy horizontal surface that está na altura do peito.
Grab a barra ou surface com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo reto.
Puxe o peitoral em direção à barra ou surface por aproximando bem as escápulas e flexionando os cotovelos.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra ou surface.
Desça o corpo de volta à posição inicial com control.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Remada Invertida com Apoio no Banco (Bench Pull-up)

name: scapula push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you lower, squeeze your shoulder blades together and push your chest forward.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The scapula push-up is a bodyweight exercise that targets the serratus anterior and helps improve scapular mobility and stability. It is performed in a high plank position, focusing on the movement of the shoulder blades rather than the elbows.
instructions_pt: Inicie na alto posição de prancha com as mãos directly sob os ombros e o corpo na linha reta.
Desça o peitoral em direção ao chão, mantendo os cotovelos junto ao corpo.
Ao desça, aproxime bem as escápulas e empurre o peitoral para a frente.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: band fixed back underhand pulldown
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point above your head.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull the band down towards your chest, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
Slowly release the tension in the band and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The band fixed back underhand pulldown is a resistance band exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) and also working the biceps, rhomboids, and rear deltoids. It mimics the motion of a traditional lat pulldown but uses a resistance band anchored above the head.
instructions_pt: Prenda o elástico para a sturdy ponto de fixação acima da cabeça.
Fique de frente para o ponto de fixação com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure o elástico com pegada supinada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Dê um passo de volta para create tension no elástico, mantendo seus braços totalmente estendidos.
Contraia o abdômen e aproxime bem as escápulas.
Puxe o elástico para baixo em direção ao peitoral, leading com os cotovelos.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo do movimento, feeling o contração nas dorsais.
Lentamente solte o tension no elástico e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Puxada Alta Pegada Supinada com Elástico

name: band fixed back close grip pulldown
instructions: Attach the band to a fixed point above you, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Sit down on a bench or chair facing the band, with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Grasp the band with a close grip, palms facing towards you.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
Slowly release the band back to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The band fixed back close grip pulldown is an exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) using a resistance band anchored above the user. It mimics the traditional cable pulldown but uses a band for resistance, making it accessible and effective for building back strength.
instructions_pt: Prenda o elástico para a fixed point acima você, such as a puxe-para cima bar ou sturdy beam.
Sente-se para baixo em um banco ou chair virado para o elástico, com os pés apoiado no chão e os joelhos flexionado.
Segure o elástico com pegada fechada, palmas voltadas para você.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e contraia o abdômen.
Puxe o elástico para baixo em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo do movimento, feeling o contração nas dorsais.
Lentamente solte o elástico de volta à posição inicial, mantendo o controle throughout o movimento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Puxada Alta Pegada Fechada com Elástico

name: potty squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if you were sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The potty squat is a bodyweight exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the quadriceps and glutes. It involves squatting down as if sitting on a chair, maintaining a straight back and upright chest, and then returning to a standing position.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés pointing levemente para fora.
Desça o corpo para baixo flexionando os joelhos e empurrando o quadril de volta como se você were sitting na chair.
Mantenha seu peito estufado e as costas reto throughout o movimento.
Desça o corpo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão ou as baixo ao can comfortably go.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo e empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: resistance band seated shoulder press
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band with both hands, palms facing forward, and bring it up to shoulder level.
Press the band overhead, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The resistance band seated shoulder press is an overhead pressing exercise performed while seated, using a resistance band to target the deltoid muscles. It also engages the triceps and upper back as secondary muscles. This exercise is suitable for building shoulder strength and stability, and is accessible for most fitness levels due to the controlled movement and support provided by the seated position.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na chair ou banco com as costas reto e pés apoiado no chão.
Segure o elástico de resistência com ambas as mãos, palmas voltadas para a frente, e aproxime o peso para cima até a altura dos ombros.
Empurre o elástico acima da cabeça, estendendo os braços totalmente.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o elástico de volta para baixo até a altura dos ombros.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento para Ombros Sentado com Elástico

name: resistance band seated biceps curl
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and arms extended down by your sides.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the resistance band up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the resistance band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The resistance band seated biceps curl is an upper arm exercise that targets the biceps using a resistance band while seated, making it accessible and safe for most fitness levels.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na chair ou banco com as costas reto e pés apoiado no chão.
Segure o elástico de resistência com pegada supinada, palmas voltadas para cima, e braços estendidos para baixo por seu lados.
Mantendo os braços firmes e imóveis, expire e flexione o elástico de resistência para cima em direção aos ombros.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, contraindo bem os bíceps.
Inspire e lentamente desça o elástico de resistência de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: resistance band seated chest press
instructions: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the resistance band handles in each hand, with your palms facing down and elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arms forward, pushing the resistance band away from your chest.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The resistance band seated chest press is a chest-focused exercise performed while sitting, using a resistance band to provide tension. It targets the pectoral muscles and also works the shoulders and triceps. This movement is performed by pressing the band forward from the chest while seated, making it accessible and safe for most fitness levels.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na chair ou banco com as costas reto e pés apoiado no chão.
Segure o elástico de resistência manoplas em cada mão, com suas palmas voltadas para baixo e cotovelos flexionado a 90 graus.
Estenda os braços para a frente, empurrando o elástico de resistência longe do peitoral.
Faça uma breve pausa no end do movimento, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Supino Reto na Máquina Sentado com Elástico

name: resistance band foot external rotation
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with knees bent ~90° and both feet flat, hip‑width apart.
Loop a small resistance band around the forefeet; keep the non‑working foot still to act as the anchor.
Brace your core, keep the working heel planted and shin vertical.
Rotate the working foot outward (eversion/external rotation), leading with the little toe; do not let the knee or hip twist.
Pause briefly at end range without pain, feeling the outer lower leg engage.
Return slowly to neutral under control; avoid the band snapping back.
Complete reps, then switch sides; keep movements small, smooth, and pain‑free.
description: Sit on a bench with a light loop band around both forefeet; one foot anchors the band while the other rotates outward against the resistance. Keep the heel down and move only at the ankle to train the lateral lower-leg muscles.
instructions_pt: Sente-se ereto em um banco ou chair com joelhos flexionado ~90° e ambos os pés apoiado, quadril‑largura afastados.
Loop a small elástico de resistência around o forefeet; mantenha o non‑working pé still para act as o anchor.
Brace o core, mantenha o working calcanhar planted e shin vertical.
Gire o working pé para fora (eversion/external rotation), leading com o little ponta do pé; do not Mantenha o joelho ou quadril gire.
Faça uma breve pausa em end range sem pain, feeling o outer desça perna contraia.
Retorne lentamente para neutral sob control; avoid o elástico snapping de volta.
Complete reps, em seguida troque lados; mantenha movements small, smooth, e pain‑free.

name: resistance band foot plantar flexion
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with knees at ~90° and the working heel lightly on the floor.
Loop the band around the ball of the working foot; anchor the other end under your opposite foot or hold it to create light tension.
Set the ankle in neutral (shin vertical, foot at 90°).
Press through the ball of the foot to plantarflex, pointing the toes away while keeping the knee still and heel gently grounded.
Pause briefly at end range without letting the ankle roll inward or outward.
Slowly return to the start over 2–3 seconds, controlling the resistance.
Repeat for reps, then switch sides; stop if you feel sharp pain in the Achilles or ankle joint.
description: Seated, loop a resistance band around the ball of the working foot and anchor the other end securely. Plantarflex the ankle by pointing the toes against the band, then return under control.
instructions_pt: Sente-se ereto em um banco ou chair com joelhos em ~90° e o working calcanhar lightly no chão.
Loop o elástico around o bola do working pé; anchor o outro end sob seu pé oposto ou segure o peso para create light tension.
Set o tornozelo em neutral (shin vertical, pé em 90°).
Empurre através do bola do pé para plantarflex, pointing o pontas dos pés longe enquanto mantendo o joelho still e calcanhar gently grounded.
Faça uma breve pausa em end range sem letting o tornozelo roll para dentro ou para fora.
Lentamente retorne para o inicie sobre 2-3 seconds, controlling o resistance.
Repita por reps, em seguida troque lados; stop if você feel sharp pain no Achilles ou tornozelo joint.

name: resistance band foot eversion
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with knees at 90 degrees and feet flat.
Loop the band around the ball of the working foot; anchor the other end under the opposite foot so it pulls the forefoot inward.
Keep the working heel lightly on the floor and the knee still; ankle starts neutral.
Evert the foot by sweeping the forefoot outward against the band without rotating the knee or hip.
Pause 1–2 seconds at end range, keeping toes relaxed and the arch lifted.
Return slowly to neutral under control, maintaining light tension in the band.
Complete 10–20 reps, then switch sides; adjust band length to achieve a pain‑free, controlled range.
description: Seated with a band looped around the ball of the working foot and anchored under the opposite foot, rotate the sole outward against the band. This isolates the ankle evertors to strengthen the lateral lower leg and support the ankle.
instructions_pt: Sente-se ereto na chair com joelhos em 90 graus e pés apoiado.
Loop o elástico around o bola do working pé; anchor o outro end sob o pé oposto so o peso pulls o forefoot para dentro.
Mantenha o working calcanhar lightly no chão e o joelho still; tornozelo starts neutral.
Evert o pé por sweeping o forefoot para fora contra o elástico sem girando o joelho ou quadril.
Faça uma pausa 1-2 seconds em end range, mantendo pontas dos pés relaxed e o arch lifted.
Retorne lentamente para neutral sob control, mantendo light tension no elástico.
Complete 10-20 reps, em seguida troque lados; ajuste elástico length para achieve a pain‑free, controlled range.

name: resistance band foot inversion
instructions: Sit tall with knees bent ~90°, heel of the working foot on the floor and toes slightly dorsiflexed.
Loop the band around the forefoot and anchor it to the outside (under the opposite foot or a sturdy object) so it pulls laterally.
Brace the lower leg; do not let the knee or hip move.
Pull the inside edge of the foot inward (invert) against the band in a slow, controlled motion.
Pause 1–2 seconds at end range without pain or cramping.
Return slowly to neutral under control; avoid letting the band snap you back or everting past neutral.
Keep heel down and avoid excessive plantarflexion; breathe steadily.
Complete desired reps, then switch sides.
description: Sit with a resistance band looped around the forefoot of the working leg and anchored laterally so it pulls the foot outward. Rotate the foot inward against the band to strengthen the medial ankle stabilizers, keeping the shin still.
instructions_pt: Sente-se ereto com joelhos flexionado ~90°, calcanhar do working pé no chão e pontas dos pés levemente dorsiflexed.
Loop o elástico around o forefoot e anchor o peso para o outside (sob o pé oposto ou a sturdy object) so o peso pulls laterally.
Brace o desça perna; do not Mantenha o joelho ou quadril move.
Puxe o inside edge do pé para dentro (invert) contra o elástico na slow, controlled movimento.
Faça uma pausa 1-2 seconds em end range sem pain ou cramping.
Retorne lentamente para neutral sob control; avoid letting o elástico snap você de volta ou everting past neutral.
Mantenha calcanhar para baixo e avoid excessive plantarflexion; breathe steadily.
Complete desejado reps, em seguida troque lados.

name: potty squat with support
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold onto a stable support, such as a chair or wall, for balance.
Lower your body down into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight throughout the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The potty squat with support is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, performed with the assistance of a stable support for balance. It is suitable for those developing lower body strength and proper squat mechanics.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés pointing levemente para fora.
Segure-se na stable support, such as a chair ou wall, por balance.
Desça o corpo para baixo em posição de agachamento flexionando os joelhos e empurrando o quadril de volta.
Mantenha seu peito estufado e as costas reto throughout o movimento.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo e empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: smith sumo squat
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper back and shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your body down into a squat position, pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith sumo squat is a lower body exercise performed on a smith machine, targeting the glutes with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The wide stance and guided bar path make it accessible for those developing squat technique and lower body strength.
instructions_pt: Set para cima o aparelho Smith com a barra em quadril altura.
Fique em pé com os pés wider than na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés apontados para fora.
Posição yourself sob a barra, apoiando o peso em seu upper de volta e ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha seu peito estufado ao desça o corpo para baixo em posição de agachamento, empurrando o quadril de volta e flexionando os joelhos.
Desça o corpo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão, ou as baixo ao can comfortably go.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo e empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: resistance band seated straight back row
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop the resistance band around your feet.
Hold the ends of the resistance band with your hands, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly back, engaging your core.
Pull the resistance band towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The resistance band seated straight back row targets the upper back muscles and is performed seated on the floor with a resistance band looped around the feet. It emphasizes scapular retraction and upper back strength.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com as pernas estendidas e loop o elástico de resistência around os pés.
Segure o ends do elástico de resistência com as mãos, palmas voltadas uma para a outra.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e incline levemente de volta, contraindo o abdômen.
Puxe o elástico de resistência em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida solte lentamente o tension e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: push-up plus
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Once your chest is just above the ground, push through your hands to extend your arms and lift your upper body up.
At the top of the movement, protract your shoulder blades by pushing your upper back towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement by retracting your shoulder blades and lowering your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The push-up plus is a variation of the standard push-up that adds an extra movement at the top of the push-up by protracting the shoulder blades, which further engages the serratus anterior and improves shoulder stability.
instructions_pt: Inicie na alto posição de prancha com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros e o corpo na linha reta de cabeça para calcanhares.
Desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo os pesos próximo a seu lados.
Once o peitoral está just acima o chão, empurre através das mãos para estenda os braços e levante o tronco para cima.
No topo do movimento, protract o ombro blades por empurrando seu upper de volta em direção ao ceiling.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida inverta o movimento por retracting o ombro blades e descendo o corpo de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: pelvic tilt
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands by your sides.
Engage your abs and tilt your pelvis upward, pressing your lower back into the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, focusing on contracting your abs.
Release the tilt and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The pelvic tilt is a bodyweight exercise that targets the abdominal muscles and helps improve core stability and lower back health. It is often used in rehabilitation and as a foundational movement for beginners.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos por seu lados.
Contraia o abdômen e tilt seu pelvis para cima, empurrando seu desça de volta no chão.
Sustente essa posição pela few seconds, focusing em contraindo o abdômen.
Solte o tilt e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: chin tuck
instructions: Sit or stand upright with shoulders relaxed and eyes looking straight ahead.
Brace lightly through your midsection and keep your jaw relaxed.
Without tilting your head up or down, draw your chin straight backward as if sliding your head along a track.
Feel the back of your neck lengthen and the front of your neck gently engage; keep eyes level.
Hold for 3–5 seconds while breathing normally.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for 8–12 controlled reps.
description: Sit or stand tall with neutral posture. Glide your head straight back to create a gentle double-chin, aligning the cervical spine; hold briefly, then return to neutral.
instructions_pt: Sente-se ou fique em pé upright com ombros relaxed e eyes looking reto ahead.
Brace lightly através de seu midsection e mantenha seu jaw relaxed.
Sem tilting a cabeça para cima ou para baixo, draw o queixo reto para trás como se sliding a cabeça along a track.
Feel o de volta do pescoço lengthen e o frente do pescoço gently contraia; mantenha eyes altura.
Segure por 3-5 seconds enquanto breathing normally.
Retorne lentamente à posição inicial e repita por 8-12 controlled reps.

name: assisted chin tuck
instructions: Stand with your upper back close to a wall, feet hip‑width, knees soft, chest tall.
Place one or two fingers on the tip of your chin to guide the motion; keep eyes level.
Without tilting the head, glide your chin straight back, making a small “double chin.”
Lightly touch the back of your head to the wall at the base of the skull while keeping the neck long.
Hold 3–5 seconds, breathe normally, and keep shoulders relaxed (no shrugging).
Slowly release to the start position and repeat for controlled reps.
Avoid jutting the chin forward, looking up/down, or opening the mouth during the movement.
description: Stand tall with your back near a wall and use your fingers to gently guide your chin straight backward to align the head over the spine. This assisted chin tuck reinforces cervical retraction without neck flexion or extension.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com seu upper de volta próximo à wall, pés quadril‑largura, joelhos soft, peitoral tall.
Posicione um ou dois fingers no tip do queixo para guide o movimento; mantenha eyes altura.
Sem tilting o cabeça, glide o queixo reto de volta, making a small "double chin."
Lightly toque o de volta da cabeça para o wall no base do skull enquanto mantendo o pescoço long.
Segure 3-5 seconds, breathe normally, e mantenha ombros relaxed (no shrugging).
Lentamente solte para o inicie posição e repita por controlled reps.
Avoid jutting o chin para a frente, looking para cima/para baixo, ou opening o mouth during o movimento.

name: bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in one hand with a neutral grip.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The bodyweight standing close-grip one arm row is a unilateral exercise targeting the upper back, performed with body weight and focusing on pulling strength and stability.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, joelhos levemente flexionados, e segure um halter em uma mão com pegada neutra.
Flexione para a frente no quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
