Puxe o halter para cima em direção ao peitoral, mantendo seu cotovelo junto ao corpo e aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o halter de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de lado.
name_pt: Remada em Pé Unilateral Pegada Fechada Corporal

name: bodyweight standing close-grip row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, gripping the bar or handles with a close grip.
Pull the bar or handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight standing close-grip row targets the upper back using only body weight for resistance. It involves pulling a bar or handles towards the body while maintaining a bent-over position, focusing on squeezing the shoulder blades together.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Flexione para a frente no waist, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Estenda os braços reto à sua frente, gripping a barra ou manoplas com pegada fechada.
Puxe a barra ou manoplas em direção ao corpo, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Remada em Pé Pegada Fechada Corporal

name: bodyweight standing one arm row (with towel)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a towel with one hand.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the towel back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: A bodyweight exercise targeting the upper back, performed by pulling a towel with one arm while standing, engaging the biceps and forearms as secondary muscles.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, joelhos levemente flexionados, e segure a towel com uma mão.
Flexione para a frente no quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Puxe o towel em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o towel de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e passe para o outro braço.

name: bodyweight standing one arm row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down in front of you, with your arm fully extended.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The bodyweight standing one arm row is a unilateral exercise targeting the upper back, performed by hinging at the hips and pulling a weight toward the chest with one arm.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, joelhos levemente flexionados, e segure um halter em uma mão.
Flexione para a frente no quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Mantenha o halter hang reto para baixo à sua frente, com o braço totalmente estendidos.
Puxe o halter para cima em direção ao peitoral, mantendo seu cotovelo junto ao corpo.
Aproxime bem as escápulas no topo do movimento.
Desça o halter de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de lado.

name: bodyweight standing row (with towel)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a towel in front of you with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight standing row (with towel) is a back exercise that targets the upper back using a towel for resistance. It also engages the biceps and shoulders. The movement is performed by pulling the towel towards your chest while maintaining a strong posture.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure a towel à sua frente com ambas as mãos.
Flexione levemente os joelhos e incline o tronco à frente a partir do quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Puxe o towel em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida solte lentamente o tension e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: bodyweight standing row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Grasp a bar or handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Pull the bar or handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement.
Slowly release and extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight standing row is a back exercise that targets the upper back using only body weight for resistance. It also engages the biceps and shoulders as secondary muscles. The movement involves pulling a bar or handles towards the body while standing, focusing on squeezing the shoulder blades together.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure uma barra ou manoplas com pegada pronada, palmas voltadas para baixo.
Mantenha a coluna ereta e core engaged.
Puxe a barra ou manoplas em direção ao corpo, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento.
Lentamente solte e estenda os braços de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: bodyweight squatting row (with towel)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a towel in front of you with your palms facing down.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and your chest up.
As you lower into the squat, simultaneously pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then slowly return to the starting position while extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight squatting row (with towel) is a compound exercise that targets the upper back while also engaging the biceps and shoulders. It combines a squat with a rowing motion using a towel for resistance, making it a functional movement that develops strength and coordination.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando a towel à sua frente com suas palmas voltadas para baixo.
Flexione os joelhos e desça o corpo em posição de agachamento, mantendo a coluna ereta e seu peito estufado.
Ao desça em posição de agachamento, simultaneamente puxe o towel em direção ao peitoral, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo do squat, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial enquanto estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: bodyweight squatting row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding onto a sturdy object or suspension trainer with your arms extended.
Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and your knees behind your toes.
From the squat position, pull your body up towards the object or suspension trainer, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight squatting row is a compound exercise that targets the upper back while also engaging the biceps and shoulders. It combines a squatting motion with a rowing movement, requiring coordination and strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando-se na sturdy object ou suspension trainer com seus braços estendidos.
Desça o corpo em posição de agachamento, mantendo a coluna ereta e os joelhos atrás as pontas dos pés.
Do squat posição, puxe o corpo para cima em direção ao object ou suspension trainer, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma pausa no topo e retorne o corpo controladamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: glute-ham raise
instructions: Adjust the glute-ham raise machine to fit your body.
Position yourself face down on the machine with your ankles secured.
Place your hands on your chest or cross them over your chest.
Engage your hamstrings and glutes to lift your upper body up towards the ceiling.
Continue lifting until your body is in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The glute-ham raise is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the hamstrings, with secondary emphasis on the glutes and lower back. It is performed on a glute-ham raise machine and requires significant strength and control to execute properly.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o glute-ham eleve aparelho para fit o corpo.
Posição yourself face para baixo no aparelho com seu tornozelos travado.
Posicione as mãos no peitoral ou cruze os pesos sobre o peitoral.
Contraia os posteriores de coxa e glutes para levante o tronco para cima em direção ao ceiling.
Continue levantando até o corpo está na linha reta da cabeça para os calcanhares.
Faça uma pausa no topo e retorne o corpo controladamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: frankenstein squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell in front of your body with straight arms.
Keeping your back straight, lower your body by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The Frankenstein squat is a variation of the squat where the barbell is held in front of the body with straight arms, challenging the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. This exercise emphasizes posture, core stability, and lower body strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e segure a barra em frente ao corpo com reto braços.
Mantendo a coluna ereta, desça o corpo flexionando os joelhos e o quadril, como se sentando em uma cadeira.
Continue descendo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão, ou as baixo ao can comfortably go.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lever lying two-one leg curl
instructions: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your legs on the lever pad, just above your ankles.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper body still, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever lying two-one leg curl is an isolation exercise targeting the hamstrings using a leverage machine. It involves curling the legs towards the glutes while lying on the machine, focusing on one leg at a time for increased intensity and muscle engagement.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o aparelho para fit o corpo e sente-se no peso com as costas contra o backrest.
Posicione as pernas no lever apoio, just acima seu tornozelos.
Segure as manoplas no lados do aparelho por support.
Mantendo seu upper corpo still, expire e flexione as pernas para cima em direção aos glúteos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida inspire e lentamente desça as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: quick feet run
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and elbows at about 90 degrees.
Engage your core and lean your torso forward just a few degrees, staying on the balls of your feet.
Begin taking very short, rapid steps in place, minimizing ground contact time.
Pump your arms in opposition to your legs while keeping shoulders relaxed and down.
Keep hips level, torso upright, and land quietly on the forefoot—avoid heel striking and excessive vertical bounce.
Maintain a brisk, steady rhythm for the prescribed time; stop if posture or cadence breaks down.
description: A fast-feet drill performed in place to elevate heart rate and improve leg turnover. Run on the balls of your feet with short, rapid steps while keeping an athletic, upright posture.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé tall com pés na largura do quadril, joelhos levemente flexionados, e cotovelos em about 90 graus.
Contraia o abdômen e incline o tronco para a frente just a few graus, staying no balls dos pés.
Begin taking very short, rapid steps em posicione, minimizing chão contact time.
Pump os braços em opposition para as pernas enquanto mantendo ombros relaxed e para baixo.
Mantenha quadril altura, tronco upright, e aterrisse quietly no forefoot-avoid calcanhar striking e excessive vertical bounce.
Mantenha a brisk, steady rhythm pelo prescribed time; stop if posture ou cadence breaks para baixo.

name: prancing
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, toes pointing forward, arms relaxed or in a gentle running swing for balance.
Shift weight to your right forefoot and press through the ball of the foot to lift the right heel high; keep the knee soft, not locked.
Keep the left heel lightly on the ground as you rise on the right, maintaining an upright torso and braced core.
Lower the right heel under control as you transfer weight to the left forefoot.
Lift the left heel high while the right foot returns to flat, continuing to alternate sides in a smooth rhythm.
Maintain even tempo, forefoot contact, and neutral ankles (don’t roll outward or inward).
Breathe steadily and stop before losing form or bouncing excessively.
description: Stand tall and alternately rise onto one forefoot while lowering the other heel, mimicking a light prancing motion. Keep the torso upright and move through a full ankle range with controlled rhythm.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com pés na largura do quadril, pontas dos pés pointing para a frente, braços relaxed ou na gentle running swing por balance.
Transfira o peso para o antepé direito e empurre pela ponta do pé para elevar bem o calcanhar direito; mantenha o joelho destravado.
Mantenha o calcanhar esquerdo lightly no chão ao rise à direita, mantendo an upright tronco e braced core.
Desça o calcanhar direito sob control ao transfer peso para a esquerda forefoot.
Levante o calcanhar esquerdo alto enquanto o pé direito returns para apoiado, continuing para alterne lados na smooth rhythm.
Mantenha even tempo, forefoot contact, e neutral tornozelos (don't roll para fora ou para dentro).
Breathe steadily e stop before losing form ou bouncing excessively.

name: zigzag hops
instructions: Stand athletic: feet hip-width, knees softly bent, chest up, eyes forward.
Load through the hips and ankles and hop diagonally over the line to the opposite side of the next cone, landing on the balls of your feet.
Absorb the landing softly by bending the ankles, knees, and hips while keeping knees tracking over toes.
Immediately rebound into the next diagonal hop, using arm swing for balance and rhythm.
Maintain a neutral torso and keep hops low-to-moderate and quick to emphasize control and reactivity.
Continue hopping past all cones, then walk back to recover and repeat for the desired reps or time.
If form degrades, slow the pace or reduce hop distance/height.
description: Set 4–6 cones in a straight line and stand to one side of the first cone. Hop diagonally from side to side over the line of cones, moving forward in a zigzag on the balls of your feet.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé athletic: pés quadril-largura, joelhos softly flexionado, peito estufado, eyes para a frente.
Load através do quadril e tornozelos e hop diagonally sobre o line para o lado oposto do next cone, aterrissando no balls dos pés.
Absorb o aterrissando softly por flexionando o tornozelos, joelhos, e quadril enquanto mantendo joelhos tracking sobre pontas dos pés.
Immediately rebound no next diagonal hop, using braço swing por balance e rhythm.
Mantenha a neutral tronco e mantenha hops baixo-para-moderate e quick para emphasize control e reactivity.
Continue hopping past all cones, em seguida walk de volta para recover e Repita pelo número desejado reps ou time.
If form degrades, slow o pace ou reduce hop distance/altura.

name: skips
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width, arms bent about 90°, core braced, and eyes forward.
Push through the ball of your left foot to hop as you drive your right knee to hip height and swing the left arm forward/right arm back.
Land softly on your left forefoot with a slight bend in the ankle, knee, and hip; keep your torso upright.
Step onto your right foot and immediately hop, driving the left knee up with an opposite arm swing.
Maintain quick, light ground contacts, knees tracking over toes, and dorsiflex the airborne foot.
Alternate sides continuously for time or distance while breathing steadily and avoiding excessive forward lean.
description: From a tall stance, perform rhythmic skipping steps, driving one knee up with an opposite arm swing while lightly hopping off the stance foot. Land softly and alternate sides to elevate heart rate and coordination.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé tall com pés quadril-largura, braços flexionado about 90°, core braced, e eyes para a frente.
Empurre através do bola de seu pé esquerdo para hop ao empurre com força seu joelho direito para quadril altura e swing o braço esquerdo para a frente/braço direito de volta.
Aterrisse suavemente sobre o antepé esquerdo com leve flexão no tornozelo, joelho e quadril, mantendo o tronco ereto.
Dê um passo onto seu pé direito e immediately hop, driving o joelho esquerdo para cima com an braço oposto swing.
Mantenha quick, light chão contacts, joelhos tracking sobre pontas dos pés, e dorsiflex o airborne pé.
Alterne lados continuously por time ou distance enquanto breathing steadily e avoiding excessive para a frente incline.

name: lever bent-over row with v-bar
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself facing the machine.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Pull the v-bar towards your abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the weight back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever bent-over row with v-bar is a machine-based exercise targeting the upper back, with secondary emphasis on the biceps and forearms. It involves pulling a v-bar attachment towards the abdomen while maintaining a bent-over position, focusing on squeezing the shoulder blades together.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself virado para o aparelho.
Segure o v-bar com pegada pronada, mantendo a coluna ereta e os joelhos levemente flexionados.
Puxe o v-bar em direção a seu abdomen, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida solte lentamente a carga de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: quarter sit-up
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The quarter sit-up is an abdominal exercise that involves lifting your upper body off the ground to about a 45-degree angle, focusing on engaging the abs with minimal hip flexor involvement.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraindo o abdômen, lentamente levante o tronco do chão, flexionando para a frente até o tronco formar um ângulo de 45 graus.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: half sit-up (male)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The half sit-up (male) is an abdominal exercise performed with body weight. It involves curling the upper body off the ground to a 45-degree angle, primarily targeting the abs and secondarily engaging the hip flexors.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraindo o abdômen, lentamente levante o tronco do chão, flexionando para a frente até o tronco formar um ângulo de 45 graus.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: prisoner half sit-up (male)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The prisoner half sit-up is an abdominal exercise performed with body weight, focusing on the abs and hip flexors. It involves lying on your back, hands behind your head, and curling your torso up to a 45-degree angle before lowering back down.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraindo o abdômen, lentamente levante o tronco do chão, flexionando para a frente até o tronco formar um ângulo de 45 graus.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: arms overhead full sit-up (male)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms overhead, keeping them straight.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is upright.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The arms overhead full sit-up is a bodyweight abdominal exercise where you lie on your back with arms extended overhead and perform a full sit-up, engaging the abs, hip flexors, and lower back.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Estenda os braços acima da cabeça, mantendo-os estendidos.
Contraindo o abdômen, lentamente levante o tronco do chão, flexionando para a frente até o tronco está upright.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Abdominal Completo com Braços Acima da Cabeça

name: kneeling push-up (male)
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, so that your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Continue lowering until your chest is just above the ground, then push back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The kneeling push-up (male) is a bodyweight exercise targeting the pectorals, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. It is performed from a kneeling position, making it a less challenging variation of the standard push-up, suitable for building foundational upper body strength.
instructions_pt: Comece kneeling no chão com as mãos na largura dos ombros, fingers pointing para a frente.
Estenda as pernas atrás você, apoiando no balls dos pés, de modo que seu corpo forms a linha reta de cabeça para calcanhares.
Contraia o abdômen e desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo os pesos próximo a seu lados.
Continue descendo até o peitoral está just acima o chão, em seguida empurre de volta para cima à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: basic toe touch (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with your hands, keeping your legs as straight as possible.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The basic toe touch is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and calves. It involves bending forward at the waist to reach towards the toes, providing a stretch to the posterior chain.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e os braços por seu lados.
Flexione para a frente no waist, mantendo a coluna ereta e os joelhos levemente flexionados.
Alcance para baixo em direção às pontas dos pés com as mãos, mantendo seu pernas as reto as possible.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Toque nos Pés Curvado (Alongamento de Posteriores)

name: side-to-side toe touch (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend at the waist to the right, reaching your right hand towards your right foot while keeping your left hand extended to the side.
Return to the starting position and then bend at the waist to the left, reaching your left hand towards your left foot while keeping your right hand extended to the side.
Repeat the side-to-side bending motion for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The side-to-side toe touch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abs, obliques, and hip flexors. It involves bending at the waist to touch each foot alternately, promoting core engagement and flexibility.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e seus braços estendidos para o lados.
Flexione no waist para a direita, alcançando seu mão direita em direção a seu pé direito enquanto mantendo seu mão esquerda estendido para o lado.
Retorne à posição inicial e em seguida flexione no waist para a esquerda, alcançando seu mão esquerda em direção a seu pé esquerdo enquanto mantendo seu mão direita estendido para o lado.
Repita o lado-para-lado flexionando movimento pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Abdominal Toque no Pé Alternando Lados

name: arms apart circular toe touch (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended to the sides.
Keeping your legs straight, bend forward at the waist and reach down towards your toes with your right hand.
As you reach down, simultaneously lift your left leg straight up behind you, maintaining balance.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left hand reaching towards your toes and your right leg lifting up behind you.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The arms apart circular toe touch is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps, and calves. It involves bending forward at the waist to touch your toes with one hand while lifting the opposite leg behind you, alternating sides to challenge balance and flexibility.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e braços estendidos para o lados.
Mantendo seu pernas reto, flexione para a frente no waist e alcance para baixo em direção às pontas dos pés com seu mão direita.
Ao alcance para baixo, simultaneamente levante seu perna esquerda reto para cima atrás você, mantendo balance.
Retorne à posição inicial e Repita o movimento com seu mão esquerda alcançando em direção às pontas dos pés e seu perna direita levantando para cima atrás você.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Toque nos Pés Circular com Braços Abertos

name: hands reversed clasped circular toe touch (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down with your hands and clasp them together behind your legs.
Slowly raise your hands up and over your head in a circular motion, keeping your legs straight.
Continue the circular motion until your hands touch your toes.
Reverse the motion and bring your hands back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise involves standing with feet shoulder-width apart, bending forward at the waist, clasping hands behind the legs, and performing a circular motion with the arms to touch the toes, targeting the glutes and stretching the lower body.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e seus braços estendidos para o lados.
Flexione para a frente no waist, mantendo a coluna ereta e os joelhos levemente flexionados.
Alcance para baixo com as mãos e clasp os pesos juntos atrás as pernas.
Lentamente eleve as mãos para cima e sobre a cabeça na circular movimento, mantendo seu pernas reto.
Continue o circular movimento até as mãos toque as pontas dos pés.
Inverta o movimento e aproxime as mãos de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Toque nos Pés Circular com Mãos Entrelaçadas

name: chest tap push-up (male)
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, tap your chest with your right hand.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time tapping your chest with your left hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The chest tap push-up is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the pectorals while also engaging the triceps and shoulders. It requires strength, coordination, and balance as you momentarily support your body with one hand while tapping your chest with the other.
instructions_pt: Inicie na alto posição de prancha com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros e o corpo na linha reta.
Desça o corpo em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo os pesos próximo a seu lados.
Ao Desça o corpo, tap o peitoral com seu mão direita.
Empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial.
Repita o movimento, this time tapping o peitoral com seu mão esquerda.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: modified hindu push-up (male)
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart.
Lower your body towards the ground, bending your elbows and keeping your core engaged.
As you lower your body, shift your weight back and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, creating an inverted V shape with your body.
Continue to lower your body until your chest is just above the ground, then reverse the movement, pushing your hips back down and extending your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The modified Hindu push-up is a bodyweight exercise that targets the pectorals while also engaging the triceps, shoulders, and core. It involves a dynamic movement pattern that combines elements of a push-up with a downward dog-like position, challenging both strength and mobility.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros e os pés na largura do quadril.
Desça o corpo em direção ao chão, flexionando os cotovelos e mantendo o abdômen contraído.
Ao desça o corpo, transfira o peso do corpo de volta e levante o quadril para cima em direção ao ceiling, creating an inverted V shape com o corpo.
Continue para desça o corpo até o peitoral está just acima o chão, em seguida inverta o movimento, empurrando o quadril de volta para baixo e estendendo os braços para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: hands clasped circular toe touch (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands clasped together in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your hands towards your toes in a circular motion, reaching as far as you can without straining.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The hands clasped circular toe touch is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes and also engages the hamstrings, quadriceps, and calves. It involves hinging at the hips and making a circular motion with your hands towards your toes, promoting flexibility and mobility in the lower body.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e as mãos clasped juntos em frente ao peitoral.
Flexione levemente os joelhos e incline o tronco à frente a partir do quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Desça as mãos em direção às pontas dos pés na circular movimento, alcançando o máximo que conseguir sem straining.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Toque nos Pés Circular com Mãos Unidas

name: scissor jumps (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Jump off the ground and simultaneously cross your right leg in front of your left leg.
As you land, quickly switch legs, crossing your left leg in front of your right leg.
Continue alternating legs and jumping as quickly as possible.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Scissor jumps are a plyometric cardio exercise that involves jumping and alternating the crossing of your legs in mid-air. This movement elevates the heart rate and challenges coordination and lower body strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Salte do chão e simultaneamente cruze seu perna direita em frente a seu perna esquerda.
Ao aterrisse, quickly troque pernas, cruzando seu perna esquerda em frente a seu perna direita.
Continue alternando pernas e saltando as quickly as possible.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: astride jumps (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively upwards, extending your legs and arms.
While in the air, spread your legs apart and bring your arms out to the sides.
Land softly with your feet shoulder-width apart, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Astride jumps (male) are a plyometric cardio exercise that involves jumping explosively from a squat position, spreading the legs and arms in the air, and landing softly. This movement targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Flexione os joelhos e desça o corpo em posição de agachamento.
Salte explosively upwards, estendendo as pernas e braços.
Enquanto no air, spread as pernas afastados e aproxime os braços para fora para o lados.
Aterrisse suavemente com os pés na largura dos ombros, flexionando os joelhos para absorb o impact.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: half knee bends (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down as if you were sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your weight in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Half knee bends (male) are a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes. The movement involves bending the knees and lowering the body as if sitting back into a chair, then returning to standing. This exercise is often used for light cardio, warm-ups, or rehabilitation.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Flexione os joelhos e desça o corpo para baixo como se você were sentando em uma cadeira.
Mantenha seu peito estufado e seu peso nos calcanhares.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo e empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: semi squat jump (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively, extending your hips and knees while swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The semi squat jump is a plyometric exercise that targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves performing a partial squat followed by an explosive jump, making it effective for improving cardiovascular fitness, lower body power, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Flexione os joelhos e desça o corpo em posição de agachamento.
Salte explosively, estendendo o quadril e joelhos enquanto swinging os braços por momentum.
Aterrisse suavemente no balls dos pés e immediately go no next repetition.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: star jump (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and jump up explosively.
As you jump, spread your legs and extend your arms out to the sides, forming a star shape with your body.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The star jump (male) is a plyometric cardio exercise that involves jumping explosively while spreading the arms and legs out to form a star shape in the air. It targets the cardiovascular system and also engages the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e os braços por seu lados.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e salte para cima explosively.
Ao salte, spread as pernas e estenda os braços para fora para o lados, forming a star shape com o corpo.
Aterrisse suavemente no balls dos pés com os joelhos levemente flexionados.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: jack jump (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump up, spreading your feet apart and raising your arms above your head.
As you land, quickly jump back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A dynamic bodyweight exercise that involves jumping with feet apart and arms overhead, then returning to the starting position. This movement elevates the heart rate and targets the cardiovascular system, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps and calves.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés juntos e os braços por seu lados.
Salte para cima, spreading os pés afastados e elevando os braços acima da cabeça.
Ao aterrisse, quickly salte de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: two toe touch (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended out to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with both hands, keeping your legs straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The two toe touch (male) is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the spine, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and glutes. It involves bending forward at the waist to touch your toes, promoting flexibility and mobility in the posterior chain.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e seus braços estendidos para fora para o lados.
Flexione para a frente no waist, mantendo a coluna ereta e os joelhos levemente flexionados.
Alcance para baixo em direção às pontas dos pés com ambas as mãos, mantendo seu pernas reto.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Toque nos Pés com Pernas Afastadas

name: hyght dumbbell fly
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement and bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The hyght dumbbell fly is a chest exercise performed on a bench using dumbbells. It targets the pectoral muscles and also engages the shoulders. The movement involves lowering the dumbbells in a wide arc to stretch the chest and then bringing them back together above the chest.
instructions_pt: Deite-se no banco reto com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas uma para a outra.
Estenda os braços reto para cima sobre o peitoral, com a slight flexione nos cotovelos.
Mantendo a slight flexione nos cotovelos, desça os halteres para fora para o lados na wide arc até você sentir um alongamento em seu peitoral.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida inverta o movimento e aproxime os halteres de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: cable assisted inverse leg curl
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle attachment is at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs straight and the ankle attachment secured to your ankles.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable assisted inverse leg curl is an exercise targeting the hamstrings, performed using a cable machine to provide resistance as you curl your legs toward your glutes while lying face down.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o máquina de polia de modo que o tornozelo attachment está no lowest setting.
Deite-se de bruços no banco com as pernas reto e o tornozelo attachment travado para seu tornozelos.
Segure-se nas manoplas do banco por stability.
Mantendo seu upper corpo stationary, expire e flexione as pernas para cima em direção aos glúteos por flexing os joelhos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, contraindo os posteriores de coxa.
Inspire e lentamente desça as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female)
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your feet flexed.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on your hips or extend them out in front of you for balance.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Push your hips forward and squeeze your glutes as you lift your knees off the ground, extending your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your knees back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female) target the glutes primarily, with secondary activation of the hamstrings and quadriceps. The exercise is performed by kneeling, using a resistance band for added tension, and thrusting the hips forward to engage the glutes.
instructions_pt: Comece kneeling no chão com os joelhos na largura do quadril e os pés flexed.
Wrap o elástico de resistência around suas coxas, just acima os joelhos.
Posicione as mãos no quadril ou estenda os pesos para fora à sua frente por balance.
Contraia os glúteos e core muscles.
Empurre o quadril para a frente e contraia os glúteos ao levante os joelhos do chão, estendendo o quadril até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão.
Sustente a posição pela instante, em seguida desça lentamente os joelhos de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação Pélvica de Joelhos com Elástico

name: landmine lateral raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, resting it on the front of your shoulders.
Keeping your core engaged and back straight, lift the barbell up and away from your body, raising it to shoulder height.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The landmine lateral raise is a shoulder exercise performed using a barbell anchored at one end (landmine setup). It targets the deltoids and also engages the traps and upper back. The movement involves lifting the barbell laterally to shoulder height, emphasizing shoulder strength and stability.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure a barra com pegada pronada, apoiando o peso no frente dos ombros.
Mantendo o abdômen contraído e a coluna ereta, levante a barra para cima e longe do corpo, elevando o peso até a altura dos ombros.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a barra de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: kneeling plank tap shoulder (male)
instructions: Start in a kneeling position with your hands on the ground, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on your toes, and lift your body into a plank position.
Keeping your core engaged and your hips stable, lift one hand off the ground and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return the hand to the ground and repeat with the other hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The kneeling plank tap shoulder is a core stability exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the shoulders and triceps. It requires maintaining a stable plank position while alternately tapping each shoulder with the opposite hand, challenging balance and coordination.
instructions_pt: Inicie na kneeling posição com as mãos no chão, na largura dos ombros.
Estenda as pernas atrás você, apoiando nas pontas dos pés, e levante o corpo em um posição de prancha.
Mantendo o abdômen contraído e o quadril stable, levante uma mão do chão e tap o oposto ombro.
Retorne o mão para o chão e Repita com o outro mão.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between knees)
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of you.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your knees.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise targets the calves by performing a calf raise while standing against a wall with an exercise ball supporting the lower back and a tennis ball held between the knees. Dumbbells are held for added resistance, and the movement requires balance and coordination.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com as costas contra a wall e posicione an bola suíça entre seu desça de volta e o wall.
Posição os pés na largura dos ombros e levemente à sua frente.
Segure um halter em cada mão, com seus braços estendidos por seu lados.
Posicione a tennis bola entre os joelhos.
Eleve os calcanhares do chão, levantando o corpo para cima onto as pontas dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação de Panturrilha na Bola Suíça

name: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between ankles)
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place an exercise ball between the wall and your lower back.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your ankles.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: This exercise targets the calves by performing a calf raise while holding a dumbbell in each hand, using an exercise ball for back support against the wall, and squeezing a tennis ball between the ankles to increase activation and control.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a wall com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Posicione an bola suíça entre o wall e seu desça de volta.
Segure um halter em cada mão, com seus braços estendidos por seu lados.
Posicione a tennis bola entre seu tornozelos.
Eleve os calcanhares do chão, levantando o corpo para cima onto as pontas dos pés.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os calcanhares à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação de Panturrilha na Bola Suíça

name: smith full squat
instructions: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step under the bar and position it across your upper back, resting on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and take a step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith full squat is a compound lower body exercise performed using a smith machine. It primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The smith machine provides stability, making it accessible to those who may not be comfortable with free-weight squats, but still requires proper form and core engagement.
instructions_pt: Set para cima o aparelho Smith com a barra na altura dos ombros.
Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, pontas dos pés levemente turned para fora.
Dê um passo sob a barra e posição o peso através de seu upper de volta, apoiando em seu traps.
Pegada a barra com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Unrack a barra e take a dê um passo de volta, mantendo a stable stance.
Mantendo seu peito estufado e core engaged, initiate o squat por empurrando o quadril de volta e flexionando os joelhos.
Desça o corpo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão, ou as baixo as seu flexibility allows.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre com força pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: weighted muscle up
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you reach the top of the movement, transition your grip so that your palms are facing towards you.
Continue pulling yourself up until your chest reaches the bar, then pause for a moment.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted muscle up is an advanced compound exercise that targets the lats and involves pulling your body above a bar with added resistance. It requires significant upper body strength, coordination, and technique, making it suitable for experienced athletes.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging da puxe-para cima bar com suas palmas voltadas para a frente e suas mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, leading com o peitoral.
Ao alcance o topo do movimento, transition seu pegada de modo que seu palms estão virado para em direção a você.
Continue puxando yourself para cima até o peitoral reaches a barra, em seguida faça uma breve pausa.
Lentamente Desça o corpo de volta à posição inicial, mantendo o controle throughout o movimento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: elbow dips
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your hips forward off the bench and straighten your legs, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Elbow dips are a bodyweight exercise targeting the triceps, performed using a bench or chair. The movement involves lowering and raising the body by bending and straightening the elbows while keeping the back close to the bench.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na ponta do banco ou chair com as mãos gripping o edge next para o quadril.
Slide o quadril para a frente do banco e straighten as pernas, mantendo seus calcanhares no chão.
Flexione os cotovelos e desça o corpo em direção ao chão, mantendo seu de volta próximo ao banco.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre através das mãos para straighten os braços e levante o corpo de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: korean dips
instructions: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms extended and supporting your body weight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Korean dips are a challenging bodyweight exercise performed on parallel bars, targeting the pectorals, triceps, and shoulders. The movement requires significant upper body strength, shoulder mobility, and stability, as the body is lowered deeply between the bars before pressing back up.
instructions_pt: Posição yourself entre dois barras paralelas com seus braços estendidos e supporting o corpo peso.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos até os braços estejam paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: impossible dips
instructions: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Impossible dips are a challenging bodyweight exercise performed between two parallel bars, focusing on the triceps while also engaging the chest and shoulders. The movement requires significant upper body strength and control, as well as experience with dip variations.
instructions_pt: Posição yourself entre dois barras paralelas com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo suspended no air.
Flexione os joelhos e cruze seu tornozelos.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos até os braços estejam paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: weighted one hand pull up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arm fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbow and squeezing your back muscles.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted one hand pull up is an advanced bodyweight exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi (lats) and also engages the biceps and forearms. By adding weight, this movement significantly increases the strength and coordination required, making it a challenging exercise for experienced athletes.
instructions_pt: Grab o puxe-para cima bar com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso na barra com o braço totalmente estendidos e o corpo reto.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra por flexionando o cotovelo e contraindo as costas muscles.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra.
Desça o corpo de volta à posição inicial com control.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: stalder press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended overhead.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Lower your body down into a squat position while keeping your arms extended overhead.
As you squat down, press your arms down towards the ground, engaging your triceps.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then push through your heels to stand back up while simultaneously raising your arms back overhead.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The stalder press is a challenging bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the triceps, while also engaging the shoulders and core. It involves a combination of squatting and pressing movements, requiring significant strength, balance, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Comece em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e seus braços estendidos acima da cabeça.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e contraia o abdômen.
Desça o corpo para baixo em posição de agachamento enquanto mantendo seus braços estendidos acima da cabeça.
Ao squat para baixo, empurre os braços para baixo em direção ao chão, contraindo os tríceps.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo do squat, em seguida empurre pelos calcanhares para ficar em pé novamente enquanto simultaneamente elevando os braços de volta acima da cabeça.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: elevator
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Place your hands on your hips or cross them in front of your chest.
Keeping your back straight, slowly bend forward at the waist, lowering your upper body towards the ground.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise your upper body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The elevator is a bodyweight exercise targeting the upper back. It involves bending forward at the waist while keeping the back straight, then returning to a standing position. This movement helps strengthen the upper back and improves posture.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Posicione as mãos no quadril ou cruze os pesos em frente ao peitoral.
Mantendo a coluna ereta, lentamente flexione para a frente no waist, descendo o tronco em direção ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida lentamente eleve o tronco de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: archer pull up
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
As you pull yourself up, bend one arm and bring your elbow towards your side, while keeping the other arm straight.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar and your bent arm is fully flexed.
Lower yourself back down with control, straightening the bent arm and repeating the movement on the other side.
Alternate sides with each repetition.
description: The archer pull up is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the lats and requires significant strength, coordination, and control. It involves pulling up with one arm while the other remains straight, alternating sides with each repetition.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging da puxe-para cima bar com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe o ombro blades para baixo e de volta.
Ao puxe yourself para cima, flexione um braço e aproxime o cotovelo em direção a seu lado, enquanto mantendo o outro braço reto.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra e seu flexionado braço está totalmente flexed.
Desça o corpo de volta para baixo com control, estendendo o flexionado braço e repeating o movimento no outro lado.
Alterne lados com cada repetition.

name: archer push up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, extending the opposite arm out to the side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The archer push up is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the pectorals and also works the triceps, shoulders, and core. It involves performing a push-up while extending one arm out to the side, increasing the load on the working arm and requiring significant strength, balance, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Estenda um braço estendidos para o lado, paralelos ao chão.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Empurre de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado, estendendo o braço oposto para fora para o lado.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: front lever reps
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Keeping your body straight, lift your legs up until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, aiming for 10-20 seconds.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The front lever is an advanced calisthenics exercise that targets the upper back, core, and shoulders. It requires significant strength, body control, and coordination to maintain a horizontal position while hanging from a bar.
instructions_pt: Fique suspenso na barra fixa com pegada pronada, palmas voltadas para a frente.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe o ombro blades para baixo e de volta.
Mantendo seu corpo reto, levante as pernas para cima até they estejam paralelas ao chão.
Sustente essa posição pelas long ao can, aiming por 10-20 seconds.
Lentamente desça as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: front lever
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Simultaneously, lift your legs up and extend them straight out in front of you, keeping your body parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, aiming for a full front lever position.
To release, slowly lower your legs back down and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The front lever is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the abs and requires significant strength and control from the lats, shoulders, and forearms. It involves holding your body parallel to the ground while hanging from a pull-up bar.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging da puxe-para cima bar com pegada pronada, mãos na largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe o ombro blades para baixo e de volta.
Flexione os joelhos e tuck os pesos em direção ao peitoral.
Simultaneamente, levante as pernas para cima e estenda os pesos estendidos à sua frente, mantendo seu corpo paralelos ao chão.
Sustente essa posição pelas long ao can, aiming pela full frente lever posição.
Para solte, lentamente desça as pernas de volta para baixo e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: back lever
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Slowly lift your legs up, keeping them straight, until your body is parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The back lever is a challenging bodyweight exercise performed on a pull-up bar, requiring significant strength, balance, and body control. It targets the upper back and also engages the biceps, forearms, and core.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging da puxe-para cima bar com pegada pronada, mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe o ombro blades para baixo e de volta.
Flexione os joelhos e tuck os pesos em direção ao peitoral.
Lentamente levante as pernas para cima, mantendo-os estendidos, até o corpo está paralelo ao chão.
Sustente essa posição pela few seconds, em seguida desça lentamente as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: straddle planche
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet spread wide apart.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders over your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The straddle planche is an advanced bodyweight exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the shoulders, triceps, and chest. It requires significant core strength, balance, and coordination to hold the body parallel to the ground with only the hands supporting the weight.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos na largura dos ombros e os pés spread wide afastados.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente transfira o peso do corpo para a frente, aproximando os ombros sobre as mãos.
Flexione os cotovelos e desça o corpo em direção ao chão, mantendo seus cotovelos próximo a seu lados.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre através das mãos para straighten os braços e levante o corpo de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: full planche
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your fingers pointing forward.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, lifting your feet off the ground.
Continue shifting your weight forward until your body is parallel to the ground, balancing on your hands.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your feet back to the ground and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The full planche is an advanced bodyweight exercise that requires significant core strength, balance, and upper body control. It involves holding your body parallel to the ground, supported only by your hands, with no other contact points.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos na largura dos ombros e seu fingers pointing para a frente.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente transfira o peso do corpo para a frente, levantando os pés do chão.
Continue shifting seu peso para a frente até o corpo está paralelo ao chão, balancing nas mãos.
Sustente essa posição pelas long ao can, mantendo a reto corpo line.
Lentamente desça os pés de volta para o chão e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: lean planche
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body straight.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders past your hands.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and your body straight as you lean forward.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lean planche is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the abdominal muscles while also engaging the shoulders, chest, and triceps. It requires significant core strength, balance, and upper body control as you lean your body forward in a plank-like position, shifting your weight past your hands.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos na largura dos ombros e o corpo reto.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente transfira o peso do corpo para a frente, aproximando os ombros past as mãos.
Mantenha seus cotovelos levemente flexionados e o corpo reto ao incline para a frente.
Sustente essa posição pela few seconds, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: frog planche
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back straight.
As you lower your body, lift your feet off the ground and bring your knees towards your chest.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then extend your legs back out and push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The frog planche is an advanced bodyweight exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the shoulders, chest, and triceps. It requires significant core strength, balance, and upper body control.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos na largura dos ombros e os pés juntos.
Flexione os cotovelos e desça o corpo em direção ao chão, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Ao desça o corpo, levante os pés do chão e aproxime os joelhos em direção ao peitoral.
Sustente essa posição pela few seconds, em seguida estenda as pernas de volta para fora e empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: handstand
instructions: Find an open space with enough room to perform a handstand.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Kick your legs up towards the wall, using your core and shoulders to maintain balance.
Once in a handstand position, engage your triceps to support your body weight.
Hold the handstand for as long as you can maintain balance.
To come down, slowly lower your legs back to the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The handstand is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the triceps, while also engaging the shoulders and core. It requires significant balance, strength, and coordination to perform safely and effectively.
instructions_pt: Find an open space com enough room para perform a handstand.
Posicione as mãos no chão na largura dos ombros, fingers pointing para a frente.
Kick as pernas para cima em direção ao wall, using o core e ombros para mantenha balance.
Once na handstand posição, contraia os tríceps para support o corpo peso.
Segure o handstand pelas long ao can mantenha balance.
Para come para baixo, lentamente desça as pernas de volta para o chão.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: flag
instructions: Start by gripping a vertical pole with both hands, palms facing each other, and arms fully extended.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Using your core and upper body strength, raise your legs until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The flag is an advanced bodyweight exercise that targets the abs and requires significant core, shoulder, and grip strength. It involves gripping a vertical pole and lifting the body horizontally, holding a straight line parallel to the ground.
instructions_pt: Comece gripping a vertical pole com ambas as mãos, palmas voltadas uma para a outra, e braços totalmente estendidos.
Contraia o abdômen e levante as pernas do chão, mantendo-os estendidos.
Using o core e upper corpo strength, eleve as pernas até they estejam paralelas ao chão.
Sustente essa posição pelas long ao can, mantendo a reto corpo line.
Lentamente desça as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: skin the cat
instructions: Start by hanging from a bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Engage your core and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Continue to lift your legs up and over your head, allowing your body to pass through the arms.
Once your legs are fully extended over your head, begin to lower them back down towards the starting position.
As you lower your legs, allow your body to pass back through the arms until you are hanging with your arms fully extended again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Skin the cat is a gymnastic movement performed on a bar, where you hang, lift your legs over your head, rotate your body through your arms, and then return to the starting position. It requires significant upper body and core strength, as well as shoulder mobility and coordination.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging de uma barra com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo relaxed.
Contraia o abdômen e levante as pernas para cima, aproximando os joelhos em direção ao peitoral.
Continue para levante as pernas para cima e sobre a cabeça, allowing o corpo para pass através do braços.
Once as pernas estão totalmente estendidos sobre a cabeça, begin para desça os pesos de volta para baixo em direção ao posição inicial.
Ao desça as pernas, allow o corpo para pass de volta através do braços até você estão hanging com os braços totalmente estendidos again.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell thruster
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your heels to stand up, simultaneously pressing the barbell overhead.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height as you lower back into the squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell thruster is a compound exercise that combines a front squat with an overhead press, targeting the shoulders and engaging multiple muscle groups for strength and power.
instructions_pt: Comece em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando uma barra na altura dos ombros com pegada pronada.
Desça em posição de agachamento flexionando os joelhos e empurrando o quadril de volta.
Ao alcance o ponto mais baixo do agachamento, explosively empurre com força pelos calcanhares para fique em pé para cima, simultaneamente empurrando a barra acima da cabeça.
Desça a barra de volta até a altura dos ombros ao desça de volta em posição de agachamento posição.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: strongman fingal's fingers
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width at the free end of the hinged pole, shins close to the implement.
Grip the end securely with both hands underneath, chest up, shoulders packed, and spine neutral.
Brace your core, pull the pole tight to your body, and initiate the lift by driving through your heels, extending knees and hips together.
Keep the implement close as it rises past the knees; re-adjust your hand position if needed to transition from lifting to pushing.
Continue hip and knee extension while driving the pole upward; as it nears vertical, step forward under it and press through the arms to guide it over.
Finish by tipping the pole past its balance point under control, letting it fall safely to the opposite side.
Reset your stance on the new side, re-brace, and repeat. Avoid jerking, twisting, or rounding your back at any point.
description: Lift a hinged strongman pole (Fingal’s Finger) from the ground and drive it up using leg and hip extension, then press and walk it past vertical to tip it over. Reset on the opposite side and repeat for reps or distance.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com pés ombro-largura no free end do hinged pole, shins próximo ao implement.
