Pegada o end securely com ambas as mãos underneath, peito estufado, ombros packed, e spine neutral.
Brace o core, puxe o pole tight para o corpo, e initiate o levante por driving pelos calcanhares, estendendo joelhos e quadril juntos.
Mantenha o implement fechado as o peso rises past o joelhos; re-ajuste a mão posição if needed para transition de levantando para empurrando.
Continue quadril e joelho extension enquanto driving o pole para cima; as o peso nears vertical, dê um passo para a frente sob o peso e empurre através do braços para guide o peso sobre.
Finish por tipping o pole past its balance point sob control, letting o peso fall safely para o lado oposto.
Reset seu stance no new lado, re-brace, e repita. Avoid jerking, girando, ou rounding as costas em any point.

name: strongman keg toss
instructions: Clear a safe landing zone in front of you and stand shoulder‑width apart with the keg slightly in front, gripping the rims/sides securely.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back, soften the knees, and brace your abs as you pull the keg to swing slightly between your legs.
Drive through the floor and extend hips, knees, and ankles explosively, squeezing the glutes as the keg travels upward.
Keep the chest tall, shrug, and guide the keg overhead with straightening arms; release when the keg is on a rising arc slightly above eye level.
Finish tall with hips and knees locked out, keeping your body out of the keg’s path.
Let the keg land in the clear area, then walk to it and reset your stance and grip for the next repetition.
description: Explosive toss of a weighted keg using a powerful hip hinge and triple extension to project the load overhead. Set up in a shoulder‑width stance, hinge to load the hips, then drive upward to release the keg while keeping a neutral spine.
instructions_pt: Clear a safe aterrissando zone à sua frente e fique em pé ombro‑largura afastados com o keg levemente em frente, gripping o rims/lados securely.
Incline o tronco no quadril com a apoiado de volta, soften o joelhos, e brace o abdômen ao puxe o keg para swing levemente entre as pernas.
Empurre com força através do chão e estenda quadril, joelhos, e tornozelos explosively, contraindo o glutes as o keg travels para cima.
Mantenha o peitoral tall, shrug, e guide o keg acima da cabeça com estendendo braços; solte when o keg está na rising arc levemente acima eye altura.
Finish tall com quadril e joelhos locked para fora, mantendo seu corpo para fora do keg's path.
Mantenha o keg aterrisse no clear area, em seguida walk para o peso e reset seu stance e pegada pelo next repetition.

name: weighted muscle up (on bar)
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your elbows and pull your chest towards the bar, keeping your body straight.
Once your chest reaches the bar, push down with your hands and drive your elbows back, lifting your body above the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted muscle up (on bar) is an advanced calisthenics exercise that combines a pull-up with a dip, performed while adding extra weight. It targets the lats and also works the biceps, triceps, shoulders, and forearms. This movement requires significant upper body strength, coordination, and technique, especially when performed with additional weight.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging da puxe-para cima bar com suas palmas voltadas para a frente e suas mãos ligeiramente mais afastadas que a largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e puxe o ombro blades para baixo e de volta.
Flexione os cotovelos e puxe o peitoral em direção à barra, mantendo seu corpo reto.
Once o peitoral reaches a barra, empurre para baixo com as mãos e empurre com força os cotovelos de volta, levantando o corpo acima a barra.
Faça uma pausa no topo do movimento, em seguida desça lentamente yourself de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Muscle-up na Barra com Carga Adicional

name: weighted straight bar dip
instructions: Position yourself between parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted straight bar dip is a compound chest exercise performed on parallel bars with added weight for increased resistance. It primarily targets the pectorals, with significant involvement of the triceps and shoulders.
instructions_pt: Posição yourself entre barras paralelas com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo reto.
Desça o corpo flexionando os cotovelos até os braços estejam paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Mergulho nas Paralelas com Carga Adicional

name: straddle maltese
instructions: Start by hanging from a pair of rings with your arms fully extended and your body in a straight line.
Spread your legs wide apart, forming a straddle position.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The straddle maltese is an advanced bodyweight exercise performed on rings, targeting the abs with significant involvement of the shoulders and chest. It requires exceptional core strength, shoulder stability, and body control, making it a challenging movement for experienced athletes.
instructions_pt: Comece hanging da pair de rings com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo na linha reta.
Spread as pernas wide afastados, forming a straddle posição.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente desça o corpo até os braços estejam paralelas ao chão.
Sustente essa posição pela few seconds, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: full maltese
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight out to the sides.
Slowly lean forward, keeping your arms straight, until your upper body is parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and hold this position for a few seconds.
Return to the starting position by pushing through your feet and standing back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The full maltese is an advanced bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the abs, with significant involvement of the shoulders and chest. It requires a high degree of core strength, balance, and body control, making it a challenging movement for most practitioners.
instructions_pt: Comece em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e os braços estendido em linha reta para fora para o lados.
Lentamente incline para a frente, mantendo os braços estendidos, até o tronco está paralelo ao chão.
Contraia o abdômen e sustente essa posição pela few seconds.
Retorne à posição inicial por empurrando através dos pés e standing de volta para cima.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell weightlifting complex
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over midfoot, hands just outside legs; brace and set a neutral spine.
Initiate a power clean: push through the floor, extend hips and knees violently, shrug, then pull under and catch the bar on the shoulders with elbows high.
Set feet shoulder-width and perform one controlled front squat to comfortable depth, keeping torso upright and knees tracking over toes; stand tall.
Dip 2-3 inches by bending knees and hips together, then drive up and press the bar overhead to full lockout (push press) with ribs down.
Lower the bar back to the front rack, then to the hips, and guide it to the floor with control to reset.
Repeat the sequence for the prescribed reps, stopping if bar speed slows or form degrades.
description: Using a light-to-moderate Olympic barbell, perform a continuous sequence of a power clean to the front rack, one front squat, and a push press before returning the bar to the floor. Maintain a neutral spine and keep the bar close to the body throughout.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com pés quadril-largura, bar sobre midfoot, mãos just outside pernas; brace e set a neutral spine.
Initiate a power clean: empurre através do chão, estenda quadril e joelhos violently, shrug, em seguida puxe sob e catch a barra no ombros com cotovelos alto.
Set pés ombro-largura e perform um controlled frente squat para comfortable depth, mantendo tronco upright e joelhos tracking sobre pontas dos pés; fique em pé tall.
Dip 2-3 inches por flexionando joelhos e quadril juntos, em seguida empurre com força para cima e empurre a barra acima da cabeça para full lockout (empurre empurre) com ribs para baixo.
Desça a barra de volta para o frente rack, em seguida para o quadril, e guide o peso para o chão com control para reset.
Repita o sequence pelo prescribed reps, stopping if bar speed slows ou form degrades.

name: strongman car flip
instructions: Stand facing the object with feet just outside shoulder width and toes slightly out; brace your core and set a neutral spine.
Hinge and squat to reach under the edge with a mixed or supinated grip, keeping the object close to your shins and chest up.
Pack the lats and take the slack out, then drive through your heels to extend knees and hips together to bring the object to mid‑thigh.
As it rises, step one foot forward and transition one or both hands to a pushing position on the edge.
Continue driving hips forward and use your legs and chest to tip the object past its balance point—do not curl with the arms.
Push it over and guide the descent, keeping fingers clear of the landing zone.
Reset your stance, re-brace, and repeat for the next rep, avoiding rounding or twisting under load.
description: Face the front edge of a heavy flip implement and squat to hook your hands under the lip. Drive through your legs and hips to lift, then step and push the object over under control.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para o object com pés just outside ombro largura e pontas dos pés levemente para fora; brace o core e set a neutral spine.
Incline o tronco e squat para alcance sob o edge com a mixed ou supinated pegada, mantendo o object próximo a seu shins e peito estufado.
Pack o lats e take o slack para fora, em seguida empurre com força pelos calcanhares para estenda joelhos e quadril juntos para aproxime o object para mid‑coxa.
As o peso rises, dê um passo um pé para a frente e transition um ou ambos os mãos para a empurrando posição no edge.
Continue driving quadril para a frente e use as pernas e peitoral para tip o object past its balance point-do not flexione com o braços.
Empurre o peso sobre e guide o descent, mantendo fingers clear do aterrissando zone.
Reset seu stance, re-brace, e repita pelo next rep, avoiding rounding ou girando sob load.

name: swing 360
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and swing your arms in a circular motion, rotating your torso as you do so.
Continue the circular motion, swinging your arms and rotating your torso for the desired number of repetitions.
Remember to breathe throughout the exercise.
description: The swing 360 is a dynamic bodyweight exercise that targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the shoulders and core. It involves swinging the arms in a circular motion while rotating the torso, making it a great movement for increasing heart rate and improving coordination.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Segure os braços estendidos à sua frente, paralelos ao chão.
Contraia o abdômen e swing os braços na circular movimento, girando o tronco ao do so.
Continue o circular movimento, swinging os braços e girando o tronco pelo número desejado de repetições.
Remember para breathe throughout o exercise.
name_pt: Giro Circular de Braços com Rotação 360° (Swing 360)

name: full planche push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lower your body down towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, lean your body forward and lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your hands.
Continue to lower your body until your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to lift your body back up to the starting position.
Maintain a straight line from your head to your heels throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The full planche push-up is an advanced bodyweight exercise that targets the pectorals, shoulders, triceps, and core. It requires significant strength, balance, and coordination as you perform a push-up while balancing your entire body off the ground with only your hands.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos placed levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Contraia o abdômen e desça o corpo para baixo em direção ao chão, mantendo seus cotovelos próximo a seu lados.
Ao Desça o corpo, incline o corpo para a frente e levante os pés do chão, balancing nas mãos.
Continue para desça o corpo até o peitoral está just acima o chão.
Empurre através das mãos e estenda os braços para levante o corpo de volta para cima à posição inicial.
Mantenha a linha reta da cabeça para os calcanhares throughout o movimento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: bear crawl
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Lift your knees slightly off the ground, keeping your back flat and your core engaged.
Move your right hand and left foot forward simultaneously, followed by your left hand and right foot.
Continue crawling forward, alternating your hand and foot movements.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your core tight throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired distance or time.
description: The bear crawl is a full-body movement that targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the core, shoulders, and triceps. It involves crawling on all fours with knees off the ground, requiring coordination and endurance.
instructions_pt: Inicie em all fours com as mãos directly sob os ombros e os joelhos directly sob o quadril.
Levante os joelhos levemente do chão, mantendo seu de volta apoiado e o core engaged.
Move seu mão direita e pé esquerdo para a frente simultaneamente, followed por seu mão esquerda e pé direito.
Continue crawling para a frente, alternando a mão e pé movements.
Mantenha a steady pace e mantenha o abdômen firme throughout o exercise.
Continue pelo desejado distance ou time.

name: skater hops
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and jump to the right, landing on your right foot.
As you land, swing your left leg behind your right leg and tap the ground with your left toes.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot.
As you land, swing your right leg behind your left leg and tap the ground with your right toes.
Continue alternating sides, jumping and tapping the ground with each leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Skater hops are a dynamic, lateral jumping exercise that targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the lower body muscles. The movement mimics a speed skater's motion, helping to improve agility, coordination, and cardiovascular endurance.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e salte para a direita, aterrissando em seu pé direito.
Ao aterrissar, cruze a perna esquerda por trás da perna direita e toque o chão com a ponta do pé esquerdo.
Immediately salte para a esquerda, aterrissando em seu pé esquerdo.
Ao aterrissar, cruze a perna direita por trás da perna esquerda e toque o chão com a ponta do pé direito.
Continue alternando lados, saltando e tapping o chão com cada perna.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: l-pull-up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your lats and biceps to pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The L-pull-up is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the lats while also engaging the core, biceps, and forearms. It requires the lifter to maintain an 'L' position with the legs extended straight out in front, parallel to the ground, throughout the pull-up movement.
instructions_pt: Grab o puxe-para cima bar com uma pegada pronada, um pouco mais aberta que a largura dos ombros.
Fique suspenso com os braços totalmente estendidos e o corpo reto.
Contraia as dorsais e biceps para puxe o corpo para cima em direção à barra, mantendo os cotovelos junto ao corpo.
Continue puxando até o queixo está acima a barra.
Faça uma pausa no topo e retorne o corpo controladamente à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: l-sit on floor
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your hands on the floor beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Try to bring your legs parallel to the floor, forming an 'L' shape with your body.
Hold this position for as long as you can.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The L-sit on floor is a challenging core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. It requires significant core strength, balance, and coordination to lift and hold the legs parallel to the floor while supporting the body with the arms.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com as pernas estendidas à sua frente.
Posicione as mãos no chão beside o quadril, fingers pointing para a frente.
Contraia o abdômen e levante as pernas do chão, mantendo-os estendidos.
Try para aproxime as pernas paralelos ao chão, forming an 'L' shape com o corpo.
Sustente essa posição pelas long ao can.
Lentamente desça as pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: v-sit on floor
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Lean back slightly and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Simultaneously, lift your upper body off the ground and reach your arms towards your legs.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your upper body and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The V-sit on floor is a core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles and also engages the hip flexors. It requires balance, core strength, and coordination as you hold your body in a V-shape, balancing on your tailbone.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com as pernas estendidas à sua frente.
Incline de volta levemente e levante as pernas do chão, mantendo-os estendidos.
Simultaneamente, levante o tronco do chão e alcance os braços em direção às pernas.
Sustente essa posição pela few seconds, em seguida desça lentamente o tronco e pernas de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: swimmer kicks v. 2 (male)
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended overhead.
Engage your core and lift your chest and legs off the ground simultaneously.
Kick your legs up and down in a fluttering motion, as if you were swimming.
Continue kicking for the desired number of repetitions.
Lower your chest and legs back down to the starting position.
description: Swimmer kicks v. 2 (male) is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings, quadriceps, and calves. It involves lying face down and performing a flutter kick motion with the legs while keeping the chest and legs elevated off the ground.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de bruços na mat com seus braços estendidos acima da cabeça.
Contraia o abdômen e levante o peitoral e pernas do chão simultaneamente.
Kick as pernas para cima e para baixo na fluttering movimento, como se você were swimming.
Continue kicking pelo número desejado de repetições.
Desça o peitoral e pernas de volta à posição inicial.

name: forward lunge (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hands on your hips.
Take a big step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Bend your right knee to about 90 degrees, keeping your knee aligned with your ankle.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The forward lunge is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping forward into a lunge position and returning to standing, alternating legs.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura do quadril e mãos no quadril.
Take a big dê um passo para a frente com seu pé direito, descendo o corpo em um lunge posição.
Flexione seu joelho direito para about 90 graus, mantendo seu joelho aligned com seu tornozelo.
Impulsione-se com seu pé direito e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita com seu perna esquerda, alternando lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your back against it and your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the bench beside your hips for support.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then lift your hips off the bench until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The glute bridge with two legs on a bench is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and core. It involves lifting the hips off the ground while the upper back rests on a bench, creating a straight line from knees to shoulders.
instructions_pt: Sente-se na ponta do banco com as costas contra o peso e os pés apoiado no chão.
Posicione as mãos no banco beside o quadril por support.
Contraia os glúteos e hamstrings, em seguida levante o quadril do banco até o corpo forms a linha reta dos joelhos para os ombros.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o quadril de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: quads (bodyweight squat)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Lower yourself until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A bodyweight squat exercise primarily targeting the quadriceps, with secondary activation of the hamstrings and glutes. This movement is fundamental for lower body strength and can be performed without equipment.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Desça o corpo flexionando os joelhos e empurrando o quadril de volta como se sitting na chair.
Mantenha seu peito estufado e as costas reto.
Desça o corpo até suas coxas estejam paralelas ao chão.
Empurre pelos calcanhares para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell incline y-raise
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Lean forward slightly and let your arms hang straight down, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides and up in a Y shape until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline Y-raise is an upper back exercise performed on an incline bench, targeting the upper back, shoulders, and rear deltoids. It involves raising the arms in a Y shape while lying face down on an incline bench, emphasizing scapular stability and shoulder health.
instructions_pt: Set an incline banco para a 45-degree ângulo e sente-se no peso com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para inwards.
Incline para a frente levemente e Mantenha os braços hang reto para baixo, mantendo a slight flexione nos cotovelos.
Eleve os braços para fora para o lados e para cima na Y shape até they estejam paralelas ao chão.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os braços de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação em Y Inclinada com Halteres (Y-Raise)

name: dumbbell incline t-raise
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Lean forward and let your arms hang straight down, perpendicular to the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, raise them out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, forming a 'T' shape with your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline T-raise is an isolation exercise targeting the deltoids, performed on an incline bench to emphasize shoulder and upper back muscles. It requires good form and control to avoid swinging and to properly engage the target muscles.
instructions_pt: Set an incline banco para a 45-degree ângulo e sente-se no peso com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para inwards.
Incline para a frente e Mantenha os braços hang reto para baixo, perpendicular para o chão.
Mantendo os braços estendidos, eleve os pesos para fora para o lados até they estejam paralelas ao chão, forming a 'T' shape com o corpo.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os braços de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Elevação em T Inclinada com Halteres (T-Raise)

name: bodyweight drop jump squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Jump up explosively, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
While in mid-air, quickly bring your feet together.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately drop back into a squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight drop jump squat is a plyometric exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves explosive jumping and rapid foot movement, challenging coordination, power, and lower body strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Desça o corpo em posição de agachamento flexionando os joelhos e empurrando o quadril de volta.
Salte para cima explosively, estendendo o quadril, joelhos, e tornozelos.
Enquanto em mid-air, quickly aproxime os pés juntos.
Aterrisse suavemente no balls dos pés e immediately drop de volta em posição de agachamento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: bodyweight incline side plank
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your hips back down to the ground and repeat on the other side.
description: The bodyweight incline side plank is a core stability exercise that targets the abs, with secondary emphasis on the obliques and shoulders. It involves holding a plank position on your side with your body supported by your forearm and feet, focusing on maintaining a straight line and engaging the core.
instructions_pt: Comece lying em seu lado com seu pernas estendidas e stacked em topo de cada outro.
Posicione o antebraço no chão directly abaixo o ombro, com o cotovelo flexionado a 90 graus.
Contraia o abdômen e levante o quadril do chão, creating a linha reta da cabeça para os pés.
Sustente essa posição pelo desejado amount de time.
Desça o quadril de volta para baixo para o chão e Repita do outro lado.

name: dumbbell incline alternate press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lean back on the bench and use your thighs to help raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Once at shoulder height, rotate your wrists so that the palms of your hands are facing forward.
Push the dumbbells up with your chest and shoulders, extending your arms fully.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating arms.
description: The dumbbell incline alternate press is a chest exercise performed on an incline bench, pressing dumbbells alternately to target the upper chest, shoulders, and triceps.
instructions_pt: Sente-se em an incline banco com um halter em cada mão, apoiando em suas coxas.
Incline de volta no banco e use suas coxas para help eleve os halteres até a altura dos ombros, palmas voltadas para a frente.
Once na altura dos ombros, gire os punhos de modo que o palms das mãos estão virado para para a frente.
Empurre os halteres para cima com o peitoral e ombros, estendendo os braços totalmente.
Desça os halteres de volta à posição inicial, mantendo os cotovelos levemente flexionados.
Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições, alternando braços.

name: dumbbell seated alternate shoulder
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards, and raise them to shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell up overhead while keeping the other dumbbell at shoulder height.
Lower the raised dumbbell back to shoulder height while simultaneously pressing the other dumbbell up overhead.
Continue alternating between arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated alternate shoulder press is a strength exercise targeting the deltoids, performed while seated and alternating arms for each press. It also engages the triceps and upper back as secondary muscles.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com as costas retas e os pés firmes no chão.
Segure um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para inwards, e eleve os pesos até a altura dos ombros.
Empurre um halter para cima acima da cabeça enquanto mantendo o outro halter na altura dos ombros.
Desça o raised halter de volta até a altura dos ombros enquanto simultaneamente empurrando o outro halter para cima acima da cabeça.
Continue alternando entre braços pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento de Ombros Sentado Alternado com Halteres

name: dumbbell seated biceps curl to shoulder press
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your elbows close to your sides, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Once your forearms are vertical, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing forward.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated biceps curl to shoulder press is a compound exercise that targets the biceps and shoulders. It combines a biceps curl with a shoulder press, making it effective for building upper arm and shoulder strength.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no banco com as costas retas e os pés firmes no chão.
Segure um halter em cada mão com suas palmas voltadas para a frente e braços totalmente estendidos.
Mantendo seus cotovelos próximo a seu lados, flexione os halteres para cima em direção aos ombros.
Once os antebraços estão vertical, gire os punhos de modo que seu palms estão virado para para a frente.
Empurre os halteres acima da cabeça até os braços estão totalmente estendidos.
Desça os halteres de volta à posição inicial por reversing o movimento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Desenvolvimento para Ombros Sentado com Halteres

name: dumbbell single arm overhead carry
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Engage your core and keep your back straight as you walk forward, maintaining the dumbbell overhead.
Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
Switch hands and repeat the exercise.
description: The dumbbell single arm overhead carry is a functional exercise that targets the deltoids while also engaging the traps and core. It challenges shoulder stability, core strength, and coordination as you walk while holding a dumbbell overhead.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando um halter em uma mão.
Eleve o halter acima da cabeça, totalmente estendendo o braço.
Contraia o abdômen e mantenha a coluna ereta ao walk para a frente, mantendo o halter acima da cabeça.
Continue walking pelo desejado distance ou time.
Troque mãos e repita o exercise.
name_pt: Caminhada com Halter Acima da Cabeça (Overhead Carry)

name: quick feet v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Begin by rapidly moving your feet up and down, as if you were running in place.
Keep your movements quick and light, focusing on staying on the balls of your feet.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description: Quick feet v. 2 is a bodyweight exercise that involves rapidly moving your feet up and down in place, focusing on speed and agility. It targets the quadriceps while also engaging the calves and hamstrings.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e os braços por seu lados.
Begin por rapidly moving os pés para cima e para baixo, como se você were running em posicione.
Mantenha seu movements quick e light, focusing em staying no balls dos pés.
Continue pelo desejado duration ou number de repetições.

name: dumbbell standing alternate hammer curl and press
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your back straight.
Exhale and curl the dumbbell in your right hand towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the curl with your left hand.
After completing the curl with your left hand, exhale and press the dumbbell in your right hand overhead.
Extend your arm fully and hold for a moment at the top.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the press with your left hand.
Continue alternating between curls and presses for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing alternate hammer curl and press is a compound exercise that targets the biceps, forearms, and shoulders. It involves curling a dumbbell with a neutral grip and then pressing it overhead, alternating arms each repetition.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para o corpo.
Mantenha seus cotovelos próximo ao tronco e as costas reto.
Expire e flexione o halter em seu mão direita em direção ao ombro, mantendo seu upper braço stationary.
Continue para eleve o halter até os bíceps estão totalmente contraído e o halter está na altura dos ombros.
Inspire e desça lentamente o halter de volta à posição inicial.
Repita o flexione com seu mão esquerda.
After completing o flexione com seu mão esquerda, expire e empurre o halter em seu mão direita acima da cabeça.
Estenda o braço totalmente e segure por um instante no topo.
Inspire e desça lentamente o halter de volta à posição inicial.
Repita o empurre com seu mão esquerda.
Continue alternando entre curls e presses pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: glute bridge march
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
While keeping your hips lifted, lift one foot off the ground and bring your knee towards your chest.
Lower your foot back to the ground and repeat the movement with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs in a marching motion while maintaining the bridge position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The glute bridge march is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes while also engaging the hamstrings and quadriceps. It involves holding a glute bridge position and alternately lifting each knee towards the chest in a marching motion, challenging hip stability and core strength.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Contraia os glúteos e levante o quadril do chão, forming a linha reta dos joelhos para os ombros.
Enquanto mantendo seus quadris lifted, levante um pé do chão e aproxime o joelho em direção ao peitoral.
Desça o pé de volta para o chão e Repita o movimento com o outro perna.
Continue alternando pernas na marching movimento enquanto mantendo o bridge posição.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: barbell glute bridge two legs on bench (male)
instructions: Start by sitting on the edge of a bench with your upper back resting against it and your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Place a barbell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Engage your glutes and core muscles, then press through your heels to lift your hips off the bench, creating a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell glute bridge with two legs on a bench is a compound lower body exercise that primarily targets the glutes, while also engaging the hamstrings and core. It is performed by resting your upper back on a bench, placing a barbell across your hips, and driving your hips upward to create a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
instructions_pt: Comece sitting no edge de um banco com seu upper de volta apoiando contra o peso e os pés apoiado no chão, na largura do quadril.
Posicione uma barra através do quadril, segurando o peso securely com ambas as mãos.
Contraia os glúteos e core muscles, em seguida empurre pelos calcanhares para levante o quadril do banco, creating a linha reta dos joelhos para os ombros.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, contraindo bem os glúteos.
Lentamente desça o quadril de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Ponte para Glúteos no Banco com Barra

name: cable one arm pulldown
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the handle with an overhand grip and extend your arm fully.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the handle down towards your side while keeping your elbow close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your lat muscle.
Slowly release the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with the other arm.
description: The cable one arm pulldown is a unilateral exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi using a cable machine. It also engages the biceps and forearms as secondary muscles. The movement requires good form and control to isolate the lats and avoid compensatory movements.
instructions_pt: Prenda a single manopla para a alto pulley máquina de polia.
Fique de frente para o aparelho com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Segure a manopla com pegada pronada e estenda o braço totalmente.
Mantenha as costas retas e o abdômen contraído.
Puxe a manopla para baixo em direção a seu lado enquanto mantendo seu cotovelo junto ao corpo.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo do movimento, contraindo seu lat muscle.
Lentamente solte a manopla de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
Troque lados e repita o exercise com o outro braço.

name: lunge with jump
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Push off with your right foot and jump into the air, switching the position of your feet mid-air.
Land softly with your left foot forward and immediately lower your body into a lunge position.
Continue alternating between lunges and jumps for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lunge with jump is a dynamic lower body exercise that combines a traditional lunge with a plyometric jump, targeting the glutes and also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It requires balance, coordination, and explosive strength.
instructions_pt: Comece em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Take a dê um passo para a frente com seu pé direito, descendo o corpo em um lunge posição.
Impulsione-se com seu pé direito e salte no air, switching o posição dos pés mid-air.
Aterrisse suavemente com seu pé esquerdo para a frente e immediately desça o corpo em um lunge posição.
Continue alternando entre lunges e jumps pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell contralateral forward lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending both knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell contralateral forward lunge is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping forward with one leg while holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand, challenging strength, balance, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando um halter em cada mão.
Take a dê um passo para a frente com seu pé direito, mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído.
Desça o corpo por flexionando ambos os joelhos até seu coxa direita está paralelo ao chão.
Empurre através de seu calcanhar direito para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita com seu perna esquerda.
Alterne pernas pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: high knee against wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your feet hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the wall for support.
Engage your core and lift your right knee up towards your chest, while keeping your left foot on the ground.
Quickly switch legs, bringing your left knee up towards your chest and lowering your right foot back down.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, bringing your knees up as high as possible.
Maintain a fast pace and keep your upper body stable throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description: High knee against wall is a bodyweight cardio exercise that involves running in place while bringing your knees up high, using a wall for balance and support. It targets the cardiovascular system and also works the quadriceps, hamstrings, glutes, and calves.
instructions_pt: Fique de frente para a wall com os pés na largura do quadril.
Posicione as mãos no wall por support.
Contraia o abdômen e levante seu joelho direito para cima em direção ao peitoral, enquanto mantendo seu pé esquerdo no chão.
Quickly troque pernas, aproximando seu joelho esquerdo para cima em direção ao peitoral e descendo seu pé direito de volta para baixo.
Continue alternando pernas na running movimento, aproximando os joelhos para cima as alto as possible.
Mantenha a fast pace e mantenha seu upper corpo stable throughout o exercise.
Repita pelo número desejado duration ou number de repetições.
name_pt: Corrida Estacionária com Joelhos Altos na Parede

name: wheel run
instructions: Start in a plank position with your hands on the wheel and your body straight.
Engage your core and start rolling the wheel forward by extending your arms.
Continue rolling until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Reverse the movement by pulling the wheel back towards your body, using your core and arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The wheel run is a dynamic exercise that targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the core, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves rolling a wheel forward and backward from a plank position, requiring both strength and coordination.
instructions_pt: Inicie na posição de prancha com as mãos no wheel e o corpo reto.
Contraia o abdômen e inicie rolling o wheel para a frente por estendendo os braços.
Continue rolling até o corpo está totalmente estendidos e os braços estão acima da cabeça.
Inverta o movimento por puxando o wheel de volta em direção ao corpo, using o core e braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: push to run
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body straight.
Push through your hands to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Quickly bring one knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring the other knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating knees as fast as you can while maintaining good form.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description: The 'push to run' exercise combines a push-up with a running-in-place motion, alternating knees towards the chest in a plank position. This movement elevates the heart rate and challenges both upper body strength and cardiovascular endurance.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos na largura dos ombros e o corpo na linha reta.
Desça o peitoral em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo seu corpo reto.
Empurre através das mãos para estenda os braços e retorne à posição inicial.
Quickly aproxime um joelho em direção ao peitoral, em seguida quickly troque e aproxime o outro joelho em direção ao peitoral.
Continue alternando joelhos as fast ao can enquanto mantendo good form.
Continue pelo desejado duration ou number de repetições.
name_pt: Arrancada de Corrida da Posição de Flexão (Push to Run)

name: bent knee lying twist (male)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms out to the sides, perpendicular to your body.
Keeping your knees together, slowly lower them to one side, aiming to touch the ground with your knees.
Pause for a moment, then engage your core and slowly lift your knees back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bent knee lying twist (male) is a bodyweight exercise that targets the glutes and also engages the obliques and hip flexors. It involves lying on your back with bent knees and twisting them side to side, which helps improve flexibility and mobility in the lower back and hips.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Estenda os braços para fora para o lados, perpendicular para o corpo.
Mantendo seus joelhos juntos, lentamente desça os pesos para um lado, aiming para toque o chão com os joelhos.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida contraia o abdômen e lentamente levante os joelhos de volta à posição inicial.
Repita o movimento para o outro lado.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: knee touch crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulder blades off the ground and reach your right hand towards your left knee.
Return to the starting position and repeat, this time reaching your left hand towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The knee touch crunch is a bodyweight abdominal exercise that targets the abs and also engages the hip flexors. It involves alternating reaching across the body to touch the opposite knee while performing a crunch motion.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Posicione as mãos suavemente atrás da cabeça com os cotovelos abertos para fora (sem puxar a cervical).
Contraindo o abdômen, levante o ombro blades do chão e alcance seu mão direita em direção ao joelho esquerdo.
Retorne à posição inicial e repita, this time alcançando seu mão esquerda em direção ao joelho direito.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: weighted kneeling step with swing
instructions: Start in a kneeling position with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight.
Hold a weight in each hand, with your arms extended straight down in front of you.
Engage your core and swing the weights up and overhead, keeping your arms straight.
Lower the weights back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted kneeling step with swing is a dynamic exercise that targets the deltoids while also engaging the triceps and core. It involves swinging weights overhead from a kneeling position, requiring coordination, balance, and strength.
instructions_pt: Inicie na kneeling posição com os joelhos na largura do quadril e as costas reto.
Segure a peso em cada mão, com os braços estendido em linha reta para baixo à sua frente.
Contraia o abdômen e swing os pesos para cima e acima da cabeça, mantendo os braços estendidos.
Desça os pesos de volta à posição inicial e Repita pelo número desejado number de repetições.
name_pt: Balanço Frontal de Joelhos com Carga (Kneeling Swing)

name: weighted stretch lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight.
Lower your body by bending your knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted stretch lunge is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping forward into a lunge position while holding weights, then returning to the starting position and alternating legs.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Take a dê um passo para a frente com seu pé direito, mantendo a coluna ereta.
Desça o corpo flexionando os joelhos até seu coxa direita está paralelo ao chão.
Empurre através de seu calcanhar direito para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita com seu perna esquerda.
Continue alternando as pernas pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: weighted cossack squats (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands.
Shift your weight to one side and lower your body by bending the knee of the side you shifted towards, while keeping the other leg straight.
Go as low as you can while maintaining balance and keeping your chest up.
Push through the heel of the bent leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, alternating between legs.
description: Weighted cossack squats are a lower body exercise targeting the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. This movement requires significant balance, mobility, and strength, as you shift your weight laterally and squat deeply on one leg while holding a weight.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés wider than na largura dos ombros e pontas dos pés pointing levemente para fora.
Segure a peso em frente ao peitoral com ambas as mãos.
transfira o peso do corpo para um lado e desça o corpo por flexionando o joelho do lado você shifted em direção a, enquanto mantendo o outro perna reto.
Go as baixo ao can enquanto mantendo balance e mantendo seu peito estufado.
Empurre através do calcanhar do flexionado perna para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado, alternando entre pernas.

name: weighted lunge with swing
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a weight in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
As you lunge forward, swing the weights forward and upward, keeping your arms straight.
Push off with your right foot and return to the starting position, swinging the weights back down.
Repeat with your left foot and continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted lunge with swing is a dynamic lower body exercise that combines a traditional lunge with an upper body swinging motion using weights. This movement targets the glutes primarily, while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The swinging motion adds a coordination and balance challenge.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando um peso em cada mão.
Take a dê um passo para a frente com seu pé direito, descendo o corpo em um lunge posição.
Ao lunge para a frente, swing os pesos para a frente e para cima, mantendo os braços estendidos.
Impulsione-se com seu pé direito e retorne à posição inicial, swinging os pesos de volta para baixo.
Repita com seu pé esquerdo e continue alternando pernas pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: single leg bridge with outstretched leg
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend one leg straight out in front of you.
Engage your glutes and lift your hips off the ground, forming a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The single leg bridge with outstretched leg is a bodyweight exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and quadriceps. It challenges stability and unilateral strength by requiring you to lift your hips while keeping one leg extended.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas com os joelhos flexionado e pés apoiado no chão.
Estenda uma perna estendidos à sua frente.
Contraia os glúteos e levante o quadril do chão, forming a linha reta dos joelhos para os ombros.
Segure por um instante no topo, em seguida desça lentamente o quadril de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de perna.
name_pt: Ponte de Glúteos Unilateral com Perna Estendida

name: walking high knees lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Lift your right knee up towards your chest as high as you can while balancing on your left leg.
Step forward with your right foot and lower your body into a lunge position, bending both knees to a 90-degree angle.
Push off with your right foot and bring your left knee up towards your chest.
Step forward with your left foot and lower your body into a lunge position.
Continue alternating legs and lunging forward, keeping your core engaged and maintaining a steady pace.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The walking high knees lunge is a dynamic exercise that combines high knee raises with forward lunges, targeting the cardiovascular system while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, glutes, and calves. It is performed using only body weight and is effective for improving cardiovascular endurance, coordination, and lower body strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura do quadril.
Levante seu joelho direito para cima em direção ao peitoral as alto ao can enquanto balancing em seu perna esquerda.
Dê um passo para a frente com seu pé direito e desça o corpo em um lunge posição, flexionando ambos os joelhos para a 90-degree ângulo.
Impulsione-se com seu pé direito e aproxime seu joelho esquerdo para cima em direção ao peitoral.
Dê um passo para a frente com seu pé esquerdo e desça o corpo em um lunge posição.
Continue alternando pernas e lunging para a frente, mantendo o abdômen contraído e mantendo a steady pace.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: short stride run
instructions: Find an open space or a treadmill to perform the exercise.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Start jogging in place, lifting your knees high and pumping your arms.
After a few seconds, start taking short strides forward, maintaining a quick pace.
Continue running with short strides for the desired duration or distance.
description: Short stride run is a cardiovascular exercise performed by running with quick, short steps, either in place or moving forward. It primarily targets the cardiovascular system and also engages the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves.
instructions_pt: Find an open space ou a treadmill para perform o exercise.
Fique em pé tall com os pés na largura do quadril.
Inicie jogging em posicione, levantando os joelhos alto e pumping os braços.
After a few seconds, inicie taking short strides para a frente, mantendo a quick pace.
Continue running com short strides pelo desejado duration ou distance.

name: pike-to-cobra push-up
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, forming an inverted V shape with your body.
Lower your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
As you lower down, shift your weight forward and transition into a cobra pose by straightening your arms and lifting your chest up.
Reverse the movement by bending your elbows and lowering your chest back down towards the ground.
Push through your hands to return to the inverted V position.
Continue the movement by lowering your hips back down towards the ground, returning to the starting push-up position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The pike-to-cobra push-up is a dynamic bodyweight exercise that combines elements of a push-up, pike, and cobra pose. It targets the glutes primarily, while also engaging the core, shoulders, and triceps. The movement requires transitioning between an inverted V (pike) position and a cobra pose, demanding strength, flexibility, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Inicie na empurre-para cima posição com as mãos levemente wider than na largura dos ombros e os pés juntos.
Contraia o abdômen e levante o quadril para cima em direção ao ceiling, forming an inverted V shape com o corpo.
Desça o tronco em direção ao chão flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo os pesos junto ao corpo.
Ao desça para baixo, transfira o peso do corpo para a frente e transition em um cobra pose por estendendo os braços e levantando seu peito estufado.
Inverta o movimento flexionando os cotovelos e descendo o peitoral de volta para baixo em direção ao chão.
Empurre através das mãos para retorne para o inverted V posição.
Continue o movimento descendo o quadril de volta em direção ao chão, retornando à posição inicial de flexão de braço.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: reverse plank with leg lift
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you and your hands resting on the ground behind you, fingers pointing towards your feet.
Press through your hands and lift your hips off the ground, coming into a reverse plank position.
Engage your core and lift one leg off the ground, extending it straight up towards the ceiling.
Hold for a moment, then lower your leg back down.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The reverse plank with leg lift is a challenging core exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and shoulders. It requires maintaining a strong reverse plank position while alternately lifting each leg, demanding significant core strength, balance, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no chão com seu pernas estendidas à sua frente e as mãos apoiando no chão atrás você, fingers pointing em direção aos pés.
Empurre através das mãos e levante o quadril do chão, coming em um inverta posição de prancha.
Contraia o abdômen e levante uma perna do chão, estendendo o peso reto para cima em direção ao ceiling.
Segure por um instante, em seguida desça a perna de volta para baixo.
Repita com o outro perna.
Continue alternando as pernas pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: dumbbell side plank with rear fly
instructions: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, keeping your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand, with your arm extended straight down towards the ground.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
While maintaining the side plank position, lift the dumbbell up towards the ceiling, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The dumbbell side plank with rear fly is a compound exercise that combines core stability with upper back and shoulder strength. It requires holding a side plank position while performing a rear fly with a dumbbell, challenging balance, coordination, and strength.
instructions_pt: Comece lying em seu lado com seu pernas estendidas e stacked em topo de cada outro.
Posicione o antebraço no chão directly abaixo o ombro, mantendo seu cotovelo flexionado a 90 graus.
Segure um halter em seu topo mão, com o braço estendido em linha reta para baixo em direção ao chão.
Contraia o abdômen e levante o quadril do chão, creating a linha reta da cabeça para os calcanhares.
Enquanto mantendo o lado posição de prancha, levante o halter para cima em direção ao ceiling, aproximando bem as escápulas.
Desça o halter de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de lado.

name: power point plank
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Engage your core and squeeze your glutes to maintain a stable position.
Lower your body down onto your forearms, one arm at a time, maintaining a straight line from head to toe.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time, keeping your core and glutes engaged.
To return to the starting position, push through your forearms and lift your body back up into a high plank position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The power point plank is a dynamic core exercise that involves transitioning between a high plank and a forearm plank position, challenging core stability, shoulder strength, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Inicie na alto posição de prancha com as mãos directly sob os ombros e o corpo na linha reta de cabeça para ponta do pé.
Contraia o abdômen e contraia os glúteos para mantenha a stable posição.
Desça o corpo para baixo onto os antebraços, um braço na time, mantendo a linha reta de cabeça para ponta do pé.
Sustente essa posição pelo desejado amount de time, mantendo seu core e glutes engaged.
Para retornar à posição inicial, empurre através dos antebraços e levante o corpo de volta para cima em um alto posição de prancha.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: walking on incline treadmill
instructions: Adjust the incline level on the treadmill to your desired intensity.
Stand on the treadmill with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Start walking at a comfortable pace, ensuring that you maintain proper form.
Engage your core muscles and keep your back straight throughout the exercise.
Continue walking on the incline treadmill for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Gradually decrease the incline and speed of the treadmill to cool down before stopping.
description: Walking on an incline treadmill is a cardiovascular exercise performed on a treadmill with the incline set to increase intensity. It primarily targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves.
instructions_pt: Ajuste o incline altura no treadmill para seu desejado intensity.
Fique em pé sobre o treadmill com os pés na largura dos ombros.
Inicie walking na comfortable pace, garantindo que that você mantenha proper form.
Contraia os músculos do core e mantenha a coluna ereta throughout o exercise.
Continue walking no incline treadmill pelo desejado duration de seu cardio workout.
Gradually decrease o incline e speed do treadmill para cool para baixo before stopping.

name: side lying hip adduction (male)
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Engage your adductors and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The side lying hip adduction (male) is a bodyweight exercise targeting the adductors, performed while lying on your side and lifting the top leg upward.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de lado com as pernas reto e stacked em topo de cada outro.
Posicione seu bottom braço sob a cabeça por support.
Contraia seu adductors e levante seu topo perna as alto as possible sem girando o quadril ou inclinando para trás.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo, em seguida desça lentamente a perna de volta à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e troque de lado.
name_pt: Adução de Quadril Deitado de Lado

name: standing archer
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, parallel to the ground.
Rotate your torso to the right, keeping your arms extended and your back straight.
As you rotate, extend your right arm forward and your left arm back, mimicking the motion of drawing a bowstring.
Hold the position for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the motion, this time rotating your torso to the left and extending your left arm forward and your right arm back.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The standing archer is a bodyweight exercise that targets the upper back and involves rotational movement of the torso, mimicking the motion of drawing a bowstring. It also engages the shoulders, biceps, and forearms.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros e joelhos levemente flexionados.
Estenda os braços estendidos à sua frente na altura dos ombros, paralelos ao chão.
Gire o tronco para a direita, mantendo seus braços estendidos e as costas reto.
Ao gire, estenda seu braço direito para a frente e seu braço esquerdo de volta, mimicking o movimento de drawing a bowstring.
Sustente a posição pela instante, em seguida retorne à posição inicial.
Repita o movimento, this time girando o tronco para a esquerda e estendendo seu braço esquerdo para a frente e seu braço direito de volta.
Continue alternando os lados pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: weighted decline sit-up
instructions: Lie flat on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and slowly lift your upper body off the bench, curling forward until your torso is perpendicular to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted decline sit-up is an abdominal exercise performed on a decline bench with added resistance. It primarily targets the abs while also engaging the hip flexors and lower back. This variation increases the intensity compared to standard sit-ups, requiring greater core strength and control.
instructions_pt: Deite-se apoiado na decline banco com os pés travado sob o pé apoios.
Posicione as mãos atrás da cabeça ou através do peitoral.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente levante o tronco do banco, flexionando para a frente até o tronco está perpendicular para o chão.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Abdominal no Banco Declinado com Carga

name: ski step
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and keep your back straight.
Jump to the right, landing on your right foot while swinging your left leg behind your right leg.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot while swinging your right leg behind your left leg.
Continue alternating jumps from side to side, mimicking a skiing motion.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The ski step is a dynamic, bodyweight exercise that mimics the motion of skiing. It involves lateral jumps from side to side, engaging the cardiovascular system while also working the lower body muscles.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e mantenha a coluna ereta.
Salte para a direita, aterrissando em seu pé direito enquanto swinging seu perna esquerda atrás seu perna direita.
Immediately salte para a esquerda, aterrissando em seu pé esquerdo enquanto swinging seu perna direita atrás seu perna esquerda.
Continue alternando jumps de lado para lado, mimicking a skiing movimento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: back and forth step
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward with your right foot, bending your knee and lowering your body into a lunge position.
Push off with your right foot and step back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left foot, alternating legs with each step.
Continue stepping back and forth, maintaining a steady pace.
Repeat for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description: A dynamic bodyweight exercise that alternates stepping forward and backward, targeting the cardiovascular system and lower body muscles.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Dê um passo para a frente com seu pé direito, flexionando o joelho e descendo o corpo em um lunge posição.
Impulsione-se com seu pé direito e dê um passo de volta à posição inicial.
Repita o movimento com seu pé esquerdo, alternando pernas com cada dê um passo.
Continue stepping de volta e forth, mantendo a steady pace.
Repita pelo número desejado duration ou number de repetições.
name_pt: Passada Frente e Trás (Back and Forth)

name: sit-up with arms on chest
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sit-up with arms on chest is a classic abdominal exercise that targets the abs and also engages the hip flexors. It is performed by lying on your back, crossing your arms over your chest, and lifting your upper body towards your knees.
instructions_pt: Deite-se de costas no chão com os joelhos flexionados e os pés apoiados.
Cruze os braços sobre o peitoral.
Contraindo o abdômen, levante o tronco do chão em direção aos joelhos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo e desça lentamente o tronco à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Abdominal Completo com Braços Cruzados no Peito

name: cable kneeling rear delt row (with rope) (male)
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a low cable pulley and kneel down facing the machine.
Grasp the rope with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and extend your arms fully in front of you.
Keeping your back straight and core engaged, pull the rope towards your body by retracting your shoulder blades.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement and hold for a brief pause.
Slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable kneeling rear delt row (with rope) targets the rear deltoids and upper back muscles, requiring the user to kneel and pull a rope attachment toward their body while maintaining a strong core and stable posture.
instructions_pt: Prenda a corda manopla para a baixo cabo pulley e kneel para baixo virado para o aparelho.
Segure a corda com pegada neutra (palmas voltadas uma para a outra) e estenda os braços totalmente à sua frente.
Mantendo a coluna ereta e o abdômen contraído, puxe a corda em direção ao corpo por retracting o ombro blades.
Aproxime bem as escápulas no end do movimento e segure pela breve faça uma pausa.
Lentamente solte o tension e retorne à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Remada Ajoelhado com Corda na Polia

name: inchworm v. 2
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend forward at the waist and place your hands on the ground in front of you.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a high plank position, with your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Keeping your legs straight, walk your feet towards your hands, bringing your hips up towards the ceiling.
Continue walking your hands forward, repeating the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The inchworm v. 2 is a bodyweight exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the shoulders and hamstrings. It involves moving from a standing position to a plank and back, promoting core strength, flexibility, and coordination.
instructions_pt: Inicie na posição em pé com os pés na largura do quadril.
Flexione para a frente no waist e posicione as mãos no chão à sua frente.
Walk as mãos para a frente até você estão na alto posição de prancha, com o corpo na linha reta de cabeça para ponta do pé.
Mantendo seu pernas reto, walk os pés em direção às mãos, aproximando o quadril para cima em direção ao ceiling.
Continue walking as mãos para a frente, repeating o movimento pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: shoulder tap
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and lift your right hand off the ground, reaching across to tap your left shoulder.
Place your right hand back on the ground and repeat with your left hand tapping your right shoulder.
Continue alternating shoulder taps while keeping your hips and torso stable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Shoulder taps are a bodyweight exercise performed in a high plank position, targeting the abs while also engaging the shoulders and triceps. The movement requires you to alternate tapping your shoulders with the opposite hand, challenging core stability and coordination.
instructions_pt: Inicie na alto posição de prancha com as mãos directly sob os ombros e o corpo na linha reta.
Contraia o abdômen e levante seu mão direita do chão, alcançando através de para tap seu ombro esquerdo.
Posicione seu mão direita de volta no chão e repita com seu mão esquerda tapping seu ombro direito.
Continue alternando ombro taps enquanto mantendo seus quadris e tronco stable.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Prancha com Toque no Ombro (Shoulder Tap)

name: lever standing chest press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at chest level.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the handles back towards your chest, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever standing chest press is a machine-based exercise that targets the pectoral muscles, with secondary emphasis on the shoulders and triceps. It is performed standing, using a leverage machine, and involves pressing handles forward from chest level to full extension.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco e posição yourself no aparelho com os pés apoiado no chão.
Segure as manoplas com pegada pronada e posição as mãos na altura do peito.
Empurre as manoplas para a frente até os braços estão totalmente estendidos, mantendo os cotovelos levemente flexionados.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida lentamente aproxime as manoplas de volta em direção ao peitoral, mantendo o controle throughout o movimento.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Supino em Pé na Máquina Articulada

name: lever seated good morning
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your hips are slightly higher than your knees.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the footrests.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Keeping your back straight, slowly lean forward from your hips until your upper body is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position by pushing through your glutes and hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated good morning is a machine-based exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It involves hinging at the hips while seated, using a leverage machine to provide resistance.
instructions_pt: Ajuste a altura do banco de modo que seus quadris estão levemente higher than os joelhos.
Sente-se no aparelho com as costas contra o apoio e os pés apoiado no footrests.
Segure as manoplas ou o lados do seat por stability.
Mantendo a coluna ereta, lentamente incline para a frente do quadril até o tronco está paralelo ao chão.
Faça uma breve pausa, em seguida retorne lentamente à posição inicial por empurrando através dos glúteos e hamstrings.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
