name_pt: Bom Dia Sentado na Máquina Articulada (Good Morning)

name: lever seated crunch v. 2
instructions: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the pad and your feet secured under the footpads.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the seat for support.
Engage your abs and slowly crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
Slowly return to the starting position, allowing your back to round slightly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated crunch v. 2 is an abdominal exercise performed on a leverage machine. It targets the abs, with secondary emphasis on the obliques and hip flexors. The movement involves crunching forward against resistance, making it a controlled and effective core strengthening exercise.
instructions_pt: Sente-se no leverage aparelho com as costas contra o apoio e os pés travado sob o footpads.
Posicione as mãos nas manoplas ou o lados do seat por support.
Contraia o abdômen e lentamente crunch para a frente, aproximando o peitoral em direção aos joelhos.
Faça uma breve pausa no topo do movimento, contraindo o abdômen.
Retorne lentamente à posição inicial, allowing as costas para round levemente.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
name_pt: Abdominal Supra Sentado na Máquina Articulada

name: curtsey squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step diagonally behind and across your body with your right foot, crossing it behind your left leg.
Bend both knees as if you were curtsying, lowering your body towards the ground.
Keep your torso upright and your weight on your front foot.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping diagonally behind and across your body with your left foot.
description: The curtsey squat is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes and also works the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping one leg diagonally behind and across the body, bending both knees to lower into a squat, and then returning to the starting position. This movement challenges balance and coordination in addition to strength.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés afastados na largura dos ombros.
Take a dê um passo diagonally atrás e através do corpo com seu pé direito, cruzando o peso atrás seu perna esquerda.
Flexione ambos os joelhos como se você were curtsying, descendo o corpo em direção ao chão.
Mantenha seu tronco upright e seu peso em seu frente pé.
Empurre através de seu frente pé para retornar à posição inicial.
Repita do outro lado, stepping diagonally atrás e através do corpo com seu pé esquerdo.

name: incline push-up (on box)
instructions: Place your hands on the edge of a box or elevated surface, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the box by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The incline push-up (on box) is a bodyweight exercise that targets the pectoral muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. It is performed by placing the hands on an elevated surface, such as a box, and executing a push-up motion.
instructions_pt: Posicione as mãos no edge da box ou elevated surface, levemente wider than na largura dos ombros.
Estenda as pernas atrás você, apoiando no balls dos pés, creating a linha reta da cabeça para os calcanhares.
Desça o peitoral em direção ao box flexionando os cotovelos, mantendo seu corpo na linha reta.
Faça uma breve pausa embaixo, em seguida empurre o corpo para cima novamente à posição inicial por estendendo os braços.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.

name: double under jump rope
instructions: Set rope length: stand on the middle and ensure handles reach roughly armpit height.
Hold handles lightly with elbows tucked and wrists slightly in front of hips; brace your core and look forward.
Begin with a few single-unders to establish rhythm on the balls of your feet.
Jump vertically a bit higher and whip the wrists quickly so the rope makes two revolutions during one jump.
Keep the torso tall with relaxed shoulders; do not tuck knees or kick heels back.
Land softly on the mid- to forefoot and absorb impact through ankles and knees.
Reset with singles if you miss, then resume double-unders for the desired reps or time while breathing steadily.
description: Stand tall with a jump rope behind your heels, elbows close to your sides. Jump slightly higher than a single-under while snapping the wrists so the rope passes under your feet twice before you land.
instructions_pt: Set corda length: Fique em pé sobre o middle e ensure manoplas alcance roughly armpit altura.
Segure manoplas lightly com cotovelos tucked e wrists levemente em frente a quadril; brace o core e look para a frente.
Begin com a few single-unders para establish rhythm no balls dos pés.
Salte vertically a bit higher e whip o wrists quickly so a corda makes dois revolutions during um salte.
Mantenha o tronco tall com relaxed ombros; do not tuck joelhos ou kick calcanhares de volta.
Aterrisse suavemente no mid- para forefoot e absorb impact através de tornozelos e joelhos.
Reset com singles if você miss, em seguida resume double-unders pelo desejado reps ou time enquanto breathing steadily.

name: dumbbell complex push up row clean and press
instructions: Place two dumbbells on the floor shoulder-width apart and grip the handles in a high plank; feet hip–shoulder width, core braced, wrists neutral.
Lower into a controlled push-up, keeping a straight line from head to heels.
Shift weight slightly and row the right dumbbell toward your ribs without rotating the torso; return it to the floor and repeat with the left.
Jump or step your feet to the outside of the dumbbells, keeping your back flat and hips down.
Drive through the legs and hips to clean the dumbbells to the shoulders, catching with elbows forward in a partial squat.
Stand tall and press the dumbbells overhead until arms are fully extended and ribs stay down.
Lower the dumbbells back to the shoulders, then hinge to place them on the floor with a neutral spine.
Kick or step your feet back to the plank position and repeat for the next rep.
description: Start in a high plank holding two dumbbells. Perform a push-up, row each dumbbell, then transition to a clean and overhead press before returning to the plank.
instructions_pt: Posicione dois halteres no chão na largura dos ombros e pegada as manoplas na alto plank; pés quadril-ombro largura, core braced, wrists neutral.
Desça em um controlled empurre-para cima, mantendo a linha reta de cabeça para calcanhares.
Transfira levemente o peso e reme o halter direito em direção às costelas sem girar o tronco; retorne ao chão e repita com o lado esquerdo.
Salte ou dê um passo os pés para o outside dos halteres, mantendo seu de volta apoiado e quadril para baixo.
Empurre com força através do pernas e quadril para clean os halteres para o ombros, catching com cotovelos para a frente na partial squat.
Fique em pé tall e empurre os halteres acima da cabeça até braços estão totalmente estendidos e ribs stay para baixo.
Desça os halteres de volta para o ombros, em seguida incline o tronco para posicione os pesos no chão com a neutral spine.
Kick ou dê um passo os pés de volta para o posição de prancha e repita pelo next rep.

name: jump box over (male)
instructions: Place a stable box in open space and stand beside it with feet hip‑width, knees soft, and chest up.
Brace your core, hinge slightly at the hips, and dip into a quarter‑squat while swinging the arms back.
Drive through the feet to jump up and laterally onto the box, landing softly with both feet flat, knees tracking over toes.
Immediately continue across the top and descend to the far side by a small hop or controlled step, landing softly on mid‑foot and absorbing with the hips and knees.
Reset posture on the floor, turn to face the box from the new side, and repeat back.
Keep a neutral spine throughout; avoid valgus knee collapse and do not catch the toes on the box.
If control or landing quality degrades, step down or lower the box height.
description: Stand to one side of a stable plyo box and jump laterally onto and over it, landing on the floor on the opposite side. Move explosively but land softly with control on each contact.
instructions_pt: Posicione a stable box em open space e fique em pé beside o peso com pés quadril‑largura, joelhos soft, e peito estufado.
Brace o core, incline o tronco levemente no quadril, e dip em um quarter‑squat enquanto swinging o braços de volta.
Empurre com força através do pés para salte para cima e laterally no box, aterrissando softly com ambos os pés apoiado, joelhos tracking sobre pontas dos pés.
Immediately continue através do topo e descend para o far lado pela small hop ou controlled dê um passo, aterrissando softly em mid‑pé e absorbing com o quadril e joelhos.
Reset posture no chão, turn para face o box do new lado, e repita de volta.
Mantenha a neutral spine throughout; avoid valgus joelho collapse e do not catch o pontas dos pés no box.
If control ou aterrissando quality degrades, dê um passo para baixo ou desça o box altura.
name_pt: Salto Sobre a Caixa (Box Jump Over)

name: dumbbell one arm snatch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Lower the dumbbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the dumbbell upwards in a straight line.
As the dumbbell reaches shoulder height, quickly rotate your hand and punch it overhead, fully extending your arm.
Catch the dumbbell overhead with a slight bend in your knees and hips.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell one arm snatch is a dynamic, full-body movement that targets the glutes, hamstrings, quadriceps, and core. It requires explosive power, coordination, and balance as you lift a dumbbell from the ground to overhead in one fluid motion.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com os pés na largura dos ombros, segurando um halter em uma mão com pegada pronada.
Flexione os joelhos levemente e incline o tronco para a frente no quadril, mantendo a coluna ereta e peito estufado.
Desça o halter em direção ao chão, mantendo o peso junto ao corpo.
estenda os quadris com potência e controle, joelhos, e tornozelos, driving o halter upwards na linha reta.
As o halter reaches ombro altura, quickly gire a mão e punch o peso acima da cabeça, totalmente estendendo o braço.
Catch o halter acima da cabeça com a slight flexione nos joelhos e quadril.
Desça o halter de volta à posição inicial na controlled manner.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições e passe para o outro braço.

name: resistance band horizontal pallof press
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways to it, feet hip-width, knees softly bent.
Grip the band with both hands at your sternum; stack ribs over pelvis and set a neutral spine.
Square hips and shoulders forward, away from the anchor; tense glutes and brace the abs.
Exhale and press the band straight out from your sternum until elbows are extended without shrugging.
Pause while resisting the band’s pull—do not let the torso rotate.
Inhale and draw the hands back to the sternum under control, maintaining alignment.
Complete reps, then switch sides to train the opposite direction.
description: Stand perpendicular to a chest-height anchored resistance band, holding it at your sternum with both hands. Brace your core and press the band straight out in front of you, resisting any rotation, then return under control.
instructions_pt: Anchor o elástico na altura do peito e fique em pé sideways para o peso, pés quadril-largura, joelhos softly flexionado.
Pegada o elástico com ambas as mãos em seu sternum; stack ribs sobre pelvis e set a neutral spine.
Square quadril e ombros para a frente, longe do anchor; tense glutes e brace o abs.
Expire e empurre o elástico estendidos de seu sternum até cotovelos estão estendido sem shrugging.
Faça uma pausa enquanto resisting o elástico's puxe-do not Mantenha o tronco gire.
Inspire e draw o mãos de volta para o sternum sob control, mantendo alignment.
Complete reps, em seguida troque lados para train o oposto direction.
name_pt: Pallof Press Horizontal com Faixa Elástica

name: resistance band shuttle
instructions: Place a light-to-moderate loop band around your ankles and stand hip-width with toes forward.
Drop into a quarter-squat: hips back, chest up, core braced, knees tracking over toes.
Create slight outward tension on the band so the knees don’t collapse inward.
Step laterally with the lead foot 12–24 inches, then bring the trail foot in just enough to keep the band taut—no slack.
Keep hips level, feet parallel, and weight through midfoot/heels as you shuffle for the prescribed steps or distance.
Pause under control, then reverse direction leading with the opposite leg for equal distance.
Maintain a steady tempo and neutral spine; avoid torso rotation or letting knees cave inward.
Reset if posture or tension is lost before continuing.
description: Loop a resistance band around your ankles, assume an athletic quarter-squat, and shuffle laterally while keeping constant band tension. Move for the set distance, then reverse while maintaining knee alignment and a stable torso.
instructions_pt: Posicione a light-para-moderate loop elástico around seu tornozelos e fique em pé quadril-largura com pontas dos pés para a frente.
Drop em um quarter-squat: quadril de volta, peito estufado, core braced, joelhos tracking sobre pontas dos pés.
Create slight para fora tension no elástico so o joelhos don't collapse para dentro.
Dê um passo laterally com o lead pé 12-24 inches, em seguida aproxime o trail pé em just enough para mantenha o elástico taut-no slack.
Mantenha quadril altura, pés paralelo, e peso através de midfoot/calcanhares ao shuffle pelo prescribed steps ou distance.
Faça uma pausa sob control, em seguida inverta direction leading com o perna oposta por equal distance.
Mantenha a steady tempo e neutral spine; avoid tronco rotation ou letting joelhos cave para dentro.
Reset if posture ou tension está lost before continuing.

name: broad jump to vertical
instructions: Stand with feet hip‑to‑shoulder width, toes slightly out, core braced, eyes forward.
Hinge and descend to a quarter–half squat with heels down and neutral spine, arms sweeping back.
Explosively swing the arms forward and triple‑extend hips, knees, and ankles to broad jump ahead.
Land softly on mid‑to‑forefoot then heels, feet under hips, knees tracking over toes, hips back.
Quickly absorb and rebound: swing the arms and drive straight up into a vertical jump.
Reach tall while keeping the torso upright and core tight.
Land softly again with knees and hips slightly bent; stabilize.
Reset spacing and repeat only while maintaining knee alignment and controlled landings.
description: From an athletic stance, jump forward in a powerful standing broad jump. Absorb the landing and immediately transition into a vertical jump, then land softly and reset.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé com pés quadril‑para‑ombro largura, pontas dos pés levemente para fora, core braced, eyes para a frente.
Incline o tronco e descend para a quarter-half squat com calcanhares para baixo e neutral spine, braços sweeping de volta.
Explosively swing o braços para a frente e triple‑estenda quadril, joelhos, e tornozelos para broad salte ahead.
Aterrisse suavemente em mid‑para‑forefoot em seguida calcanhares, pés sob quadril, joelhos tracking sobre pontas dos pés, quadril de volta.
Quickly absorb e rebound: swing o braços e empurre com força reto para cima em um vertical salte.
Alcance tall enquanto mantendo o tronco upright e core tight.
Aterrisse suavemente again com joelhos e quadril levemente flexionados; stabilize.
Reset spacing e repita only enquanto mantendo joelho alignment e controlled landings.
name_pt: Salto em Distância com Salto Vertical

name: medicine ball overhead throw
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width and hold the medicine ball at mid‑chest, elbows under the ball and wrists neutral.
Brace your core and take a small dip by bending hips and knees while keeping the torso upright.
Drive through the legs and extend the hips, then rapidly flex the shoulders and extend the elbows to launch the ball overhead and forward.
Release the ball slightly above forehead level at a 30–45° angle while keeping the ribcage down to avoid low‑back arching.
Finish tall on the toes with arms extended and eyes forward.
Catch the return (or retrieve the ball) with soft knees and a neutral spine.
Reset, inhale, and repeat powerful, crisp throws; exhale on each release.
description: Stand holding a medicine ball at your chest with feet shoulder-width. Dip and then explosively extend through the hips, shoulders, and elbows to throw the ball overhead and forward to a partner or wall.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé tall com pés ombro-largura e segure o medicine bola em mid‑peitoral, cotovelos sob o bola e wrists neutral.
Brace o core e take a small dip por flexionando quadril e joelhos enquanto mantendo o tronco upright.
Empurre com força através do pernas e estenda o quadril, em seguida rapidly flex o ombros e estenda o cotovelos para launch o bola acima da cabeça e para a frente.
Solte o bola levemente acima forehead altura na 30-45° ângulo enquanto mantendo o ribcage para baixo para avoid baixo‑de volta arching.
Finish tall no pontas dos pés com braços estendidos e eyes para a frente.
Catch o retorne (ou retrieve o bola) com soft joelhos e a neutral spine.
Reset, inspire, e repita powerful, crisp throws; expire em cada solte.
name_pt: Lançamento Acima da Cabeça com Medicine Ball

name: kettlebell overhead carry
instructions: Select a moderate kettlebell, hold it by the horns at chest height, then press it overhead until elbows are straight and wrists neutral.
Set your position: ribs down, pelvis neutral, abs and glutes braced; biceps align with or slightly behind the ears.
Actively reach the kettlebell to the ceiling so the shoulder blades upwardly rotate; keep the weight stacked over the midfoot.
Begin walking with small, controlled steps and a tall posture—no leaning, rib flare, or low‑back arch.
Keep the kettlebell stable (no drifting forward/back), eyes forward, and breathe behind the brace.
Turn carefully as needed without losing overhead lockout or trunk alignment.
After the set, stop, lower the kettlebell to the chest with control, then to the floor.
description: Stand tall and press a kettlebell overhead with both hands on the horns, locking the elbows with the biceps near the ears. Maintain a stacked rib‑cage–pelvis position and walk under control for distance or time while keeping the kettlebell directly over your midfoot.
instructions_pt: Select a moderate kettlebell, segure o peso pelo horns na altura do peito, em seguida empurre o peso acima da cabeça até cotovelos estão reto e wrists neutral.
Set seu posição: ribs para baixo, pelvis neutral, abs e glutes braced; biceps align com ou levemente atrás o ears.
Actively alcance o kettlebell para o ceiling so o ombro blades upwardly gire; mantenha o peso stacked sobre o midfoot.
Begin walking com small, controlled steps e a tall posture-no inclinando, rib flare, ou baixo‑de volta arch.
Mantenha o kettlebell stable (no drifting para a frente/de volta), eyes para a frente, e breathe atrás o brace.
Turn carefully as needed sem losing acima da cabeça lockout ou trunk alignment.
After o set, stop, desça o kettlebell para o peitoral com control, em seguida para o chão.

name: single leg board jump
instructions: Stand tall on one leg facing the board/target, core braced, hip–knee–toe aligned.
Hinge slightly and descend into a quarter squat, arms sweeping back, free leg behind for balance.
Drive through the standing foot, extending ankle, knee, and hip to jump forward.
Swing the arms forward to assist, keeping the torso controlled and knee tracking over toes.
Land softly on the same foot, ball-to-heel, with knee bent and hips back.
Hold and stabilize for 1–2 seconds without the knee collapsing inward.
Reset posture and repeat for reps, then switch legs.
description: Stand on one leg facing a low board or marked landing spot. Load into a quarter squat and explosively hop forward to land softly on the same leg, stabilizing before the next rep.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé tall em uma perna virado para o board/target, core braced, quadril-joelho-ponta do pé aligned.
Incline o tronco levemente e descend em um quarter squat, braços sweeping de volta, free perna atrás por balance.
Empurre com força através do standing pé, estendendo tornozelo, joelho, e quadril para salte para a frente.
Swing o braços para a frente para assist, mantendo o tronco controlled e joelho tracking sobre pontas dos pés.
Aterrisse suavemente no same pé, bola-para-calcanhar, com joelho flexionado e quadril de volta.
Segure e stabilize por 1-2 seconds sem o joelho collapsing para dentro.
Reset posture e repita por reps, em seguida troque pernas.

name: medicine ball crunch
instructions: Lie supine with knees bent ~90° and feet hip-width apart; hold the medicine ball against your chest with elbows tucked.
Posteriorly tilt the pelvis to lightly flatten the low back; brace the abs and keep the neck neutral with a slight chin tuck.
Exhale and curl the trunk, lifting head, shoulders, and upper back until the shoulder blades just clear the floor; keep the ball touching your chest.
Pause briefly and squeeze the abs; do not pull with the arms or jut the chin forward.
Inhale and lower slowly, placing the spine back down segment by segment until the shoulder blades touch.
Maintain a small, controlled range and steady tension; stop if you feel low-back discomfort or hip flexor dominance.
description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, holding a medicine ball against your chest. Curl your torso to lift the shoulder blades off the floor, then return under control.
instructions_pt: Deite-se supine com joelhos flexionado ~90° e pés na largura do quadril; segure o medicine bola contra o peitoral com cotovelos tucked.
Posteriorly tilt o pelvis para lightly flatten o baixo de volta; brace o abs e mantenha o pescoço neutro com a slight chin tuck.
Expire e flexione o trunk, levantando cabeça, ombros, e upper de volta até o ombro blades just clear o chão; mantenha o bola tocando o peitoral.
Faça uma breve pausa e contraia o abs; do not puxe com o braços ou jut o chin para a frente.
Inspire e desça lentamente, placing o spine de volta para baixo segment por segment até o ombro blades toque.
Mantenha a small, controlled range e steady tension; stop if você feel baixo-de volta discomfort ou quadril flexor dominance.

name: single leg vertical jump
instructions: Stand tall on one leg with the other knee slightly flexed and arms by your sides.
Engage your core, keep your chest up, and align the stance knee over the toes.
Hinge slightly at the hips and dip into a quarter squat to load the leg.
Swing the arms upward and drive through the whole foot, extending hip, knee, and ankle to jump vertically.
Lift the non-jumping knee up as you reach maximal height while keeping the torso neutral.
Land quietly on the same leg with a soft knee and hip, absorbing the impact through hip–knee–ankle.
Reset balance and repeat for reps, then switch legs. Keep the knee tracking over the toes and avoid valgus collapse.
description: Stand on one leg, dip into a quarter squat, then explode straight up using an arm swing. Land softly on the same leg, absorb the force, and reset before the next rep.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé tall em uma perna com o outro joelho levemente flexed e braços por seu lados.
Contraia o abdômen, mantenha seu peito estufado, e align o stance joelho sobre o pontas dos pés.
Incline o tronco levemente no quadril e dip em um quarter squat para load o perna.
Swing o braços para cima e empurre com força através do whole pé, estendendo quadril, joelho, e tornozelo para salte vertically.
Levante o non-saltando joelho para cima ao alcance maximal altura enquanto mantendo o tronco neutral.
Aterrisse quietly no same perna com a soft joelho e quadril, absorbing o impact através de quadril-joelho-tornozelo.
Reset balance e repita por reps, em seguida troque pernas. mantenha o joelho tracking sobre o pontas dos pés e avoid valgus collapse.

name: straight leg hip bridge
instructions: Lie supine with legs straight hip-width apart, heels on the floor and toes pointed up.
Brace the core and lightly posteriorly tilt the pelvis; keep knees extended without locking out.
Press the heels into the floor and squeeze the hamstrings and glutes to lift the hips.
Raise until your shoulders, hips, and ankles align; keep ribs down and neck neutral.
Pause 1–2 seconds while maintaining straight legs and level hips.
Lower the hips slowly to the floor without arching the lower back.
Exhale on the lift, inhale on the descent, and repeat for reps.
description: Lie on your back with legs straight and heels on the floor, arms across chest. Drive through the heels to lift the hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to ankles, then lower with control.
instructions_pt: Deite-se supine com pernas reto na largura do quadril, calcanhares no chão e pontas dos pés pointed para cima.
Brace o core e lightly posteriorly tilt o pelvis; mantenha joelhos estendido sem locking para fora.
Empurre o calcanhares no chão e contraia o hamstrings e glutes para levante o quadril.
Eleve até os ombros, quadril, e tornozelos align; mantenha ribs para baixo e pescoço neutro.
Faça uma pausa 1-2 seconds enquanto mantendo reto pernas e altura quadril.
Desça o quadril lentamente para o chão sem arching o desça de volta.
Expire no levante, inspire no descent, e repita por reps.
name_pt: Ponte de Glúteos com Pernas Estendidas

name: stepdown squat
instructions: Stand tall on a sturdy step 15–30 cm high; toes forward, hands on hips or out for balance.
Shift your weight fully over the working leg, keeping pelvis level and core braced.
Bend the stance knee and hip to descend, letting the free heel reach toward the floor in front.
Track the stance knee over the second–third toe; do not let it cave inward.
Lightly tap the floor with the free heel without transferring weight to it.
Press through the stance midfoot/heel to extend the knee and hip and return to the start.
Complete all reps under slow control, then switch legs.
description: Stand on a stable step with one leg as the support and the other foot hanging off the edge. Lower under control until the free heel lightly taps the floor, then drive back up to stand tall.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé tall na sturdy dê um passo 15-30 cm alto; pontas dos pés para a frente, mãos em quadril ou para fora por balance.
transfira o peso do corpo totalmente sobre o working perna, mantendo pelvis altura e core braced.
Flexione o stance joelho e quadril para descend, letting o free calcanhar alcance em direção ao chão em frente.
Track o stance joelho sobre o second-third ponta do pé; do not Mantenha o peso cave para dentro.
Lightly tap o chão com o free calcanhar sem transferring peso para o peso.
Empurre através do stance midfoot/calcanhar para estenda o joelho e quadril e retorne para o inicie.
Complete all reps sob slow control, em seguida troque pernas.

name: shuffle
instructions: Stand in an athletic stance: feet hip–shoulder width, knees bent, hips back, chest up, arms ready.
Brace your core and stay light on the balls of your feet.
Push off the trail foot and step the lead foot laterally; quickly slide the trail foot in without crossing.
Keep hips low and level; track knees over toes and avoid letting them cave inward.
Take 2–4 quick shuffles in one direction, then plant the outside foot and reverse.
Move fast but controlled, landing softly each step, and continue for the set time or distance.
description: Start in a low athletic stance and move laterally with quick, short steps, staying on the balls of your feet. Shuffle side to side while keeping your hips low and torso stable to elevate heart rate.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé em an athletic stance: pés quadril-ombro largura, joelhos flexionado, quadril de volta, peito estufado, braços ready.
Brace o core e stay light no balls dos pés.
Impulsione-se a partir de trail pé e dê um passo o lead pé laterally; quickly slide o trail pé em sem cruzando.
Mantenha quadril baixo e altura; track joelhos sobre pontas dos pés e avoid letting os pesos cave para dentro.
Take 2-4 quick shuffles em um direction, em seguida plant o outside pé e inverta.
Move fast but controlled, aterrissando softly cada dê um passo, e continue pelo set time ou distance.

name: backwards run
instructions: Choose a clear, obstacle‑free lane; face forward with tall posture and brace your core.
Shift weight slightly onto the balls of your feet and initiate movement by pushing the ground away to step backward.
Land softly on the mid/forefoot with knees slightly bent; keep feet under your hips to avoid overstriding.
Maintain an upright torso, neutral spine, and look over your shoulder periodically (or use a spotter) to steer.
Pump arms naturally opposite the legs and keep a quick, compact cadence.
Breathe steadily and stop or turn around to reorient whenever you lose clear visibility.
description: Run in reverse on a clear, flat surface using short, quick steps and a soft mid/forefoot landing. Keep an upright torso, core braced, and pump the arms while periodically checking behind you for safety.
instructions_pt: Choose a clear, obstacle‑free lane; face para a frente com tall posture e brace o core.
Shift peso levemente no balls dos pés e initiate movimento por empurrando o chão longe para dê um passo para trás.
Aterrisse suavemente no mid/forefoot com joelhos levemente flexionados; mantenha pés sob o quadril para avoid overstriding.
Mantenha an upright tronco, neutral spine, e look sobre o ombro periodically (ou use a spotter) para steer.
Pump braços naturally oposto o pernas e mantenha a quick, compact cadence.
Breathe steadily e stop ou turn around para reorient whenever você lose clear visibility.

name: dumbbell waiter biceps curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your upper arms close to your body and your elbows tucked in.
Slowly curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your wrists straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell waiter biceps curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed with dumbbells. It also engages the forearms and shoulders as secondary muscles. The movement requires basic strength and coordination, making it suitable for most fitness levels.
instructions_pt: Fique em pé ereto com um halter em cada mão, palmas voltadas para a frente.
Mantenha seu upper braços junto ao corpo e os cotovelos tucked em.
Lentamente flexione os halteres para cima em direção aos ombros, mantendo seu wrists reto.
Faça uma pausa no topo e desça lentamente os halteres à posição inicial.
Repita pelo número desejado de repetições.
